enabled: A handle was adopted or an existing enabled handle remains active.
gated: Permission is denied. Initial denial skips activation; if permission is withdrawn while activation runs, its late handle is released before returning gated.

members.name: hostDisposed
members.description: Thrown when a mutation method such as `register`, `setFlag`, `setFlags`, `enable`, or `disable` * is called after the host is disposed. * * Enforces the terminal host boundary. Read-only diagnostics (`names`, `state`, `handle`, and * `error`) remain available after disposal. Create a new host to enable capabilities again. A * disposed host cannot be revived.

members.name: hostTransitioning
members.description: Thrown or rejected when `register`, `setFlag`, `setFlags`, `enable`, `disable`, or `dispose` * reenters a disposer or reporter while `transitionDepth > 0`. Also rejects repeated `dispose()` * calls before the first disposal completes. * * Enforces the reentrancy boundary. A rollback callback cannot rewrite the flag snapshot during * the surrounding transition. Move mutations outside lifecycle callbacks.

members.name: notRegistered
members.description: Thrown when `state`, `handle`, `error`, `enable`, or `disable` references an unregistered * capability. * * Enforces registered-name lookup. Check the name and register the capability first.

members.name: alreadyRegistered
members.description: Thrown when `register()` receives an existing `name`. Duplicate registration is a programming * error and never silently replaces the existing entry. * * Enforces unique registration names. Use a different name or create a new host.

members.name: invalidName
members.description: Thrown as a `TypeError` when `register()` receives a name that is not a nonempty string. * * Enforces input validation. Correct `name` before retrying.

members.name: invalidActivate
members.description: Thrown as a `TypeError` when `register()` receives a non-function `activate`. * * Enforces input validation. Provide a callable `activate`.

members.name: invalidHandle
members.description: Thrown as a `TypeError` when the result of `activate()` lacks a callable `dispose`. Rejects * incomplete activation instead of leaving a partially enabled capability. * * Enforces the handle contract. Ensure `activate` returns a handle with `dispose`.

members.name: gated
members.description: Reserved for diagnostics or events when the gate denies activation. No current throw site uses * it. `enable()` returns `{ status: 'gated' }` for a denied activation without throwing. * Reserving this code for an `onError` or event channel does not change that behavior. * * Enforces the activation gate. `gated` differs from graph availability `blocked`. Branch on the * return value instead of catching an error.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Thrown when an `ownKeys`, `getOwnPropertyDescriptor`, or getter operation fails while * snapshotting `flags`, `definition`, or graph-readiness state/error, for example on a hostile * proxy. Annotatable readiness getter Errors retain their native identity and receive this code. * * The gate fails closed before throwing. `cause` retains the original proxy exception by * identity. Correct the flags or definition object before retrying.

off: Activation is allowed but no active handle has been adopted.
gated: The flag denies activation, so the activation callback is not called.

symbols.name: createCapabilityHost
symbols.purpose: Creates an isolated host owning feature permission, activation state and disposable handles. Register activation callbacks, grant permission explicitly and call enable to start. `options` defaults to `{}`; omitted flags deny every capability. Resource dependencies belong to the graph entry rather than this independent-feature gate.
symbols.core:
context: Required application context, which may explicitly be `undefined`; there is no default, cloning or prescribed field shape. Activation callbacks receive the original value. In the first case, the caller owns the `tenant` string field.
Caller-owned ICapabilityHost; dispose it when finished. Invalid options throw tagged native errors before construction completes.
flags: Copied complete name-to-boolean mapping; only own enumerable data properties exactly `true` grant permission. Getters and inherited properties do not grant permission; later input mutation has no effect.
`undefined`: every capability is denied until explicitly permitted by a flag; granting permission does not activate it.
onError: Receives (name, error) for activation or release failure; name comes from registration and error is original. No return is consumed; synchronous or async reporter failure reaches the shared utils host exception queue without changing business state.
The default is undefined, meaning that no error callback is configured. Omission therefore sends no callback notification, but failures remain recorded. Use host.error(name) to read a recorded failure even when no callback was supplied.
Set it when activation and cleanup failures need monitoring. The callback receives the registered name and original error. Omitting it keeps failures available through host.error(name) but sends no callback.
parameters: context: Context
options: ICapabilityHostOptions (optional)
symbols.returns: ICapabilityHost<Context>

declaredConfiguration.name: flags
declaredConfiguration.description: Initial flag snapshot. The gate denies activation by default. Only own data properties whose value is exactly `true` permit activation. The host copies this snapshot. Use `setFlag()` or `setFlags()` for later changes. Mutating the input object cannot bypass the state machine. `setFlag(name, false)` atomically invalidates pending activation and releases the current handle. A separate `disable()` call is unnecessary.

declaredConfiguration.name: onError
declaredConfiguration.description: Reports activation or release failures; omitted by default. Reporter failures preserve gate state and error(name) diagnostics and reach the shared terminal reporting channel.

rows: 终态 Host 上调用变更方法。
同步生命周期重入，或首次 dispose 完成前再次调用。
查询或操作未登记能力。
名字不是 trim 后非空字符串，TypeError。
激活结果缺少可调用 dispose，TypeError。
保留诊断码，当前 enable 返回 gated 而不抛此码。
options/flags/definition/readiness 准入或读取失败，保留原 cause。

rows: GRAPH_DISPOSED：终态变更或不允许的读取。
GRAPH_INVALID_NODE：定义、边或启动结果形状非法。

GRAPH_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE：直接读取未声明/未 ready provider，或不能取得 binding lease。
GRAPH_START_FAILED：启动失败，回滚或记录失败批次。
GRAPH_ADMISSION_CLOSED：关闭中或已结束的启动 context 继续接纳工作。
GRAPH_REENTRANT_OPERATION：同步生命周期回调重入。
GRAPH_INVALID_OPTION：选项或 own descriptor 不合法。
GRAPH_NODE_HAS_DEPENDENTS：reject 策略遇到 required 消费者。

members.description: Captures a name and activation function without activating. Duplicate names, malformed recipes, disposed hosts, and synchronous lifecycle reentry fail with the corresponding host code.

members.name: names
members.description: Fresh registration-order name array; it is a snapshot, not the mutable registry.

members.name: state
members.description: Reads current lifecycle state; an unknown name throws NOT_REGISTERED, even after disposal.

members.name: handle

members.description: Returns the enabled handle or undefined; unknown names throw NOT_REGISTERED.

members.name: error
members.description: Returns the retained activation or release failure, or undefined. Starting a new attempt or deactivating clears the prior diagnostic; unknown names throw NOT_REGISTERED.

members.name: setFlag
members.description: Updates one flag. Disabling synchronously invalidates pending activation and releases the handle. Enabling does not activate. A name may be configured before it is registered; the setter does not wait for asynchronous cleanup.

members.name: setFlags
members.description: Atomically replaces all flags. Missing capabilities are denied, so removed keys cannot retain an earlier true value. An unreadable snapshot gates every entry before INVALID_OPTION is thrown. Accessor flags are not evaluated, and this setter does not await cleanup.

members.name: enable
members.description: Activates the capability and returns its structured activation outcome. Concurrent in-flight calls share the exact Promise and one activation. A denied flag resolves gated without activation; an already enabled entry resolves enabled. Activation failures resolve failed, while unknown names, disposed hosts, and transition reentry reject.

members.name: disable
members.description: Synchronously invalidates activation and releases the current handle, then waits for this entry's in-flight activation and cleanup, including late results. Resolves true only if the entry was on; pending activation cancellation returns false. Cleanup failures are reported.

members.name: dispose
members.description: Makes the host terminal and releases handles in reverse activation-completion order, then waits for every in-flight activation and release. Cleanup failures are reported without stopping other releases. Later calls fail with HOST_TRANSITIONING until the first completion Promise settles; after completion they return that original Promise by identity.

members.name: disposed
members.description: Becomes true synchronously when final disposal begins, before pending cleanup settles.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
flags: Copied complete name-to-boolean mapping; only own enumerable data properties exactly `true` grant permission. Getters and inherited properties do not grant permission; later input mutation has no effect.
`undefined`: every capability is denied until explicitly permitted by a flag; granting permission does not activate it.
onError: Receives (name, error) for activation or release failure; name comes from registration and error is original. No return is consumed; synchronous or async reporter failure reaches the shared utils host exception queue without changing business state.
The default is undefined, meaning that no error callback is configured. Omission therefore sends no callback notification, but failures remain recorded. Use host.error(name) to read a recorded failure even when no callback was supplied.
Set it when activation and cleanup failures need monitoring. The callback receives the registered name and original error. Omitting it keeps failures available through host.error(name) but sends no callback.

symbols.name: createCapabilityGraph
symbols.purpose: Creates a runtime-neutral static resource dependency graph: providers produce values used by consumers. Register all nodes before the first `ready()`, which freezes admission. Startup proceeds by dependency level, starting every node in a level before awaiting that level; cleanup reverses level and registration order. `options` defaults to `{}` and omitted `onError` is `undefined`. The graph owns rollback and resource release, without tracking reactive data changes.
symbols.core:
Caller-owned ICapabilityGraph with one startup transaction and shared disposal Promise; invalid options throw GRAPH_INVALID_OPTION.
onError: Receives (error) for contained or secondary failures. Return is ignored; reporter throws and rejected thenables reach the shared utils host exception queue without changing graph results.
`undefined`: no external reporting sink is installed.
Use it to observe recoverable release diagnostics and secondary rollback failures. It does not replace the startup or disposal result. Without it, the graph has no external reporting sink.
parameters: options: ICapabilityGraphOptions (optional)
symbols.returns: ICapabilityGraph

symbols.name: ICapabilityGraph
symbols.purpose: Static dependency graph owning one frozen startup and reverse-order cleanup transaction.
symbols.core:
register: Snapshots a node before the first ready call freezes registration; duplicates and malformed definitions reject admission.
register.node: Required definition with no field defaults: `id` is an application-issued nonempty `IGraphNodeId`, `kind` is a nonempty diagnostic string, `dependencies` is an array (use `[]` for none), and `start(context)` is callable. Each edge requires `provider` (a registered node ID) and `required: true`, with no duplicate providers. `start` receives `nodeId`, a graph-owned native `signal`, `get(provider)` for declared ready direct providers and `own(resource, descriptor)` for auxiliary lifecycle ownership. Return `{ value, release(context) }`, or its thenable; `value` may be any value including `undefined`, and required `release` returns void or a completion thenable. Its context contains `nodeId`, `signal` and `report(error)`.
No return value; the definition is admitted without starting it.
ready: Freezes registration and starts providers before consumers; partial failure rolls back provisional and adopted resources. An admitted stale primary is still released if auxiliary rollback fails; failures follow the existing reporter policy.
The same Promise for every caller. Missing providers, cycles and startup failures reject with graph errors retaining the original cause.
nodeState: Creates a diagnostic snapshot for a registered node, including state and retained startup error.
nodeState.id: The application-assigned id from the registered node definition.
IGraphNodeDiagnostic; value is visible only when graph and node are ready. Unknown IDs throw GRAPH_UNKNOWN_NODE.
readValue: Reads the nodeState value projection without allocating a diagnostic or cloning the payload.
readValue.id: The application-assigned id from the registered node definition.
Original payload while graph and node are ready, otherwise undefined, which is also valid payload data. Unknown IDs throw GRAPH_UNKNOWN_NODE.
nodes: Frozen IDs in registration order, retained for diagnostic iteration.
state: Container transaction state from CapabilityGraphState, independent of node state.
error: Primary graph error retained through failure and terminal transitions, or undefined.
dispose: Closes admission, aborts startup and releases consumers before providers.
One shared Promise for repeated calls. Cleanup failures reject with GRAPH_DISPOSE_FAILED and original errors remain reachable; terminal graphs cannot restart.
get: Reads a ready declared direct provider for a consumer; transitive or undeclared access is refused.
get.consumer: Application-assigned id from the registered consumer definition.
get.provider: Application-assigned provider ID declared in this consumer dependency list.
Exact provider payload; unavailable or undeclared access throws GRAPH_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.

parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this type.

members.description: Closes admission and value visibility immediately, then releases in reverse topology order. Shares one Promise, including while pending. symbols.name: createDynamicCapabilityGraph
symbols.purpose: Creates a serialized dynamic graph with required-edge reconciliation and exact binding-generation custody. Ordering belongs to the graph; mandatory startBatch and releaseBatch callbacks own physical resources.
symbols.core:
Caller-owned IDynamicCapabilityGraph. Missing batch owners or invalid nonnegative admission budget throw GRAPH_INVALID_OPTION; dispose it when composition ends.
report: Receives original contained startup, release and late failure as error; return is ignored and own throws/rejections are contained.
Omitted: no external failure reporter is called.
Set it when contained startup, cleanup or late failures must reach monitoring. It receives the original error and does not replace graph results. Omission sends no external callback.
mutationAdmissionMs: Maximum queued wait before an ordinary mutation starts; finite nonnegative milliseconds only. Final dispose is exempt and waits for preceding admitted work in the same FIFO.
Omitted: the mutation queue has no admission deadline.
startBatch: Required callback receives topologically ordered IGraphStartEntry entries, each with id, binding and definition. Return one instance per entry in the same order, synchronously or by thenable. The owner must construct and roll back physical resources; throw/rejection becomes GRAPH_START_FAILED.
Always supply the physical startup owner. Return one instance for each entry, in the same order, and roll back partial resources if startup fails. There is no default; the graph does not execute definition.start for you.
releaseBatch: Required callback receives provider-first IGraphReleaseEntry entries and a Promise fence that resolves when sealed generation leases drain. Await the fence before physical teardown, release consumers first, and return void or completion thenable. Failure rejects the operation.
Always supply physical cleanup. Wait for fence, then release entries in reverse order so consumers stop before providers. There is no default, and a rejected cleanup rejects the operation.
releaseBinding: Receives an exact IGraphBindingReleaseEntry after successful instance cleanup for removal, replacement or disposal. Return void or completion thenable; failures are reported without replacing the primary result.
Omitted: graph relinquishes bindings without a composition release callback.
Set it when a composition binding owns something beyond the graph instance. It runs after instance cleanup on removal, replacement and final disposal. Omit it when relinquishing the binding needs no callback; failures go to report without stopping other bindings.

symbols.name: IDynamicCapabilityGraph
symbols.purpose: Serialized dependency graph owning ordering and exact binding custody; composition callbacks own physical resources.
symbols.core:
nodes: Current registered IDs in definition insertion order; removed definitions disappear.
state: Graph container lifecycle, separate from each node and its binding availability.
generation: Monotonic graph mutation generation used to distinguish committed lifecycle epochs.
register: Snapshots and serializes admission of a dynamic definition and optional composition binding; ready graphs reconcile newly available required providers.
register.node: Application-created ID, kind, dependencies and start recipe. The graph hands definitions to startBatch; it does not invoke start itself.
register.binding: Optional application-owned binding associated with this exact generation, for example a composition host. Omitted means no binding.
Promise of IGraphMutationResult with affected IDs, topologyChanged and generation. Invalid state or admission timeout rejects with a graph error.
remove: Removes a definition through reject or required-dependent cascade policy; cleanup precedes binding custody release.
remove.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
remove.options: Optional policy: cascade by default, or reject while required dependents remain.
suspend: Suspends a node and required dependent frontier while retaining definitions for explicit recovery.
suspend.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
suspend.options: Optional cascade policy by default; reject refuses a node with required dependents.
resume: Restores availability of the retained suspended provider instance without rerunning startBatch, then reconciles affected required dependents; a non-suspended target rejects GRAPH_NODE_NOT_SUSPENDED.
resume.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
dependentsOf: Reads direct present consumers split by required and optional edge kind without starting or mutating them.
dependentsOf.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
IGraphDependents with required and optional ID lists; unknown IDs throw GRAPH_UNKNOWN_NODE.
replace: Replaces an existing node generation and binding, releases old custody and restarts affected instances; unchanged edges retain schedule metadata.
replace.node: Replacement definition using the application-assigned ID of an existing registration.
replace.binding: Application-owned next-generation binding; omitted replaces it with undefined.
replace.options: Optional restartDependents defaults true. With false, onReplaced may rebind direct required dependents; absence or callback failure falls back to restarting their closure.
ready: Queues reconciliation and batch startup for currently startable definitions; missing required providers remain blocked rather than starting.
Promise completing this serialized readiness operation; batch startup failure rejects GRAPH_START_FAILED with original cause. This is not the static graph canonical readiness Promise.
nodeState: Creates a current diagnostic including binding generation, retained value, errors and cached schedule rank.
nodeState.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
IGraphNodeDiagnostic; unknown IDs throw GRAPH_UNKNOWN_NODE.
getBinding: Reads the retained composition binding without acquiring a lease or requiring node readiness.
getBinding.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
Original binding or undefined for an unknown node or omitted binding. Use acquireBinding when observation must delay release.
acquireBinding: Retains one exact ready binding generation. Pair with the returned lease release() before awaiting graph cleanup.
acquireBinding.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
IGraphBindingLease with original value and idempotent release; absent, unready or undefined bindings throw GRAPH_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.
dispose: Immediately closes admission and queues final physical cleanup and binding release; terminal cleanup clears definitions. Final disposal waits behind admitted predecessors in the same FIFO without mutationAdmissionMs timeout.
One shared disposal Promise. Composition releaseBatch must honor the lease fence; releaseBinding failures are reported, while releaseBatch failures reject disposal.

members.description: Mutation counter, initially zero; readiness alone does not advance it.

members.name: register
members.description: Queues admission of a new definition and optional binding, then starts its satisfiable required-consumer frontier. Missing providers leave nodes blocked; a start failure rejects while retaining the admitted definition and its diagnostic for later reconciliation.

members.name: remove
members.description: Removes the target definition and binding after cleanup. Default cascade releases required consumers but retains their definitions as blocked; reject refuses any required consumers.

members.name: suspend
members.description: Withholds the target and blocks required consumers without releasing their instances or bindings. Defaults to cascade; reject refuses a target with required consumers.

members.name: resume
members.description: Restores a suspended target and satisfiable retained consumers, starting only missing instances. Other unavailable required providers keep consumers blocked; a nonsuspended target rejects with GRAPH_NODE_NOT_SUSPENDED.

members.name: dependentsOf
members.description: Returns frozen direct required/optional consumer lists; an absent ID throws GRAPH_UNKNOWN_NODE.

members.name: replace
members.signature: replace<T>(node: IDynamicGraphNodeDefinition<T>, binding?: TBinding, options?: IGraphReplaceOptions<TBinding>): Promise<IGraphMutationResult>;
members.description: Queues replacement of a present definition and binding, preserving its registration ordinal. Defaults to restarting required consumers; false restartDependents attempts onReplaced with restart fallback. Same-edge replacement preserves canonical rank and level.

members.name: ready
members.description: Queues startup of currently satisfiable nodes and sets container ready; blocked nodes may remain.

members.name: nodeState
members.description: Returns a fresh, unfrozen diagnostic projection with original value/binding references; unknown IDs throw.

members.name: getBinding
members.description: Reads a binding without checking node availability or acquiring a lease; absent IDs return undefined.

members.name: acquireBinding
members.description: Returns a frozen lease for a ready non-undefined binding; unavailable or sealed generations reject.

members.name: dispose
members.description: Immediately closes admission, then queues final cleanup behind accepted work without an admission timeout. Repeated calls share the exact Promise. Definitions are cleared and state becomes terminal even if releaseBatch rejects; the composition owner must honor lease fences.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Serialized dependency graph owning ordering and exact binding custody; composition callbacks own physical resources.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import IDynamicCapabilityGraph from @migaia/capability/graph/dynamic, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use IDynamicCapabilityGraph when its type contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when IDynamicCapabilityGraph does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained type example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
nodes: Current registered IDs in definition insertion order; removed definitions disappear.
state: Graph container lifecycle, separate from each node and its binding availability.
generation: Monotonic graph mutation generation used to distinguish committed lifecycle epochs.
register: Snapshots and serializes admission of a dynamic definition and optional composition binding; ready graphs reconcile newly available required providers.
register.node: Application-created ID, kind, dependencies and start recipe. The graph hands definitions to startBatch; it does not invoke start itself.
register.binding: Optional application-owned binding associated with this exact generation, for example a composition host. Omitted means no binding.
Promise of IGraphMutationResult with affected IDs, topologyChanged and generation. Invalid state or admission timeout rejects with a graph error.
remove: Removes a definition through reject or required-dependent cascade policy; cleanup precedes binding custody release.
remove.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
remove.options: Optional policy: cascade by default, or reject while required dependents remain.
suspend: Suspends a node and required dependent frontier while retaining definitions for explicit recovery.
suspend.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
suspend.options: Optional cascade policy by default; reject refuses a node with required dependents.
resume: Restores availability of the retained suspended provider instance without rerunning startBatch, then reconciles affected required dependents; a non-suspended target rejects GRAPH_NODE_NOT_SUSPENDED.
resume.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
dependentsOf: Reads direct present consumers split by required and optional edge kind without starting or mutating them.
dependentsOf.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
IGraphDependents with required and optional ID lists; unknown IDs throw GRAPH_UNKNOWN_NODE.
replace: Replaces an existing node generation and binding, releases old custody and restarts affected instances; unchanged edges retain schedule metadata.
replace.node: Replacement definition using the application-assigned ID of an existing registration.
replace.binding: Application-owned next-generation binding; omitted replaces it with undefined.
replace.options: Optional restartDependents defaults true. With false, onReplaced may rebind direct required dependents; absence or callback failure falls back to restarting their closure.
ready: Queues reconciliation and batch startup for currently startable definitions; missing required providers remain blocked rather than starting.
Promise completing this serialized readiness operation; batch startup failure rejects GRAPH_START_FAILED with original cause. This is not the static graph canonical readiness Promise.
nodeState: Creates a current diagnostic including binding generation, retained value, errors and cached schedule rank.
nodeState.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
IGraphNodeDiagnostic; unknown IDs throw GRAPH_UNKNOWN_NODE.
getBinding: Reads the retained composition binding without acquiring a lease or requiring node readiness.
getBinding.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
Original binding or undefined for an unknown node or omitted binding. Use acquireBinding when observation must delay release.
acquireBinding: Retains one exact ready binding generation. Pair with the returned lease release() before awaiting graph cleanup.
acquireBinding.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
IGraphBindingLease with original value and idempotent release; absent, unready or undefined bindings throw GRAPH_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.
dispose: Immediately closes admission and queues final physical cleanup and binding release; terminal cleanup clears definitions. Final disposal waits behind admitted predecessors in the same FIFO without mutationAdmissionMs timeout.
One shared disposal Promise. Composition releaseBatch must honor the lease fence; releaseBinding failures are reported, while releaseBatch failures reject disposal.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content: Replace or suspend service bindings while preserving required-provider availability and consumer leases.

symbols.name: IDynamicCapabilityGraphOptions
symbols.purpose: Composition-owned callbacks for batch startup, lease-aware release and contained reporting.
symbols.core:
report: Receives original contained startup, release and late failure as error; return is ignored and own throws/rejections are contained.
Omitted: no external failure reporter is called.
Set it when contained startup, cleanup or late failures must reach monitoring. It receives the original error and does not replace graph results. Omission sends no external callback.
mutationAdmissionMs: Maximum queued wait before an ordinary mutation starts; finite nonnegative milliseconds only. Final dispose is exempt and waits for preceding admitted work in the same FIFO.
Omitted: the mutation queue has no admission deadline.
startBatch: Required callback receives topologically ordered IGraphStartEntry entries, each with id, binding and definition. Return one instance per entry in the same order, synchronously or by thenable. The owner must construct and roll back physical resources; throw/rejection becomes GRAPH_START_FAILED.
Always supply the physical startup owner. Return one instance for each entry, in the same order, and roll back partial resources if startup fails. There is no default; the graph does not execute definition.start for you.
releaseBatch: Required callback receives provider-first IGraphReleaseEntry entries and a Promise fence that resolves when sealed generation leases drain. Await the fence before physical teardown, release consumers first, and return void or completion thenable. Failure rejects the operation.
Always supply physical cleanup. Wait for fence, then release entries in reverse order so consumers stop before providers. There is no default, and a rejected cleanup rejects the operation.
releaseBinding: Receives an exact IGraphBindingReleaseEntry after successful instance cleanup for removal, replacement or disposal. Return void or completion thenable; failures are reported without replacing the primary result.
Omitted: graph relinquishes bindings without a composition release callback.
Set it when a composition binding owns something beyond the graph instance. It runs after instance cleanup on removal, replacement and final disposal. Omit it when relinquishing the binding needs no callback; failures go to report without stopping other bindings.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this type.

members.name: report
members.description: Receives contained startup, release, and late failures without replacing the primary graph result. Omitted by default; reporter failures reach the shared terminal reporting channel.

members.name: mutationAdmissionMs
members.description: Ordinary mutation queue budget; final dispose waits in the same FIFO without this admission timeout. Omitted means no admission deadline; provided values must be finite nonnegative milliseconds. The budget limits queue waiting, not the runtime of an admitted mutation.

members.name: startBatch
members.signature: readonly startBatch: (entries: readonly IGraphStartEntry<TBinding>[]) => readonly IGraphNodeInstance<unknown>[] | PromiseLike<readonly IGraphNodeInstance<unknown>[]>;
members.description: Required composition-owned startup for a provider-first frontier. Return one valid instance per entry in the same order, and own partial-start rollback if the batch fails. Graph does not invoke definition.start itself; an unattributable multi-node failure blocks the whole batch.
members.returns: (entries: readonly IGraphStartEntry<TBinding>[]) => readonly IGraphNodeInstance<unknown>[] | PromiseLike<readonly IGraphNodeInstance<unknown>[]>

members.name: releaseBatch
members.signature: readonly releaseBatch: (entries: readonly IGraphReleaseEntry<TBinding>[], fence: Promise<void>) => void | PromiseLike<void>;
members.description: Required physical cleanup owner. Entries arrive provider-first; await fence before cleanup and release in dependent-first order. Graph seals new leases, but this callback must honor the supplied fence and perform instance.release itself before resolving.
members.returns: (entries: readonly IGraphReleaseEntry<TBinding>[], fence: Promise<void>) => void | PromiseLike<void>

members.name: releaseBinding
members.description: Optional custody release after releaseBatch completes, for non-undefined bindings removed, replaced, or finally disposed. Failures are reported without stopping other custody releases.

symbols.name: buildCapabilityTopology
symbols.purpose: Snapshots a static node set and builds deterministic provider adjacency, schedule levels and order. Validate all required providers, dense ordinals and cycles before exposing the immutable projection.
symbols.core:
nodes: Required caller-authored array; every field is required with no default. `nodes[].id` is a unique nonempty string, `nodes[].ordinal` is a unique safe integer collectively covering 0 through nodeCount minus one, and `nodes[].dependencies` is an array (`[]` for none). Each dependency has a nonempty string `provider` and boolean `required`, with no duplicate provider within a node. `required: true` requires the provider to exist; `false` permits absence, while present optional edges still affect levels and cycles. Caller input is copied, not reordered.
onUnknownProvider: Required synchronous `(nodeId, provider) => never`, with no default. Both string arguments come from the caller’s node and missing required-provider edge. Must throw a caller-owned error, which propagates unchanged.
onCycle: Required synchronous `(path) => never`, with no default. The frozen string array is a closed cycle (first ID repeated last), rotated to its smallest registration ordinal. Must throw a caller-owned error.
onInvalid: Required synchronous `(reason, nodeId?, failure?) => never`, with no default. The `TopologyInvalidReason` domain is `invalid-node`, `duplicate-node`, `duplicate-edge`, `duplicate-ordinal`, `unknown-node`, `transaction-open` or `transaction-closed`; this static builder uses the first four structural reasons. Optional `nodeId` is the attributable caller ID, otherwise `undefined`; optional `failure` is `{ cause: unknown }` for a captured access error, otherwise `undefined`. Must throw. The boundary retains the original cause/errors without replacing the adapter-selected native error.
Deeply frozen ICapabilityTopology. Error adapters own failure construction; their errors propagate rather than being silently replaced.
parameters: nodes: readonly ITopologyNode[]
onUnknownProvider: (nodeId: string, provider: string) => never
onCycle: (path: readonly string[]) => never
onInvalid: ITopologySnapshotFailure

sections.content: Isolated copy-on-write topology view; commit or rollback closes it and restores base mutation authority.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import ITopologyTransaction from @migaia/capability/graph/topology, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use ITopologyTransaction when its type contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when ITopologyTransaction does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained type example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
size: Number of nodes currently present in this index or isolated transaction view.
has: Tests node membership without constructing a diagnostic.
has.id: Application-assigned id from a node admitted through index.add().
True when this view contains that node ID; false otherwise.
registrationOrdinal: Reads the stable registration ordinal owned by this index or open transaction; removals never renumber surviving nodes.
registrationOrdinal.id: Application-assigned id from a node admitted through index.add().
The admitted node’s ordinal. Unknown IDs invoke onInvalid. Unlike snapshot().ordinal, this number is not densely compacted after removals.
dependencies: Reads the frozen declared provider edges of one present node.
dependencies.id: Application-assigned id from a node admitted through index.add().
Provider edges in declaration order; an unknown node invokes onInvalid.
dependents: Reads present direct consumers split by required and optional edges.
dependents.id: Application-assigned id from a node admitted through index.add().
IGraphDependents containing registration-order required and optional consumer IDs.
missing: Reads declared provider edges whose providers are currently absent.
missing.id: Application-assigned id from a node admitted through index.add().
Frozen missing required and optional edges in declaration order; unknown consumers invoke onInvalid.
closure: Collects roots and their transitive required consumers, excluding optional propagation.
closure.roots: Application-selected IDs already admitted to this index; duplicates do not create duplicate work.
Frozen IDs in canonical provider-first order; unknown roots invoke onInvalid.
order: Orders all present nodes or a validated subset by dependency level and registration ordinal.
order.ids: Optional iterable of application-assigned admitted IDs; omitted selects all nodes.
Frozen, deduplicated canonical IDs; unknown subset IDs invoke onInvalid.
snapshot: Builds an immutable static projection with dense registration ordinals and read-only map facades.
ICapabilityTopology with ordered nodes, provider/consumer maps, indegree, level and ordinal.
add: Atomically adds a copied node and reconciles edges that previously named this missing provider.
add.node: Application-owned nonempty id and direct required/optional dependencies. The index assigns a stable internal registration ordinal.
No return value; the admitted topology update is complete.
remove: Removes one node while retaining consumers dangling provider facts for later reconciliation.
remove.id: Application-assigned id from a node admitted through index.add().
setDependencies: Atomically replaces direct dependencies and recomputes the affected topology; failed cycle admission leaves prior facts.
setDependencies.id: Application-assigned id from a node admitted through index.add().
setDependencies.dependencies: Application-created complete next provider-edge list, replacing all previous edges.
commit: Publishes overlay changes to the parent and closes the transaction.
No return value; later transaction use invokes onInvalid(transaction-closed).
rollback: Discards overlay changes and returns write authority to the unchanged parent.
No return value; repeated rollback or any transaction access after settlement invokes onInvalid(transaction-closed).

symbols.name: createEventChannel
symbols.purpose: Creates one in-process, synchronous event channel: an ordered list of listener registrations. `publish()` delivers a value to a snapshot of the current listeners; the `invoke*` functions use the same registrations when the publisher needs listener results. Options select how re-entrant publishes are ordered, whether duplicate listeners are merged, how much one publish may fan out, and optional method aliases.
symbols.core:
options: Channel options; every field is optional. See the options table.
The channel (`ICanonicalEventChannel`). With a `style` option it also has the alias methods of that style. Malformed options throw `INVALID_OPTIONS`; non-callable report/terminalReport uses `INVALID_REPORTER`, before construction.
report: Receives listener failures that happen after `publish()` has already returned: a Promise or thenable returned by a listener that rejects later, and value-path projection failures. Synchronous listener throws are not reported here; `publish()` throws them as `PUBLISH_FAILED`.
Not set: late failures go to `terminalReport`, then to the host error reporter.
Set a reporter when listeners return promises, such as saving a job. It receives late rejections and projection failures; synchronous throws still leave publish() as PUBLISH_FAILED. Without it, terminalReport handles these diagnostics.
terminalReport: Last diagnostic exit: receives a late failure when `report` is missing, throws, or returns a rejected thenable. It never changes publish results.
Not set: the failure is passed to the host `reportError` with code `UNHANDLED_LISTENER_FAILURE`.
Use a separate final sink when the main reporter can fail, for example when telemetry is offline. It receives failures missed by report; without it, the host diagnostic fallback receives them. It does not change publish() results.
dispatchPolicy: Decides what happens when a listener calls `publish()` while a publish is still running.
`EventDispatchPolicy.recursive`: the inner value is delivered immediately, before the outer publish continues.
Use queued when listeners publish follow-up events and every listener must finish the current value first. recursive delivers the nested value immediately. Omitting it selects recursive.
admissionPolicy: Decides whether subscribing the same listener function more than once creates separate registrations or reuses one.
`EventAdmissionPolicy.multiple`: every subscribe call creates its own registration.
Use unique when repeated setup calls must reuse the same listener and task label. multiple gives each call an independent registration and is the default. Different task labels are not merged.
removalPolicy: Decides how many registrations a subscription handle removes when it is called.
`handle`: the handle removes only the registration it created.
Use listener-all when releasing one handle must also remove other registrations of that function. handle removes only its own registration and is the default. This matters when admissionPolicy is multiple.
publishBudget: Maximum number of listener calls in one top-level synchronous publish, including calls caused by nested publishes. When the budget runs out the channel stops delivering and throws `PUBLISH_FAILED` when snapshot targets or nested values remain, with `processed` and `remaining` in `error.detail`, which stops runaway recursive publishing. Must be a positive safe integer.
`100_000` listener calls per top-level publish.
throwOnAborted: Decides what `subscribeUntil(channel, signal, listener)` does when `signal` is already aborted: return a no-op unsubscribe without registering, or throw.
`false`: no registration is made and a function that does nothing is returned.
Silently skip the registration.
Throw a `TypeError` with code `ABORTED`; use it when subscribing with a cancelled signal is a caller bug.
Use true when subscribing after cancellation is a caller error: subscribeUntil throws ABORTED. false and omission return a no-op handle without registering. Neither choice interrupts an already-running listener.
style: Adds alias method names for subscribe, publish and unsubscribe at construction time. Accepts a preset name (`on-emit`, `on-trigger`, `listen-fire`) or a custom name map checked with `as const satisfies IEventApiStyleNames`. The original methods stay available, and aliases refer to the same function objects, forwarding subscription delivery options unchanged. Changing style does not change listener order, delivery timing, error handling or unsubscribe behavior. Older examples may call defineEventApiStyle; that helper has been removed. Write custom names directly as an object and use the type check above to validate its fields while keeping the exact alias names for checking later method calls.
`subscribe-publish`: no aliases are added.
Default names only.
Adds `on`, `emit`, and `off` on handles.
Adds `on`, `trigger`, and `off` on handles.
Adds `listen`, `fire`, and `unlisten` on handles.
Choose the names your integration already uses: on-emit adds on/emit/off, on-trigger adds on/trigger/off, and listen-fire adds listen/fire/unlisten. A custom map supplies your own names. Omit it or use subscribe-publish for canonical names only; every choice preserves delivery and cancellation behavior.
valueConfig: Reads one fixed path of each published payload and attaches the result to context delivery under `alias`, so context listeners can read `event.<alias>` while `event.value` stays the original payload. Value delivery receives the original payload without adding an alias. The path is read once per publish. A missing, blocked or throwing path leaves the context alias `undefined` and reports `VALUE_PROJECTION_FAILED` through `report`; all listeners still run. An empty `readPath` disables it.
Not set: the context has no alias.
symbols.advanced:
A library exposes one lifecycle signal (`ready`, `closed`, `changed`) without string event names.
A job dispatcher names each handler with `taskId` and awaits exactly one of them with `invokeTask`.
Plugins register listeners and the host collects their async results in order with `invokeSerialSettled`.
Several named events share one owner: use `createEventHub()`.
Values must be transformed step by step: use `@migaia/middleware-pipeline`.

declaredConfiguration.name: report
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional reporter for late publish rejections and projection diagnostics; not synchronous listener throws.

declaredConfiguration.name: terminalReport
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional fallback when report is absent or fails; a failing/missing sink uses host diagnostics.

declaredConfiguration.name: dispatchPolicy
declaredConfiguration.description: Recursive (default) delivers nested values immediately; queued waits for the current snapshot.

declaredConfiguration.name: admissionPolicy
declaredConfiguration.description: Multiple (default) owns each subscription separately; unique shares one registration per listener identity.

declaredConfiguration.name: removalPolicy
declaredConfiguration.description: Handle (default) releases one registration; listener-all releases every registration of the same function.

declaredConfiguration.name: publishBudget
declaredConfiguration.description: Positive safe-integer listener-call limit per top-level synchronous publish; defaults to 100_000.

declaredConfiguration.name: throwOnAborted
declaredConfiguration.description: Opt in to throwing on already-aborted canonical-channel admission after owned cleanup; the default false returns a callable no-op unsubscribe without invoking listeners.

declaredConfiguration.name: style
declaredConfiguration.description: Naming preset or custom names; defaults to subscribe-publish, without adding default aliases.

declaredConfiguration.name: valueConfig
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional static path/alias for listener contexts. Omitted or blank paths leave projection disabled.

configuration.name: report
configuration.description: `report` — `undefined` — 接收 `{ event, error }`。主要处理同步 `publish()` 返回后的监听器拒绝，也接收值路径诊断；可以同步返回或返回 Promise。缺省时进入终端诊断。同步监听器抛错由 `publish()` 聚合，不交给它。
configuration.descriptionEn: Optional reporter for late publish rejections and projection diagnostics; not synchronous listener throws.
configuration.descriptionZh: `report` — `undefined` — 接收 `{ event, error }`。主要处理同步 `publish()` 返回后的监听器拒绝，也接收值路径诊断；可以同步返回或返回 Promise。缺省时进入终端诊断。同步监听器抛错由 `publish()` 聚合，不交给它。

configuration.name: terminalReport
configuration.description: `terminalReport` — `undefined` — 接收诊断错误；`report` 缺失、抛错或异步拒绝时使用。可以同步返回或返回 Promise，失败会继续交给宿主诊断。
configuration.descriptionEn: Optional fallback when report is absent or fails; a failing/missing sink uses host diagnostics.
configuration.descriptionZh: `terminalReport` — `undefined` — 接收诊断错误；`report` 缺失、抛错或异步拒绝时使用。可以同步返回或返回 Promise，失败会继续交给宿主诊断。

configuration.name: dispatchPolicy
configuration.description: `dispatchPolicy` — `'recursive'` — `'recursive'` 立即递归交付监听器内部的新发布；`'queued'` 等当前快照全部调用后再交付重入值。对应常量为 `EventDispatchPolicy.recursive`、`queued`。
configuration.descriptionEn: Recursive (default) delivers nested values immediately; queued waits for the current snapshot.

configuration.name: admissionPolicy
configuration.description: `admissionPolicy` — `'multiple'` — `'multiple'` 每次订阅创建独立登记；`'unique'` 按同一监听器函数的身份只保留一份登记。对应 `EventAdmissionPolicy.multiple`、`unique`。
configuration.descriptionEn: Multiple (default) owns each subscription separately; unique shares one registration per listener identity.

symbols.name: createEventHub
symbols.purpose: Creates a hub that routes several named events, each with its own payload type from the event map `C`. Each event name gets its own channel on first use. Hub channels always use recursive dispatch, multiple admission, handle removal, a budget of 100000 listener calls and non-throwing aborted admission; use `createEventChannel()` when those must be chosen.
symbols.core:
options: Hub options; every field is optional.
The hub (`IEventHub`, or `IStyledEventHub` with alias methods when `style` is set). Malformed options throw `INVALID_OPTIONS`; non-callable reporters use `INVALID_REPORTER`.
report: Receives listener failures that happen after `publish()` has already returned: a Promise or thenable returned by a listener that rejects later, together with the event `key`, and value-path projection failures. Synchronous listener throws are not reported here; `publish()` throws them as `PUBLISH_FAILED`.
Not set: late failures go to `terminalReport`, then to the host error reporter.
Set a reporter when listeners return promises, such as saving a job. It receives late rejections and projection failures; synchronous throws still leave publish() as PUBLISH_FAILED. Without it, terminalReport handles these diagnostics.
terminalReport: Last diagnostic exit: receives a late failure when `report` is missing, throws, or returns a rejected thenable. It never changes publish results.
Not set: the failure is passed to the host `reportError` with code `UNHANDLED_LISTENER_FAILURE`.
Use a separate final sink when the main reporter can fail, for example when telemetry is offline. It receives failures missed by report; without it, the host diagnostic fallback receives them. It does not change publish() results.
style: Adds alias method names for subscribe, publish and unsubscribe at construction time. Accepts a preset name (`on-emit`, `on-trigger`, `listen-fire`) or a custom name map checked with `as const satisfies IEventApiStyleNames`. The original methods stay available, and aliases refer to the same function objects, forwarding subscription delivery options unchanged. Changing style does not change listener order, delivery timing, error handling or unsubscribe behavior. Older examples may call defineEventApiStyle; that helper has been removed. Write custom names directly as an object and use the type check above to validate its fields while keeping the exact alias names for checking later method calls.
`subscribe-publish`: no aliases are added.
Default names only.
Adds `on`, `emit`, and `off` on handles.
Adds `on`, `trigger`, and `off` on handles.
Adds `listen`, `fire`, and `unlisten` on handles.
Choose the names your integration already uses: on-emit adds on/emit/off, on-trigger adds on/trigger/off, and listen-fire adds listen/fire/unlisten. A custom map supplies your own names. Omit it or use subscribe-publish for canonical names only; every choice preserves delivery and cancellation behavior.
valueConfig: Reads one fixed path of each published payload and attaches the result to context delivery under `alias`, so context listeners can read `event.<alias>` while `event.value` stays the original payload. Value delivery receives the original payload without adding an alias. The path is read once per publish. A missing, blocked or throwing path leaves the context alias `undefined` and reports `VALUE_PROJECTION_FAILED` through `report`; all listeners still run. An empty `readPath` disables it.
Not set: the context has no alias.

symbols.purpose: Values for the `admissionPolicy` option of `createEventChannel()`: whether subscribing the same listener function twice creates two registrations or reuses one.
symbols.core:
multiple: Default. Every `subscribe()` creates its own registration, even for the same function; each handle removes only its own one.
unique: One function keeps at most one registration per channel. Subscribing it again returns a handle bound to the existing registration; the `taskId` and delivery must then be the same, otherwise `INVALID_OPTIONS` is thrown. Omitted delivery equals explicit context. Only the first of several such handles removes it.

blocks.text: `EventApiStyle` 导出四个预设：`subscribePublish`、`onEmit`、`onTrigger`、`listenFire`。需要跨模块比较或保存配置时使用这些常量。

自定义 `style` 是从语义到名字的对象，例如 `{ subscribe: 'observe', publish: 'dispatch', unsubscribe: 'dispose' }`。`style.subscribe` 和 `style.publish` 必填；`style.unsubscribe` 省略时为 `'unsubscribe'`。名字必须是非空字符串、彼此不同，不能占用另一语义的名字、`subscribeOnce`、`subscribeUntil`、`filterTaskId`、`clear`、`size` 或 `__proto__`、`prototype`、`constructor`。非法配置在构造时抛 `INVALID_OPTIONS`。
保留字面量配置可用 `as const satisfies IEventApiStyleNames`。显式给出 payload 类型后，自定义 channel style 也要在第三泛型 `S` 中提供；Hub 在第二泛型提供。宽化成普通 `string` 的对象不会产生任意方法名的索引签名。预设字面量有对应的推导重载。
canonical（固定的原名）方法始终存在；别名与原名指向同一函数，不创建另一个派发器。默认风格不增加别名属性；额外别名是不可枚举、不可写、不可配置的自有数据属性。style 不增加 `flush`、队列、排空、背压或跨进程能力。

`channel.subscribe()` 返回 `IEventChannelSubscription`，`hub.subscribe()` 返回 `IEventHubSubscription`。句柄本身可调用，`handle.unsubscribe === handle`；链式 `handle.subscribe(...)` 返回同一条链，风格的订阅别名与取消别名也保持函数身份。通道及句柄的 `subscribe`/订阅别名均接受 `taskId`、delivery 选项；Hub 及句柄的 `subscribe(key, listener, options?)`/订阅别名只接受 delivery，不接受 `taskId`。取消按追加顺序的逆序执行整条链，只真正执行一次。单个释放失败原样抛出；多个失败合为 `SUBSCRIPTION_DISPOSE_FAILED`，`AggregateError.errors` 保留执行顺序。关闭后追加订阅抛 `SUBSCRIPTION_CLOSED`。
链式扩展不是事务：后一次订阅失败时，前面成功的登记仍归原句柄所有，需要调用该句柄清理。第一条登记之后的句柄别名投影失败，则回滚该登记并以 `SUBSCRIPTION_HANDLE_PROJECTION_FAILED` 保留原始失败。有限字面量事件表在同一条 Hub 链上排除已经使用的 key；同 key 的另一条独立链仍可订阅。宽 key、索引签名或运行时联合 key 保留动态广播。

symbols.name: EventSubscriberErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Every error code this package can throw or report. Errors keep their native type (`TypeError`, `AggregateError`) and carry `source` and `code`; branch on `code` instead of the message.
symbols.core:
invalidListener: `INVALID_LISTENER`: a listener is not a function. Reporter validation uses `INVALID_REPORTER`.
invalidReporter: `INVALID_REPORTER`: `report` or `terminalReport` is not a function. Pass a function or omit it.
invalidChannel: `INVALID_CHANNEL`: an `invoke*` function received an object that is not a channel from `createEventChannel()` (or comes from another package copy).
invalidSignal: `INVALID_SIGNAL`: the value passed as signal is not a valid AbortSignal. Pass a real signal.
aborted: `ABORTED`: `subscribeUntil` got an already-aborted signal on a channel with `throwOnAborted: true`.
invalidSubscriber: `INVALID_SUBSCRIBER`: the object passed to `subscribeSubscriber` has no callable `handle`.
invalidEventKey: `INVALID_EVENT_KEY`: a hub event name is not a string, number or symbol.
taskNotFound: `TASK_NOT_FOUND`: `invokeTask` found no registration with that taskId. Check the name or the registration lifetime.
taskNotUnique: `TASK_NOT_UNIQUE`: `invokeTask` found several registrations with that taskId; the error has `taskId` and `matchCount`.
invalidTaskId: `INVALID_TASK_ID`: a taskId is empty or not a string.
invalidOptions: `INVALID_OPTIONS`: an options object or one of its fields is malformed.
publishFailed: `PUBLISH_FAILED`: listeners failed, or the publish budget left snapshot targets or queued values undelivered. Budget details carry processed calls and remaining call budget.
visitorFailed: `VISITOR_FAILED`: a snapshot/live visitor threw or rejected. Native errors keep identity when annotatable; conflicting, immutable or primitive failures, including undefined, remain on cause after invocations close.
valueProjectionFailed: `VALUE_PROJECTION_FAILED`: the `valueConfig` path was missing, blocked or threw; reported, the listener still runs.
unhandledListenerFailure: `UNHANDLED_LISTENER_FAILURE`: a late listener failure reached terminal diagnostics because `report` was missing or failed.
subscriptionClosed: `SUBSCRIPTION_CLOSED`: `handle.subscribe(...)` was called on a released handle.
subscriptionHandleProjectionFailed: `SUBSCRIPTION_HANDLE_PROJECTION_FAILED`: building the alias methods of a handle failed; the registration is rolled back.
invocationClosed: `INVOCATION_CLOSED`: an invocation was called twice or after its visitor finished.
subscriptionDisposeFailed: `SUBSCRIPTION_DISPOSE_FAILED`: releasing a chain ran every disposer and more than one failed; the failures are in `errors` in run order.

blocks.text: `publish()` 收集全部同步监听器失败后抛带 `PUBLISH_FAILED` 的 `AggregateError`；监听器返回的 Promise 在它返回后拒绝，则交给 `report`。同步发布不会因为迟到失败变成可等待的调用。
`report` 不存在或失败时，先尝试 `terminalReport`，再依次尝试宿主 `reportError`、`console.error`、排入微任务抛出；宿主不能排入微任务时同步抛出。报告函数本身的失败也保留在诊断错误链上，不静默丢弃。

包级错误的 `source` 为 `EVENT_SUBSCRIBER_SOURCE`，值是 `'@migaia/event-subscriber'`。输入校验保留原生 `TypeError`，发布聚合保留 `AggregateError`。原始失败通过 `errors` 与 `cause` 可达；存在监听器失败时，`cause` 是第一个失败。只有预算耗尽时，`errors` 可以为空。业务代码比较 `EventSubscriberErrorCode` 的成员，不散写码值。`EventSubscriberErrorText` 是内部文案表，不是公开导出，业务代码不能导入；锁定文案时断言实际错误的 `message`。

blocks.text: `EventApiStyle` 导出四个预设：`subscribePublish`、`onEmit`、`onTrigger`、`listenFire`。需要跨模块比较或保存配置时使用这些常量。

自定义 `style` 是从语义到名字的对象，例如 `{ subscribe: 'observe', publish: 'dispatch', unsubscribe: 'dispose' }`。`style.subscribe` 和 `style.publish` 必填；`style.unsubscribe` 省略时为 `'unsubscribe'`。名字必须是非空字符串、彼此不同，不能占用另一语义的名字、`subscribeOnce`、`subscribeUntil`、`filterTaskId`、`clear`、`size` 或 `__proto__`、`prototype`、`constructor`。非法配置在构造时抛 `INVALID_OPTIONS`。
保留字面量配置可用 `as const satisfies IEventApiStyleNames`。显式给出 payload 类型后，自定义 channel style 也要在第三泛型 `S` 中提供；Hub 在第二泛型提供。宽化成普通 `string` 的对象不会产生任意方法名的索引签名。预设字面量有对应的推导重载。
canonical（固定的原名）方法始终存在；别名与原名指向同一函数，不创建另一个派发器。默认风格不增加别名属性；额外别名是不可枚举、不可写、不可配置的自有数据属性。style 不增加 `flush`、队列、排空、背压或跨进程能力。

`channel.subscribe()` 返回 `IEventChannelSubscription`，`hub.subscribe()` 返回 `IEventHubSubscription`。句柄本身可调用，`handle.unsubscribe === handle`；链式 `handle.subscribe(...)` 返回同一条链，风格的订阅别名与取消别名也保持函数身份。通道及句柄的 `subscribe`/订阅别名均接受 `taskId`、delivery 选项；Hub 及句柄的 `subscribe(key, listener, options?)`/订阅别名只接受 delivery，不接受 `taskId`。取消按追加顺序的逆序执行整条链，只真正执行一次。单个释放失败原样抛出；多个失败合为 `SUBSCRIPTION_DISPOSE_FAILED`，`AggregateError.errors` 保留执行顺序。关闭后追加订阅抛 `SUBSCRIPTION_CLOSED`。
链式扩展不是事务：后一次订阅失败时，前面成功的登记仍归原句柄所有，需要调用该句柄清理。第一条登记之后的句柄别名投影失败，则回滚该登记并以 `SUBSCRIPTION_HANDLE_PROJECTION_FAILED` 保留原始失败。有限字面量事件表在同一条 Hub 链上排除已经使用的 key；同 key 的另一条独立链仍可订阅。宽 key、索引签名或运行时联合 key 保留动态广播。

symbols.name: IEventChannel
symbols.purpose: The methods of every channel: subscribe, publish, select by task, clear, and count registrations. `createEventChannel()` returns this surface (as `ICanonicalEventChannel`).
symbols.core:
subscribe: Registers `listener` and returns a subscription handle. Calling the handle (or `handle.unsubscribe()`) removes the registration; `handle.subscribe(...)` adds another registration to the same chain, and releasing the chain removes all of them in reverse order.
subscribe.listener: Function called with the event context by default (`event.value`, `event.abort()`, `event.taskId`), or the original payload when `delivery: EventDelivery.value` is explicit. Its return value is collected by the `invoke*` helpers in either mode.
subscribe.options: `taskId` optionally gives this registration a non-empty name for `filterTaskId()` and `invokeTask()`, including value delivery. `delivery` defaults to `EventDelivery.context`; explicit `EventDelivery.value` selects a payload listener. Options type: `IEventSubscribeOptions`.
A callable, idempotent handle. Extending a handle after it was released throws `SUBSCRIPTION_CLOSED`.
Long-lived listeners. For one delivery use `subscribeOnce`; for a listener tied to an AbortSignal use `subscribeUntil`.
publish: Delivers `value` synchronously to the current listener snapshot in registration order, within `publishBudget`. Promises returned by listeners are not awaited; their later rejections go to `report`. A listener that publishes again is delivered recursively by default, or after the snapshot when `dispatchPolicy` is `queued`.
publish.value: Payload delivered as `event.value` in context mode, or directly in value mode, with its original identity.
Nothing. Ordinary synchronous listener failures are collected and thrown together as an `AggregateError` with code `PUBLISH_FAILED` after the snapshot completes. If `publishBudget` is exhausted, delivery stops early and throws `PUBLISH_FAILED`; some listeners may not have run.
Notifications where the publisher does not need listener results. To wait for results use `invokeParallel`, `invokeSerial` or `invokeTask`.
filterTaskId: Creates a read-only view that selects only registrations whose `taskId` equals `taskId`. The view cannot subscribe or publish; pass it to an `invoke*` helper.
filterTaskId.taskId: The name given at subscription: `channel.subscribe(listener, { taskId })`.
An `IFilteredEventChannel` view. Selection happens when a helper runs, so later registrations with the same taskId are included.
Several registrations share one taskId and all of them must run. When exactly one must match, call `invokeTask`, which rejects zero or several matches.
clear: Removes every current registration without calling listeners. With the default `removalPolicy: "handle"`, old handles cannot remove later registrations. With `removalPolicy: "listener-all"` and multiple admission, an unused old handle can still remove current registrations of the same listener after clear; unique admission keeps handles bound to their original registration.
Nothing; after the call `size` is `0`.
The owner of the channel shuts down. A single consumer should call its own handle instead.
size: Number of active registrations right now. Duplicate subscriptions of one listener count separately unless `admissionPolicy` is `unique`.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this type.

blocks.text: `EventApiStyle` 导出四个预设：`subscribePublish`、`onEmit`、`onTrigger`、`listenFire`。需要跨模块比较或保存配置时使用这些常量。

自定义 `style` 是从语义到名字的对象，例如 `{ subscribe: 'observe', publish: 'dispatch', unsubscribe: 'dispose' }`。`style.subscribe` 和 `style.publish` 必填；`style.unsubscribe` 省略时为 `'unsubscribe'`。名字必须是非空字符串、彼此不同，不能占用另一语义的名字、`subscribeOnce`、`subscribeUntil`、`filterTaskId`、`clear`、`size` 或 `__proto__`、`prototype`、`constructor`。非法配置在构造时抛 `INVALID_OPTIONS`。
保留字面量配置可用 `as const satisfies IEventApiStyleNames`。显式给出 payload 类型后，自定义 channel style 也要在第三泛型 `S` 中提供；Hub 在第二泛型提供。宽化成普通 `string` 的对象不会产生任意方法名的索引签名。预设字面量有对应的推导重载。
canonical（固定的原名）方法始终存在；别名与原名指向同一函数，不创建另一个派发器。默认风格不增加别名属性；额外别名是不可枚举、不可写、不可配置的自有数据属性。style 不增加 `flush`、队列、排空、背压或跨进程能力。

`channel.subscribe()` 返回 `IEventChannelSubscription`，`hub.subscribe()` 返回 `IEventHubSubscription`。句柄本身可调用，`handle.unsubscribe === handle`；链式 `handle.subscribe(...)` 返回同一条链，风格的订阅别名与取消别名也保持函数身份。通道及句柄的 `subscribe`/订阅别名均接受 `taskId`、delivery 选项；Hub 及句柄的 `subscribe(key, listener, options?)`/订阅别名只接受 delivery，不接受 `taskId`。取消按追加顺序的逆序执行整条链，只真正执行一次。单个释放失败原样抛出；多个失败合为 `SUBSCRIPTION_DISPOSE_FAILED`，`AggregateError.errors` 保留执行顺序。关闭后追加订阅抛 `SUBSCRIPTION_CLOSED`。
链式扩展不是事务：后一次订阅失败时，前面成功的登记仍归原句柄所有，需要调用该句柄清理。第一条登记之后的句柄别名投影失败，则回滚该登记并以 `SUBSCRIPTION_HANDLE_PROJECTION_FAILED` 保留原始失败。有限字面量事件表在同一条 Hub 链上排除已经使用的 key；同 key 的另一条独立链仍可订阅。宽 key、索引签名或运行时联合 key 保留动态广播。

blocks.text: `EventApiStyle` 导出四个预设：`subscribePublish`、`onEmit`、`onTrigger`、`listenFire`。需要跨模块比较或保存配置时使用这些常量。

自定义 `style` 是从语义到名字的对象，例如 `{ subscribe: 'observe', publish: 'dispatch', unsubscribe: 'dispose' }`。`style.subscribe` 和 `style.publish` 必填；`style.unsubscribe` 省略时为 `'unsubscribe'`。名字必须是非空字符串、彼此不同，不能占用另一语义的名字、`subscribeOnce`、`subscribeUntil`、`filterTaskId`、`clear`、`size` 或 `__proto__`、`prototype`、`constructor`。非法配置在构造时抛 `INVALID_OPTIONS`。
保留字面量配置可用 `as const satisfies IEventApiStyleNames`。显式给出 payload 类型后，自定义 channel style 也要在第三泛型 `S` 中提供；Hub 在第二泛型提供。宽化成普通 `string` 的对象不会产生任意方法名的索引签名。预设字面量有对应的推导重载。
canonical（固定的原名）方法始终存在；别名与原名指向同一函数，不创建另一个派发器。默认风格不增加别名属性；额外别名是不可枚举、不可写、不可配置的自有数据属性。style 不增加 `flush`、队列、排空、背压或跨进程能力。

`channel.subscribe()` 返回 `IEventChannelSubscription`，`hub.subscribe()` 返回 `IEventHubSubscription`。句柄本身可调用，`handle.unsubscribe === handle`；链式 `handle.subscribe(...)` 返回同一条链，风格的订阅别名与取消别名也保持函数身份。通道及句柄的 `subscribe`/订阅别名均接受 `taskId`、delivery 选项；Hub 及句柄的 `subscribe(key, listener, options?)`/订阅别名只接受 delivery，不接受 `taskId`。取消按追加顺序的逆序执行整条链，只真正执行一次。单个释放失败原样抛出；多个失败合为 `SUBSCRIPTION_DISPOSE_FAILED`，`AggregateError.errors` 保留执行顺序。关闭后追加订阅抛 `SUBSCRIPTION_CLOSED`。
链式扩展不是事务：后一次订阅失败时，前面成功的登记仍归原句柄所有，需要调用该句柄清理。第一条登记之后的句柄别名投影失败，则回滚该登记并以 `SUBSCRIPTION_HANDLE_PROJECTION_FAILED` 保留原始失败。有限字面量事件表在同一条 Hub 链上排除已经使用的 key；同 key 的另一条独立链仍可订阅。宽 key、索引签名或运行时联合 key 保留动态广播。

symbols.purpose: Options of `createEventHub()`. Dispatch, admission, removal, budget and aborted-signal behaviour are fixed for hubs; only reporting, method aliases and the value alias can be set.
symbols.core:
report: Receives listener failures that happen after `publish()` has already returned: a Promise or thenable returned by a listener that rejects later, together with the event `key`, and value-path projection failures. Synchronous listener throws are not reported here; `publish()` throws them as `PUBLISH_FAILED`.
Not set: late failures go to `terminalReport`, then to the host error reporter.
Set a reporter when listeners return promises, such as saving a job. It receives late rejections and projection failures; synchronous throws still leave publish() as PUBLISH_FAILED. Without it, terminalReport handles these diagnostics.
terminalReport: Last diagnostic exit: receives a late failure when `report` is missing, throws, or returns a rejected thenable. It never changes publish results.
Not set: the failure is passed to the host `reportError` with code `UNHANDLED_LISTENER_FAILURE`.

style: Adds alias method names for subscribe, publish and unsubscribe at construction time. Accepts a preset name (`on-emit`, `on-trigger`, `listen-fire`) or a custom name map checked with `as const satisfies IEventApiStyleNames`. The original methods stay available, and aliases refer to the same function objects, forwarding subscription delivery options unchanged. Changing style does not change listener order, delivery timing, error handling or unsubscribe behavior. Older examples may call defineEventApiStyle; that helper has been removed. Write custom names directly as an object and use the type check above to validate its fields while keeping the exact alias names for checking later method calls.
`subscribe-publish`: no aliases are added.
Default names only.
Adds `on`, `emit`, and `off` on handles.
Adds `on`, `trigger`, and `off` on handles.
Adds `listen`, `fire`, and `unlisten` on handles.
Choose the names your integration already uses: on-emit adds on/emit/off, on-trigger adds on/trigger/off, and listen-fire adds listen/fire/unlisten. A custom map supplies your own names. Omit it or use subscribe-publish for canonical names only; every choice preserves delivery and cancellation behavior.
valueConfig: Reads one fixed path of each published payload and attaches the result to context delivery under `alias`, so context listeners can read `event.<alias>` while `event.value` stays the original payload. symbols.name: invokeEachLive
symbols.purpose: Low-level synchronous traversal for framework integrations: hands admitted registrations to `visitor` as invocations, each at most once. Appended registrations may join while no registration has been removed or cleared during the traversal. After a removal or clear, later appends are no longer admitted, but already admitted pending entries are still visited. The visitor must finish synchronously. A visitor failure receives `VISITOR_FAILED`; native identity is retained where possible, otherwise the original, including undefined, remains on `cause`. Ordinary publishing should use the snapshot-based `invoke*` functions, whose target set cannot change while they run.

value: Payload passed to every selected listener as `event.value`.
visitor: Called once per registration with an invocation object; call `invocation.invoke()` to run that listener.

blocks.text: `EventApiStyle` 导出四个预设：`subscribePublish`、`onEmit`、`onTrigger`、`listenFire`。需要跨模块比较或保存配置时使用这些常量。

自定义 `style` 是从语义到名字的对象，例如 `{ subscribe: 'observe', publish: 'dispatch', unsubscribe: 'dispose' }`。`style.subscribe` 和 `style.publish` 必填；`style.unsubscribe` 省略时为 `'unsubscribe'`。名字必须是非空字符串、彼此不同，不能占用另一语义的名字、`subscribeOnce`、`subscribeUntil`、`filterTaskId`、`clear`、`size` 或 `__proto__`、`prototype`、`constructor`。非法配置在构造时抛 `INVALID_OPTIONS`。
保留字面量配置可用 `as const satisfies IEventApiStyleNames`。显式给出 payload 类型后，自定义 channel style 也要在第三泛型 `S` 中提供；Hub 在第二泛型提供。宽化成普通 `string` 的对象不会产生任意方法名的索引签名。预设字面量有对应的推导重载。
canonical（固定的原名）方法始终存在；别名与原名指向同一函数，不创建另一个派发器。默认风格不增加别名属性；额外别名是不可枚举、不可写、不可配置的自有数据属性。style 不增加 `flush`、队列、排空、背压或跨进程能力。

`channel.subscribe()` 返回 `IEventChannelSubscription`，`hub.subscribe()` 返回 `IEventHubSubscription`。句柄本身可调用，`handle.unsubscribe === handle`；链式 `handle.subscribe(...)` 返回同一条链，风格的订阅别名与取消别名也保持函数身份。通道及句柄的 `subscribe`/订阅别名均接受 `taskId`、delivery 选项；Hub 及句柄的 `subscribe(key, listener, options?)`/订阅别名只接受 delivery，不接受 `taskId`。取消按追加顺序的逆序执行整条链，只真正执行一次。单个释放失败原样抛出；多个失败合为 `SUBSCRIPTION_DISPOSE_FAILED`，`AggregateError.errors` 保留执行顺序。关闭后追加订阅抛 `SUBSCRIPTION_CLOSED`。
链式扩展不是事务：后一次订阅失败时，前面成功的登记仍归原句柄所有，需要调用该句柄清理。第一条登记之后的句柄别名投影失败，则回滚该登记并以 `SUBSCRIPTION_HANDLE_PROJECTION_FAILED` 保留原始失败。有限字面量事件表在同一条 Hub 链上排除已经使用的 key；同 key 的另一条独立链仍可订阅。宽 key、索引签名或运行时联合 key 保留动态广播。

symbols.purpose: Subscribes a listener that is removed automatically when `signal` aborts. Aborting only stops future deliveries; a listener that is already running is not interrupted. symbols.name: abortableDelay
symbols.purpose: Waits a finite nonnegative duration while observing an optional cancellation signal. The timer and listener are owned by this call and cleaned before settlement; cancellation is a boolean outcome rather than an exception.
symbols.core:
scheduler: Caller-selected `IScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`; supply an admitted scheduler when injecting external methods.
ms: Finite nonnegative delay in milliseconds, chosen by the caller; invalid values throw `INVALID_OPTION` before registration.
signal: An `IAbortSignal` from a controller or parent operation, or `undefined` for no cancellation. An already-aborted signal returns false without scheduling.
reportCleanup: Optional synchronous `(error) => void` sink receiving coded cleanup failures. Return no value; throws and rejections are contained. Omitted cleanup failures reject the wait.
`Promise<boolean>`: true for elapsed duration, false for cancellation. Admission or unreported cleanup failure rejects with `DELAY_FAILED` while retaining the original cause.
parameters: scheduler: IScheduler
ms: number
signal: IAbortSignal | undefined
reportCleanup: (error: unknown) => void (optional)
symbols.returns: Promise<boolean>
overloadSignatures: export declare function abortableDelay(scheduler: IScheduler, ms: number, signal: IAbortSignal | undefined, reportCleanup?: (error: unknown) => void): Promise<boolean>;

symbols.name: boundedWait
symbols.purpose: Observes one task until an existing absolute deadline without cancelling that task. A task rejection before timeout stays primary even if timer cancellation fails: secondary cleanup is attached through cause/errors. Synchronous timer completion waits for its handle before settling, cancels once, and applies the same cleanup policy. Late rejection remains observed.
symbols.core:
task: Caller-owned `PromiseLike<unknown>` from the operation being bounded; this helper never cancels it.
deadlineAt: Finite absolute deadline derived from the selected scheduler’s `now()`, in that same clock domain.
options: Optional scheduler and cleanup-reporter fields described below; omission uses the system clock and rejects cleanup failures.
A promise resolving true for task fulfillment or false for timeout; an already passed deadline returns false. Task and scheduler failures can reject without replacing their original identity.
scheduler: Clock and timer implementation from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`. Supply the same scheduler that produced every absolute deadline; lifecycle snapshots methods with their original receiver and rejects invalid shapes with `INVALID_OPTION`.
Omitted: use the admitted `systemScheduler` when a timed phase first needs it.
reportCleanup: Receives the raw timer-cancellation `error`; return void synchronously. Reporter throws and rejections are contained so the original task/deadline winner remains the result.
reportCleanup.error: Original failure or coded diagnostic supplied by the current lifecycle operation.
No value is consumed; callback failures do not replace the operation result.
Omitted: timer cancellation failure rejects the wait.
Set it when timer cleanup failure should be observed without replacing the winning task or deadline result. Without it, timer cleanup failure rejects the wait.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.
examples: const won = await boundedWait(task, deadlineAt) // true=task 先完成；false=截止时间先到（task 仍在跑）
overloadSignatures: export declare const boundedWait: (task: PromiseLike<unknown>, deadlineAt: number, options?: { scheduler?: IScheduler; reportCleanup?: (error: unknown) => void; }) => Promise<boolean>;

symbols.name: createMutationQueue
symbols.purpose: Serializes caller-authored mutations in submission order. Only waiting tasks receive an admission timer; the current task is never interrupted, and a labeled same-owner submission is rejected to avoid a self-dependent successor.
symbols.core:
An `IMutationQueue`; tasks settle independently and a failed task does not stop later submissions.
queueAdmissionTimeoutMs: Per-waiting-task admission budget: a number rejects and removes an overdue task, false disables timers, and undefined permits diagnostics without rejection.
`undefined`: diagnose only and never reject for admission delay.
Disable rejection and diagnostic timers for queued admission.
Use milliseconds to reject an overdue waiting task. false disables rejection and diagnostic timers; undefined, the default, allows diagnostics without rejecting. Running tasks are never interrupted.
admissionDiagnosticMs: Diagnostic delay used only when admission timeout is undefined and a diagnostic callback exists; false disables the diagnostic timer.
`1000` milliseconds: emit one diagnostic while a task remains queued.
Disable diagnostic scheduling while retaining unlimited admission waiting.
Set milliseconds to change the default 1000 ms queue warning threshold, or false to disable it. It applies only with undefined admission timeout and an onAdmissionDiagnostic callback; it never rejects work.
onAdmissionDiagnostic: Synchronous `(info) => void` notification with caller-issued `info.owner` and elapsed `info.waitedMs` from the scheduler clock. The return is ignored; synchronous throws and accidental async rejections are contained.
onAdmissionDiagnostic.info: Queue-issued record containing the submitted owner label and observed wait duration in milliseconds.
No value is consumed and callback failure does not change queue results.
Omitted: no diagnostic callback or diagnostic-only timer is installed.
Set it to observe the owner and elapsed wait without rejecting the queued task. Without it no diagnostic-only timer is installed. Callback failures are contained.
scheduler: Clock and timer implementation from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`. Supply the same scheduler that produced every absolute deadline; lifecycle snapshots methods with their original receiver and rejects invalid shapes with `INVALID_OPTION`.
Omitted: use the admitted `systemScheduler` when a timed phase first needs it.
parameters: options: IMutationQueueOptions (optional)
symbols.returns: IMutationQueue

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Serializes caller-authored mutations in submission order. Only waiting tasks receive an admission timer; the current task is never interrupted, and a labeled same-owner submission is rejected to avoid a self-dependent successor.
