blocks.text: PluginHostError 继承 Error，携带只读 source、code、可选 detail；source 为 `@migaia/plugin-host`，原始失败通过 cause/errors 可达。可写 native 回调错误原位附身份，不可写或非 Error 值保留在 cause，完整外包身份保留原 owner。INVALID_OPTION 形状错误保留 TypeError；配置值与循环错误是 PluginHostError。不要仅按类名处理所有错误，也不要解析诊断文案。

安装主错不被回滚失败覆盖。PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED.detail 包含 failedName、按回滚顺序的 rollbackErrors；异步 use 的 detail 已完成且冻结，同步 useSync 先公布冻结快照，通过 detail.completion 返回最终冻结详情。需要完整次错身份的转换应先 await completion。回滚失败另报 PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED。

diagnostic 的第三参数保留原失败身份；诊断回调自身失败不会改变 Host 控制流，而交给 onDiagnosticFailure，再失败或省略时交给宿主存在的 globalThis.reportError。Node 需要这类观测时显式提供 onDiagnosticFailure。PluginHostStatus 为 active/closing/disposed；PluginHostRegistrationLifecycle 为 idle/install/dispose。ERROR_TEXT 是根命名导出的稳定英文消息表，MiddlewarePipelineMode/Violation 属于 middleware-pipeline。
`PluginHostDisposalNodeKind` 区分清理错误、聚合及 disposer 包装；`readPluginHostDisposalProvenance(error)` 只读取本物理包登记的追溯信息，未知错误或重复包副本返回 undefined，不按形状猜测。它用于诊断，不替代 source/code/cause 分类。

必需 provider 不可用使插件挂起，先恢复依赖。
lazy 插件未激活，先 await activate。
请求了未声明的 Feature 名称。
必需 provider 从未安装，安装前直接拒绝。
必需 provider 已禁用，启用后重试。

Feature 跨插件引用成环，任何 install 前拒绝。

替换候选名称不同，未安装候选。
新 provider 已提交但依赖者重装失败，cause.errors 首项为重装失败。
退役或不支持的定义字段、非法依赖或非 canonical core，保留 TypeError。
安装/发布失败，原错在 cause，回滚详情保留次错。
即时 useSync 安装遇到 setup，改用异步 use。

install 结果自带 then，或同步路径得到异步结果，不发布此扩展。
beforeRelease 或插件释放步骤失败，cause 保留原错，其余清理继续。
扩展键已占用，Host 保留键优先分类为 EXTENSION_RESERVED。
扩展使用 Host 协议键、then 或清理 symbol。
仅诊断：有意忽略非枚举扩展键。
core 在安装窗口外拒绝且不接管；setup 关闭后的有效资源先释放再拒绝。
生命周期同步重入，或 setup / beforeRelease 等待期发起变更，不能执行。
构造时 mode 非四种合法值。
stage 无法提升到 Host 模式，cause 保留上游 TypeError。
同次 stage 重复调用 next，不重复派发。
仅诊断：stage 已结束后调用 next，忽略此调用。
管线执行期间注册新 stage。
async 双失败，AggregateError.errors 固定为 stage、downstream。
已配置准入期限且排队到限，任务移出并不再执行。
beforeRelease 或普通释放步骤超预算，结束等待并继续清理，不强行取消。
入参形状不合法，保留原生 TypeError，修正输入。
配置不满足普通数据语法，detail 含 path/reason。
配置含引用环，提供无环值图。
未分类配置、surface 读取或 defineHost disposal 回调失败；保留原错或 cause。
hook 执行到限，丧失提交权限，迟到结果不能提交。
已取出的扩展属于已卸载或替换的旧注册。
普通卸载排空超预算，ok false，继续有界清理并诊断。
逻辑关闭已提交，清理有错或仍未完成；读取结果与 continuation。
组合目标非本物理包登记的 Host，不做结构兼容。

symbols.name: PluginHostStatus
symbols.purpose: Lifecycle status of a host: `active` (accepts changes), `closing` (disposal started) and `disposed` (terminal).
symbols.core:
active: `active`: accepts installs, removals and config updates.
closing: `closing`: disposal started; new changes are refused.
disposed: disposed is terminal for work admission and protected capabilities. Identity, revision, plugin.disabled() and the composition revision remain readable for diagnostics.

members.description: Accepts new operations; existing registrations can publish through their normal guards.

blocks.text: 稳定错误码表，18 个码，唯一声明处 `src/error-code.ts`，`source` 恒为 `'@migaia/reactive'`。（迁移背景：原属于本包的 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE`/`SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`/`GENERATION_DISPOSED`/`SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 五个码已随生命周期原语迁出，归属 `@migaia/lifecycle`，不在本表。）

rows: 未分类 action/batch/untracked/tracked derivation callback 失败；native 尽量原位附码，primitive（含 undefined）/不可变 native 原错保留 cause，已有 semantic identity 不变；非 Error 对象 throw 保留控制身份，供 Resource/Suspense owner 单次准入
在已 dispose 的 `Signal`/`Computed`/自定义 Source 上调用读取或写入方法
求值 `Computed` 时检测到它（直接或间接）读取了自己正在求值的结果
一个属于某 `Runtime` 的节点或已登记函数对象在另一个 `Runtime` 的追踪/所有权边界上被读取、订阅或校验
传入的对象不是由 `createRuntime()` 创建、或不携带内部所有权登记
同一个对象或函数引用被重复登记到不同的 `Runtime`
检测到本库存在多份运行时副本、查询到另一副本已登记的对象或函数，或 `assertSingleRuntimeCopy()` 校验到副本数大于一
跨副本诊断品牌被发现处于非预期形状
单调版本时钟达到配置上限（默认 `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`）后再次申请新版本号
一次冲刷内的重算轮数超过 `maxFlushPasses`（默认 100）
一次冲刷中多个 observer 的 `tick()` 失败、或多个 observable 生命周期钩子失败，作为 `AggregateError` 外壳
`runBatched()` 内业务动作与收尾 flush 同时失败；普通可写错误在 `cause` 附加聚合结果，不可读 `cause` 的三个原值直接置于 `AggregateError.errors`
预留：异步调度策略回调或 `reportError()` 捕获到未处理错误的诊断通道码（默认无内置抛出/上报点）
`capture()` 产生的 token 在 `commitCapture()` 时已失效、已被消费、属于另一个 tracker，或对应 observer 已 dispose
同一个 `IObserverBinding` 被重复调用 `observe()`（已处于 observed 状态）
source/observer binding尝试替换已有graph node的集合，须创建新节点
同一个 `Runtime` 对象被重复注册内部面（`registerInternals()`）
构造 `Runtime`/`Scheduler`/`VersionClock` 时传入的选项不满足取值要求

symbols.name: createRuntime
symbols.signature: export declare function createRuntime(options?: IRuntimeOptions): IRuntime;
symbols.purpose: Creates an isolated reactive runtime: its own dependency graph, version clock and scheduler. Nodes created by one runtime cannot be read by computed values or effects of another (`CROSS_RUNTIME`). Create one per SSR request, per test, or per worker instead of sharing `defaultRuntime`.
symbols.core:
options: Runtime options; all optional, see the options table.
An `IRuntime`. Invalid options throw a `TypeError` or `RangeError` with code `INVALID_OPTION`.
adapter: Host capabilities: `scheduleMicrotask`, `now` (monotonic time), `timestamp` (epoch time) and `reportError`. Each missing entry falls back to the default.
`queueMicrotask`, `performance.now()`, `Date.now()` and a reporter that does nothing.
onError: Receives errors that the runtime cannot throw to a caller (effect failures during an async flush, lifecycle hook failures, trace listener failures) with a `phase` context. Synchronous reporter failures and returned thenable rejections reach the shared utils host exception queue, without changing graph operations.
Not set: errors go to `adapter.reportError`.
Set it in every long-lived runtime. An automatic flush runs in a microtask, so a failing effect has no caller to throw to; without `onError` the default adapter drops the error and the page just stops updating. Read `context.phase` and `context.observer?.debugName` to see which effect failed.
onTrace: Receives every trace event from creation on, same as calling `subscribeTrace` immediately.
Not set: no trace events are produced unless `subscribeTrace` is used.
Use it while diagnosing why an effect reruns too often, or to feed a devtools panel from the first node on. `subscribeTrace` called later misses the events of nodes created before it; `onTrace` sees them all. Each event names nodes by `debugName`, so give the nodes you care about a name.
maxFlushPasses: Maximum runs of one effect within one flush. Exceeding it is treated as a self-triggering loop: the queue is cleared and `FLUSH_LOOP` is thrown with the dropped node names. Must be a positive integer.
`100` runs per effect per flush.
scheduleIdle: Schedules cleanup work, such as suspending computed values nobody observes. Use it to align cleanup with animation frames or idle callbacks.
Uses `adapter.scheduleMicrotask`.
Use it when many computed values lose their last observer at once, for example when a large list unmounts, and the cleanup should not compete with the next interaction. Passing `requestIdleCallback` moves that cleanup to idle time; reading the computed again before then simply keeps it alive.
schedulerStrategy: Decides when pending effects flush: receives a `flush` function and calls it when appropriate (for example in `requestAnimationFrame`). It must call synchronously or schedule; returning a thenable falls back to the safe default and reports `INVALID_OPTION`.
Merge all writes of the current task into one microtask flush.
symbols.advanced:
SSR creates one runtime per request so state never leaks between users.
Each test owns a runtime and calls `flush()` for deterministic effect timing.
A store library builds collections and resources on `signal` / `computed` / `effect`.
You only need local component state: use the framework state instead.
parameters: options: IRuntimeOptions (optional)
symbols.returns: IRuntime
examples:
const runtime = createRuntime()
const count = runtime.signal(1)
count.value // 1，在 Computed/Effect 内读取会建立依赖
count.value = 2 // Object.is 判定；写入相同值不触发任何通知，也不推进版本
count.peek() // 2，不建立依赖
count.dispose()
count.value // 抛 NODE_DISPOSED

onTrace: Receives every trace event from creation on, same as calling `subscribeTrace` immediately.
Not set: no trace events are produced unless `subscribeTrace` is used.
Use it while diagnosing why an effect reruns too often, or to feed a devtools panel from the first node on. `subscribeTrace` called later misses the events of nodes created before it; `onTrace` sees them all. Each event names nodes by `debugName`, so give the nodes you care about a name.
maxFlushPasses: Maximum runs of one effect within one flush. Exceeding it is treated as a self-triggering loop: the queue is cleared and `FLUSH_LOOP` is thrown with the dropped node names. Must be a positive integer.
`100` runs per effect per flush.
scheduleIdle: Schedules cleanup work, such as suspending computed values nobody observes. Use it to align cleanup with animation frames or idle callbacks.
Uses `adapter.scheduleMicrotask`.
Use it when many computed values lose their last observer at once, for example when a large list unmounts, and the cleanup should not compete with the next interaction. Passing `requestIdleCallback` moves that cleanup to idle time; reading the computed again before then simply keeps it alive.
schedulerStrategy: Decides when pending effects flush: receives a `flush` function and calls it when appropriate (for example in `requestAnimationFrame`). It must call synchronously or schedule; returning a thenable falls back to the safe default and reports `INVALID_OPTION`.
Merge all writes of the current task into one microtask flush.

guidance.heading: 一张依赖图的完整生命周期

blocks.text: 这段代码建立的是一张由当前 `runtime` 独占的依赖图。`runtime.effect()` 创建时会立即执行一次；执行过程中读取 `doubled.value`，使 `Effect → Computed → Signal` 三层依赖自动登记，所以 `seen` 首先得到 `2`。

`count.value = 3` 只会使 `doubled` 失效并把 `effect` 放入待执行队列，不会在 setter 内立刻重跑副作用。`runtime.flush()` 同步排空该 runtime 的队列：`doubled` 在被读取时按需重算为 `6`，随后 `effect` 把它写入 `seen`。生产代码通常让默认微任务自动冲刷；测试、服务端渲染或需要确定提交边界的代码才显式调用 `flush()`。

释放顺序按消费者到数据源执行：先停掉 `effect`，避免清理过程中再次观察数据；再释放派生节点 `doubled`；最后释放源节点 `count`。`dispose()` 断开依赖边并禁止继续读取已释放节点。`Runtime` 本身没有 `dispose()`；需要批量管理时，把这些节点交给 `@migaia/lifecycle` 的 `createLifecycleScope()` / `createSyncLifecycleScope()` 持有并统一释放。

1. 不要跨 `Runtime` 混用节点：一个 `Runtime` 创建的 `Signal` 被另一个 `Runtime` 的 `Computed` / `Effect` 读取会抛 `CROSS_RUNTIME`。 2. 统一经 Runtime 工厂创建节点：`runtime.signal(value, options?)`、`runtime.computed(fn, config?)`、`runtime.effect(fn, options?)`，都有 `dispose()` / `disposed`。三个节点类是内部实现，不作为值导出。 3. `runtime.effect(...)` 创建时会同步立即执行一次，不是等到依赖变化才第一次运行。 4. 给 `Signal` 写入相同的值（`Object.is` 判定）不会触发任何通知，也不会推进版本号。 5. 没有读者的 `Computed` 会被自动挂起（断开依赖；下次读取先验证版本和拓扑，未变则复用缓存）。需要“暂时没人读也保持计算”时传 `{ keepAlive: true }`。 6. `dispose()` 之后的读取会立刻抛 `NODE_DISPOSED`，不会静默返回旧值，避免出现“看起来能用但永远不更新”的状态。 7. `defaultRuntime` 是进程级单例。服务端渲染的请求隔离、单测互不影响、Worker 独立运行，都应该显式调用 `createRuntime()`。 8. 调度可控：默认在微任务里合并冲刷；创建 Runtime 时可用 `schedulerStrategy` 改为 `requestAnimationFrame`、空闲回调或自定义策略。 9. 诊断不进入业务状态：trace 事件和错误上报走独立通道。
不适合的场景：只想要组件内部的局部状态（相当于 `useState`），不需要跨组件共享的依赖图；或者需要开箱即用的可观察集合、异步请求状态机。后两者由本仓的集合、resource 等包在本包之上提供，本包自身不包含。
通用的“一组资源集中释放”容器（原 `Scope` / `createScope()`）已移出本包，改用 `@migaia/lifecycle` 的 `createLifecycleScope()` / `createSyncLifecycleScope()`。

blocks.text: 副作用——唯一真正"被执行"的观察者（`Computed` 只标脏不重跑，只有 `Effect` 会被调度器实际 `tick`）：
边界行为：

items: 构造时立即同步执行一次，不是等到依赖变化才第一次运行。
`fn()` 可选返回一个清理函数（`IDisposer`），会在下次重跑前、以及 `dispose()` 时被调用（`runtime.untracked()` 包裹执行，不建立新依赖）；旧 cleanup 会先被摘掉（置空）再执行，避免新 `fn()` 抛错时下次重跑/dispose 重复执行旧 cleanup。

默认微任务策略下依赖变化不会立即重跑，而是被 `Scheduler.enqueue()` 标脏排队，由 `flush()`（自动或手动）驱动 `tick()`；`tick()` 内部会先确认依赖确实变化（`hasStaleDependencies`）才真正 `run()`。注入 `flush => flush()` 这类同步策略时，setter 可在完整 fan-out 后立即重跑 Effect。
依赖节点被 `dispose()`/`disconnectObservable` 断开时，会强制下次 `tick()` 无条件重跑（不看是否真的脏）。

symbols.name: IRuntime
symbols.purpose: One isolated reactive graph returned by `createRuntime()`. All nodes are created through it, and it owns batching, flushing and diagnostics.
symbols.core:
signal: Creates a writable node. Reading `.value` inside a computed or an effect records a dependency; assigning a value that is not `Object.is`-equal advances its version and marks dependents dirty.
signal.value: Initial value.
signal.options: `debugName`: label used in trace events and errors.
An `IReactiveSignal`; its owner should `dispose()` it when done.
computed: Creates a lazy, cached derived value. It computes on first read, recomputes only after a dependency changed, and when nobody observes it any more it suspends itself at idle time (unless `keepAlive`).
computed.fn: Pure derivation; every node read inside becomes a dependency. It must not write signals.
computed.config: Either an `equals(a, b)` function, or `{ equals, keepAlive, debugName }`. `equals` decides whether dependents see a change (default `Object.is`); `keepAlive: true` keeps the value warm without observers.
An `IReactiveComputed` whose `.value` is read-only.
Any value that can be derived from other nodes. Use an effect only for side effects.
effect: Creates a side effect that runs once immediately, records the nodes it reads, and runs again at the next flush after any of them changed. A function returned by `fn` is called before each rerun and on dispose.
effect.fn: Effect body; may return a cleanup function.
effect.options: `debugName`: label for traces.
An `IReactiveEffect` handle; `dispose()` removes dependencies and runs the last cleanup.
batch: Runs `fn` and merges every write inside it into one flush when the outermost `batch` returns, so effects never see a half-applied update. Nested calls only increase the depth.
batch.fn: Code that writes several nodes.
What `fn` returns. If `fn` throws and the final flush also throws, both errors are kept (see `ACTION_FLUSH_FAILED`).
untracked: Runs `fn` with dependency tracking turned off: nodes read inside are not recorded as dependencies of the current computed or effect.
untracked.fn: Code whose reads must not subscribe.
What `fn` returns.
Read configuration or context inside an effect without rerunning when it changes. For one node, `node.peek()` is shorter.
flush: Runs the pending effects now, synchronously. Production code normally relies on the scheduler strategy (merged microtasks by default); tests, SSR and explicit commit points call it directly.
`completed` from the outermost call after the queue is empty; `deferred` when called from inside an effect (the outer flush continues). More than `maxFlushPasses` reruns of one effect throw `FLUSH_LOOP` and drop the rest of the queue.
runTracedAction: Runs `fn` as one named action in the trace stream (start, end or error records). Without trace listeners it is the same as calling `fn()`.
runTracedAction.name: Non-empty action name shown in devtools; otherwise `INVALID_OPTION`.
runTracedAction.fn: The action body.
What `fn` returns; an error of `fn` is rethrown after the error record.
Pair it with `subscribeTrace` (or the `onTrace` option): mark a user-level operation so devtools can group the node changes and effect runs it caused between its start and end records. Without a listener it adds no cost and records nothing.
reportError: Sends an error to the runtime diagnostic channel (`onError`, or the adapter `reportError`). Node references in `context` are replaced by descriptors before they reach callbacks.
reportError.error: The failure to report.
reportError.context: `phase` (a `ReactiveErrorPhase` value) plus optional `observer` / `observable` node involved.
Nothing; reporting never throws into the caller.
Adapters and extensions that must swallow an error but keep it observable.
subscribeTrace: Subscribes to read-only diagnostic events: node changes, dependency connect/disconnect, effect runs and traced actions. Nodes appear as `{ id, kind, debugName }` descriptors, not as objects.
subscribeTrace.listener: Receives each trace event.
A function that stops the subscription.
Devtools, loggers and tests that need to see why the graph changed. Pair it with `runTracedAction` to group the events of one user operation under a name; subscribe after the runtime exists, or use the `onTrace` option to receive events from creation on.

symbols.name: IRuntimeOptions
symbols.purpose: Options of `createRuntime()`; all fields are optional and fixed at creation.
symbols.core:
adapter: Host capabilities: `scheduleMicrotask`, `now` (monotonic time), `timestamp` (epoch time) and `reportError`. Each missing entry falls back to the default.
`queueMicrotask`, `performance.now()`, `Date.now()` and a reporter that does nothing.
onError: Receives errors that the runtime cannot throw to a caller (effect failures during an async flush, lifecycle hook failures, trace listener failures) with a `phase` context. Synchronous reporter failures and returned thenable rejections reach the shared utils host exception queue, without changing graph operations.
Not set: errors go to `adapter.reportError`.
Set it in every long-lived runtime. An automatic flush runs in a microtask, so a failing effect has no caller to throw to; without `onError` the default adapter drops the error and the page just stops updating. Read `context.phase` and `context.observer?.debugName` to see which effect failed.
onTrace: Receives every trace event from creation on, same as calling `subscribeTrace` immediately.
Not set: no trace events are produced unless `subscribeTrace` is used.
Use it while diagnosing why an effect reruns too often, or to feed a devtools panel from the first node on. `subscribeTrace` called later misses the events of nodes created before it; `onTrace` sees them all. Each event names nodes by `debugName`, so give the nodes you care about a name.
maxFlushPasses: Maximum runs of one effect within one flush. Exceeding it is treated as a self-triggering loop: the queue is cleared and `FLUSH_LOOP` is thrown with the dropped node names. Must be a positive integer.
`100` runs per effect per flush.
scheduleIdle: Schedules cleanup work, such as suspending computed values nobody observes. Use it to align cleanup with animation frames or idle callbacks.
Uses `adapter.scheduleMicrotask`.
Use it when many computed values lose their last observer at once, for example when a large list unmounts, and the cleanup should not compete with the next interaction. Passing `requestIdleCallback` moves that cleanup to idle time; reading the computed again before then simply keeps it alive.
schedulerStrategy: Decides when pending effects flush: receives a `flush` function and calls it when appropriate (for example in `requestAnimationFrame`). It must call synchronously or schedule; returning a thenable falls back to the safe default and reports `INVALID_OPTION`.
Merge all writes of the current task into one microtask flush.

members.name: adapter
members.description: Injects host capabilities. Missing entries use `defaultRuntimeAdapter`.

members.name: maxFlushPasses
members.description: Maximum executions for one observer within one flush. The default is 100. Exceeding the limit is treated as a self-triggering cycle and throws after clearing the queue. The limit is configurable scheduling policy, not a physical constant.

members.name: scheduleIdle
members.description: Schedules suspension of an unobserved `Computed`. Defaults to the adapter's `scheduleMicrotask`. Suspension is cleanup, so its timing is separate from flushing. This configurable channel can align cleanup with animation-frame or idle policies without requiring callers or tests to wait for a hard-coded microtask.

members.name: schedulerStrategy
members.description: Selects flush timing at creation; the runtime does not expose strategy replacement.

symbols.name: IRuntimeTraceEvent
symbols.purpose: One trace event: node change, dependency connect/disconnect, effect run, or traced action. Nodes appear as descriptors.
symbols.core:
type: Event discriminant from `ReactiveTraceType`, selecting observable changes, dependency edges, observer execution or actions.
timestamp: Runtime-supplied event timestamp from the tracing clock; consumers do not construct this value.
observable: Runtime-issued node descriptor for the changed value or the dependency edge’s observable source.
reason: Runtime-supplied cause of a value change or dependency transition; absent when that event carries no reason.
phase: Dependency connect/disconnect or execution start/end/error phase, interpreted together with the event type.
observer: Runtime-issued descriptor identifying the observer at the dependency edge or execution event.
durationMs: Optional measured execution duration in milliseconds, supplied by observer or action completion tracing.
error: Original execution failure on an error-phase observer or action event; successful phases omit it.
name: Action name supplied by the caller to the runtime action API and retained on its trace events.

symbols.name: ReactiveErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Every error code this package throws or reports. Branch on `error.code === ReactiveErrorCode.x` instead of the message text.
symbols.core:
callbackFailed: `CALLBACK_FAILED`: an unclassified callback failure. Writable native errors retain identity; primitive or immutable failures remain on cause, including undefined. Valid external identities and non-Error object control values pass through unchanged, without then probing.
nodeDisposed: `NODE_DISPOSED`: a disposed signal, computed or source was read or written.
circularDependency: `CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY`: a computed read itself while being computed.
crossRuntime: `CROSS_RUNTIME`: a node of one runtime was used by another runtime.
notRuntimeOwned: `NOT_RUNTIME_OWNED`: the object is not a runtime (or node) registered by this package.
ownershipConflict: `OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT`: one object was registered to two runtimes.
copyConflict: `COPY_CONFLICT`: multiple copies registered at a correctness boundary, or a foreign branded node crossed a local boundary. Cold imports alone need not register.
brandCorrupted: `BRAND_CORRUPTED`: the cross-copy diagnostic marker has an unexpected shape.
versionExhausted: `VERSION_EXHAUSTED`: the version clock reached its upper limit.
flushLoop: `FLUSH_LOOP`: one effect ran more than `maxFlushPasses` times in one flush.
observerFailed: `OBSERVER_FAILED`: several observers or hooks failed in one flush; an `AggregateError` holds them.
actionFlushFailed: `ACTION_FLUSH_FAILED`: a batch body and its final flush both failed.
schedulerFailed: `SCHEDULER_FAILED`: reserved code for scheduler strategy failures reported by adapters.
captureInvalid: `CAPTURE_INVALID`: a capture token was already used, belongs elsewhere, or its observer is gone.
bindingDuplicate: `BINDING_DUPLICATE`: `observe()` was called twice on one binding.
graphNodeRegistered: `GRAPH_NODE_REGISTERED`: a source or observer binding targeted an already registered node.
internalsRegistered: `INTERNALS_REGISTERED`: internal services were registered twice for one runtime.
invalidOption: `INVALID_OPTION`: a runtime option or argument has an invalid value.

members.name: callbackFailed
members.description: An unclassified action, batch, untracked, or tracked derivation callback threw. Annotatable * native errors keep identity and stack; immutable and primitive values remain on cause. Existing * package identities are preserved. Handle the callback failure before retrying the operation.

members.name: nodeDisposed
members.description: Thrown when a read or write operation targets a disposed `Signal`, `Computed`, or custom * source. * * Value access rejects after disposal to prevent reading stale values from disconnected nodes. * Stop using the disposed node and create a replacement instance.

members.name: circularDependency
members.description: Thrown when evaluating a `Computed` directly or indirectly reads its own pending result. * * A cycle cannot produce a determinate value. Further evaluation loops or returns incomplete * stale data. Inspect the dependency graph and remove the cycle.

members.name: crossRuntime
members.description: Thrown when a node from one `Runtime` is read, subscribed, or checked at another runtime's * boundary. * * Each `Runtime` owns an independent dependency graph and ownership table. Cross-graph operations * cannot preserve consistency and can leave stale dependency edges. Ensure the node and its * consumer belong to the same `Runtime`. Do not share nodes across runtimes.

members.name: notRuntimeOwned
members.description: Thrown when an object lacks the internal registration supplied by this library's runtime or * node factories. * * The kernel trusts only registered runtimes and nodes. It rejects unregistered objects at the * entry boundary instead of allowing later failures that obscure their source. Use an object from * this library's factories.

members.name: ownershipConflict
members.description: Thrown at the second registration when the same node object is assigned to different runtimes. * * A node cannot belong to two dependency graphs without invalidating ownership checks. Create * independent nodes for each `Runtime` instead of reusing an object across runtimes.

members.name: copyConflict
members.description: Reports multiple library copies, such as duplicate installations, bundled and CDN copies, or * separate microfrontend bundles. Also thrown when `assertSingleRuntimeCopy()` finds more than * one copy. * * Copies do not share ownership tables or synchronous tracking contexts. Cross-copy reads can * therefore return stale data without detection. Deduplicate dependencies to keep one library * copy in the process. Use `assertSingleRuntimeCopy()` when the deployment must reject multiple * copies.

members.name: brandCorrupted
members.description: Thrown when a cross-copy diagnostic brand has an unexpected shape. * * `Object.defineProperty` installs this read-only internal marker. An invalid brand indicates * modification outside the supported path and invalidates ownership checks. Do not modify * internal properties on managed objects.

members.name: versionExhausted
members.description: Thrown when a new version is requested after the monotonic clock reaches its configured limit. * The production default is `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`. * * Resetting the counter would collide with versions held by live nodes and cause missed updates. * The clock therefore stops on exhaustion. Dispose all nodes owned by the current `Runtime`, * discard that runtime, and create a new one instead of reusing the graph.

members.name: flushLoop
members.description: Thrown when one observer executes more than `maxFlushPasses` times in one flush. The default is * 100. * * This usually indicates an effect writes to its own dependency and triggers itself. The * scheduler clears pending work and ends the flush to prevent a synchronous infinite loop. * Inspect the discarded items in the error message to locate and remove the cycle.

members.name: observerFailed
members.description: Thrown or reported as an `AggregateError` when multiple observer `tick()` calls fail in a * flush, or multiple observable lifecycle hooks (`onObserved` or `onUnobserved`) fail. * * Inspect each entry in `error.errors`. A single observer failure retains the original error * without this code.

members.name: actionFlushFailed
members.description: Tags the aggregate when both the business action and final flush fail in `runBatched()`. If * reading the business error's `cause` fails, all three original failures enter * `AggregateError.errors`. * * A writable business error remains the top-level error, with the flush failure attached through * `cause`. Inspect the top-level error and its `cause` or `errors`.

members.name: schedulerFailed
members.description: Reserved diagnostic code for unhandled failures in an async scheduling callback or * `reportError()`. * * The default `adapter.reportError` is a no-op, so no default throw or report site uses this * code. The code remains stable for custom `onAsyncError` or `onError` handlers that need * scheduler-failure semantics.

members.name: captureInvalid
members.description: Thrown when `commitCapture()` receives an invalid or consumed token, a token from another * tracker, or a token whose observer is disposed. * * A capture token can be validated and committed only once. Reevaluate instead of reusing the * token, for example during a Concurrent React render.

members.name: bindingDuplicate
members.description: Thrown when `observe` is called on an `IObserverBinding` that already owns an active observer. * * `observe` is not idempotent. Duplicate calls indicate a repeated state-machine transition. * Ensure the previous observation ends before calling `observe` again.

members.name: graphNodeRegistered
members.description: Thrown when an extension binding targets a node with existing graph bookkeeping. Replacing its * sets would orphan live edges. Bind a fresh custom node once; do not rebind a Signal, Computed, * Effect, Resource, or an already bound custom node.

members.name: internalsRegistered
members.description: Thrown when `registerInternals()` registers the same `Runtime` object twice. * * Register internals once during construction. Duplicate registration is a programming error, not * an instruction to replace the existing internals. Check the runtime construction path.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Thrown during construction or invocation when an option fails validation. Examples include * `maxFlushPasses`, the maximum version, and a traced action's name. * * Entry validation prevents invalid configuration from entering runtime state. Correct the option * value.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Every error code this package throws or reports. Branch on `error.code === ReactiveErrorCode.x` instead of the message text.

sections.title: 上手

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
callbackFailed: `CALLBACK_FAILED`: an unclassified callback failure. Writable native errors retain identity; primitive or immutable failures remain on cause, including undefined. Valid external identities and non-Error object control values pass through unchanged, without then probing.
nodeDisposed: `NODE_DISPOSED`: a disposed signal, computed or source was read or written.
circularDependency: `CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY`: a computed read itself while being computed.
crossRuntime: `CROSS_RUNTIME`: a node of one runtime was used by another runtime.
notRuntimeOwned: `NOT_RUNTIME_OWNED`: the object is not a runtime (or node) registered by this package.
ownershipConflict: `OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT`: one object was registered to two runtimes.
copyConflict: `COPY_CONFLICT`: multiple copies registered at a correctness boundary, or a foreign branded node crossed a local boundary. Cold imports alone need not register.
brandCorrupted: `BRAND_CORRUPTED`: the cross-copy diagnostic marker has an unexpected shape.
versionExhausted: `VERSION_EXHAUSTED`: the version clock reached its upper limit.
flushLoop: `FLUSH_LOOP`: one effect ran more than `maxFlushPasses` times in one flush.
observerFailed: `OBSERVER_FAILED`: several observers or hooks failed in one flush; an `AggregateError` holds them.
actionFlushFailed: `ACTION_FLUSH_FAILED`: a batch body and its final flush both failed.
schedulerFailed: `SCHEDULER_FAILED`: reserved code for scheduler strategy failures reported by adapters.
captureInvalid: `CAPTURE_INVALID`: a capture token was already used, belongs elsewhere, or its observer is gone.
bindingDuplicate: `BINDING_DUPLICATE`: `observe()` was called twice on one binding.
graphNodeRegistered: `GRAPH_NODE_REGISTERED`: a source or observer binding targeted an already registered node.
internalsRegistered: `INTERNALS_REGISTERED`: internal services were registered twice for one runtime.
invalidOption: `INVALID_OPTION`: a runtime option or argument has an invalid value.

blocks.text: 稳定错误码表，18 个码，唯一声明处 `src/error-code.ts`，`source` 恒为 `'@migaia/reactive'`。（迁移背景：原属于本包的 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE`/`SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`/`GENERATION_DISPOSED`/`SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 五个码已随生命周期原语迁出，归属 `@migaia/lifecycle`，不在本表。）

rows: 未分类 action/batch/untracked/tracked derivation callback 失败；native 尽量原位附码，primitive（含 undefined）/不可变 native 原错保留 cause，已有 semantic identity 不变；非 Error 对象 throw 保留控制身份，供 Resource/Suspense owner 单次准入
在已 dispose 的 `Signal`/`Computed`/自定义 Source 上调用读取或写入方法
求值 `Computed` 时检测到它（直接或间接）读取了自己正在求值的结果
一个属于某 `Runtime` 的节点或已登记函数对象在另一个 `Runtime` 的追踪/所有权边界上被读取、订阅或校验
传入的对象不是由 `createRuntime()` 创建、或不携带内部所有权登记
同一个对象或函数引用被重复登记到不同的 `Runtime`
检测到本库存在多份运行时副本、查询到另一副本已登记的对象或函数，或 `assertSingleRuntimeCopy()` 校验到副本数大于一
跨副本诊断品牌被发现处于非预期形状
单调版本时钟达到配置上限（默认 `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`）后再次申请新版本号
一次冲刷内的重算轮数超过 `maxFlushPasses`（默认 100）
一次冲刷中多个 observer 的 `tick()` 失败、或多个 observable 生命周期钩子失败，作为 `AggregateError` 外壳
`runBatched()` 内业务动作与收尾 flush 同时失败；普通可写错误在 `cause` 附加聚合结果，不可读 `cause` 的三个原值直接置于 `AggregateError.errors`
预留：异步调度策略回调或 `reportError()` 捕获到未处理错误的诊断通道码（默认无内置抛出/上报点）
`capture()` 产生的 token 在 `commitCapture()` 时已失效、已被消费、属于另一个 tracker，或对应 observer 已 dispose
同一个 `IObserverBinding` 被重复调用 `observe()`（已处于 observed 状态）
source/observer binding尝试替换已有graph node的集合，须创建新节点
同一个 `Runtime` 对象被重复注册内部面（`registerInternals()`）
构造 `Runtime`/`Scheduler`/`VersionClock` 时传入的选项不满足取值要求

blocks.code:
function createObserverBinding(runtime: IRuntime): IObserverBinding

type IObserverBinding = {
  capture<R>(read: () => R): ICapture<R>
  observe(fn: () => void | IDisposer, options?: IReactiveNodeOptions): IDisposer
  commit(capture: ICapture<unknown>): IObserverCommitResult
  retrack(): IObserverRetrackResult
}

type IObserverCommitResult = 'committed' | 'stale' | 'no-observer'
type IObserverRetrackResult = 'changed' | 'unchanged' | 'no-observer'

blocks.text: 为一个订阅者建立三段式绑定：render 期只读地捕获依赖，commit 期才把依赖装到订阅者上，中间的渲染可能被并发渲染丢弃，捕获阶段绝不建边。绑定自持一个内部 `Effect`：适配层能完成 capture/observe/commit/retrack，却拿不到 `deps`、版本或强制调度入口：
四个成员逐一说明：

items: `capture<R>(read: () => R): ICapture<R>` —— 渲染期捕获：只记录本次读到了哪些依赖节点及其当时版本，不建立依赖边、不推进版本、不排 idle 工作。读取 dirty Computed 复用其 speculative preview，所需已求值图保留在同一个 token 内，commit 先验证完整依赖树，再接纳图/缓存，不重跑 derivation 或 comparer；被丢弃的渲染不会留下订阅残留。`ICapture<R>` 是带品牌的不透明 token，`result: R` 是 `read()` 的返回值；依赖集合存在 tracker 私有 `WeakMap` 里，拿到 token 既读不出依赖也改不了版本。
`observe(fn, options?): IDisposer` —— 安装绑定持有的内部 `Effect`（具体类保持私有，适配层拿不到它去改 `deps`/版本或调用 `run`/`markDirty`）。同一个 binding 重复调用（当前订阅者仍处于已观察状态时再次调用）抛 `BINDING_DUPLICATE`。返回的 disposer 幂等。

`commit(capture): IObserverCommitResult` —— 提交期安装依赖，把 `capture` 装到创建绑定时指定的那个 observer 上。`'committed'`：依赖边已安装；`'stale'`：捕获后依赖已变化，token 已消费，必须重新捕获——调用方只应在此时作废快照并重新取值，不应该在 commit 阶段去 pull 脏节点（那会把用户的求值错误抛在 commit 里，绕过 Error Boundary）；`'no-observer'`：提交目标尚不存在（还未 `observe()` 或已 dispose），token 未消费，可在 observer 就绪后重试。
`retrack(): IObserverRetrackResult` —— 强制当前已提交的 observer 重跑一次，并报告其依赖集合或记录版本是否发生变化（`'changed'`/`'unchanged'`），无 observer 时返回 `'no-observer'`。

symbols.name: IInternalRuntime
symbols.purpose: Graph view of a runtime returned by `internalRuntimeOf()`: `signal()` and `computed()` return nodes that also expose `IObservable` / `IObserver`.
symbols.core:
signal: Creates a writable node. Reading `.value` inside a computed or an effect records a dependency; assigning a value that is not `Object.is`-equal advances its version and marks dependents dirty.
signal.value: Initial value.
signal.options: `debugName`: label used in trace events and errors.
A signal that is also an `IObservable`.
computed: Creates a lazy, cached derived value. It computes on first read, recomputes only after a dependency changed, and when nobody observes it any more it suspends itself at idle time (unless `keepAlive`).
computed.fn: Pure derivation; every node read inside becomes a dependency. It must not write signals.
computed.config: Either an `equals(a, b)` function, or `{ equals, keepAlive, debugName }`. `equals` decides whether dependents see a change (default `Object.is`); `keepAlive: true` keeps the value warm without observers.
A computed value that is also an `IObservable` and an `IObserver`.
Any value that can be derived from other nodes. Use an effect only for side effects.
effect: Creates a side effect that runs once immediately, records the nodes it reads, and runs again at the next flush after any of them changed. A function returned by `fn` is called before each rerun and on dispose.
effect.fn: Effect body; may return a cleanup function.
effect.options: `debugName`: label for traces.
An `IReactiveEffect` handle; `dispose()` removes dependencies and runs the last cleanup.
batch: Runs `fn` and merges every write inside it into one flush when the outermost `batch` returns, so effects never see a half-applied update. Nested calls only increase the depth.
batch.fn: Code that writes several nodes.
What `fn` returns. If `fn` throws and the final flush also throws, both errors are kept (see `ACTION_FLUSH_FAILED`).
untracked: Runs `fn` with dependency tracking turned off: nodes read inside are not recorded as dependencies of the current computed or effect.
untracked.fn: Code whose reads must not subscribe.
What `fn` returns.
Read configuration or context inside an effect without rerunning when it changes. For one node, `node.peek()` is shorter.
flush: Runs the pending effects now, synchronously. Production code normally relies on the scheduler strategy (merged microtasks by default); tests, SSR and explicit commit points call it directly.
`completed` from the outermost call after the queue is empty; `deferred` when called from inside an effect (the outer flush continues). More than `maxFlushPasses` reruns of one effect throw `FLUSH_LOOP` and drop the rest of the queue.
runTracedAction: Runs `fn` as one named action in the trace stream (start, end or error records). Without trace listeners it is the same as calling `fn()`.
runTracedAction.name: Non-empty action name shown in devtools; otherwise `INVALID_OPTION`.
runTracedAction.fn: The action body.
What `fn` returns; an error of `fn` is rethrown after the error record.
Pair it with `subscribeTrace` (or the `onTrace` option): mark a user-level operation so devtools can group the node changes and effect runs it caused between its start and end records. Without a listener it adds no cost and records nothing.
reportError: Sends an error to the runtime diagnostic channel (`onError`, or the adapter `reportError`). Node references in `context` are replaced by descriptors before they reach callbacks.
reportError.error: The failure to report.
reportError.context: `phase` (a `ReactiveErrorPhase` value) plus optional `observer` / `observable` node involved.
Nothing; reporting never throws into the caller.
Adapters and extensions that must swallow an error but keep it observable.
subscribeTrace: Subscribes to read-only diagnostic events: node changes, dependency connect/disconnect, effect runs and traced actions. Nodes appear as `{ id, kind, debugName }` descriptors, not as objects.
subscribeTrace.listener: Receives each trace event.
A function that stops the subscription.
Devtools, loggers and tests that need to see why the graph changed. Pair it with `runTracedAction` to group the events of one user operation under a name; subscribe after the runtime exists, or use the `onTrace` option to receive events from creation on.

version: Version advanced by each published change.

isStale: Optional: tells, without computing, whether the node needs recomputation.
`true` when stale; must not throw or change the graph.
onObserved: Optional hook called when the first observer subscribes.

blocks.text: 稳定错误码表，18 个码，唯一声明处 `src/error-code.ts`，`source` 恒为 `'@migaia/reactive'`。（迁移背景：原属于本包的 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE`/`SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`/`GENERATION_DISPOSED`/`SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 五个码已随生命周期原语迁出，归属 `@migaia/lifecycle`，不在本表。）

rows: 未分类 action/batch/untracked/tracked derivation callback 失败；native 尽量原位附码，primitive（含 undefined）/不可变 native 原错保留 cause，已有 semantic identity 不变；非 Error 对象 throw 保留控制身份，供 Resource/Suspense owner 单次准入
在已 dispose 的 `Signal`/`Computed`/自定义 Source 上调用读取或写入方法
求值 `Computed` 时检测到它（直接或间接）读取了自己正在求值的结果
一个属于某 `Runtime` 的节点或已登记函数对象在另一个 `Runtime` 的追踪/所有权边界上被读取、订阅或校验
传入的对象不是由 `createRuntime()` 创建、或不携带内部所有权登记
同一个对象或函数引用被重复登记到不同的 `Runtime`
检测到本库存在多份运行时副本、查询到另一副本已登记的对象或函数，或 `assertSingleRuntimeCopy()` 校验到副本数大于一
跨副本诊断品牌被发现处于非预期形状
单调版本时钟达到配置上限（默认 `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`）后再次申请新版本号
一次冲刷内的重算轮数超过 `maxFlushPasses`（默认 100）
一次冲刷中多个 observer 的 `tick()` 失败、或多个 observable 生命周期钩子失败，作为 `AggregateError` 外壳
`runBatched()` 内业务动作与收尾 flush 同时失败；普通可写错误在 `cause` 附加聚合结果，不可读 `cause` 的三个原值直接置于 `AggregateError.errors`
预留：异步调度策略回调或 `reportError()` 捕获到未处理错误的诊断通道码（默认无内置抛出/上报点）
`capture()` 产生的 token 在 `commitCapture()` 时已失效、已被消费、属于另一个 tracker，或对应 observer 已 dispose
同一个 `IObserverBinding` 被重复调用 `observe()`（已处于 observed 状态）
source/observer binding尝试替换已有graph node的集合，须创建新节点
同一个 `Runtime` 对象被重复注册内部面（`registerInternals()`）
构造 `Runtime`/`Scheduler`/`VersionClock` 时传入的选项不满足取值要求

symbols.name: IObserverBinding
symbols.purpose: Render/commit binding returned by `createObserverBinding()`. It owns one internal effect; the adapter can capture, observe, commit and retrack but cannot reach its dependencies.
symbols.core:
capture: Runs `read` with opaque capture and computed previews, without adding edges, advancing versions or scheduling work, including nested computed reads.
capture.read: Render-time read function.
An `ICapture` token with `result`.
observe: Installs the internal effect that reruns when committed dependencies change. Calling it again while observed throws `BINDING_DUPLICATE`.
observe.fn: The subscriber body (usually a rerender request).
observe.options: `debugName` for traces.
An idempotent disposer.
commit: Recursively validates the evaluated capture tree, then lets the canonical tracker adopt its dependencies and preview cache. It does not rerun derivations or comparers.
commit.capture: Token from `capture()`; consumed when committed.

sections.title: 核心用法

capture: Runs `read` with opaque capture and computed previews, without adding edges, advancing versions or scheduling work, including nested computed reads.
capture.read: Render-time read function.

observe: Installs the internal effect that reruns when committed dependencies change. Calling it again while observed throws `BINDING_DUPLICATE`.

observe.options: `debugName` for traces.
An idempotent disposer.
commit: Recursively validates the evaluated capture tree, then lets the canonical tracker adopt its dependencies and preview cache. It does not rerun derivations or comparers.
commit.capture: Token from `capture()`; consumed when committed.
`committed` (edges installed), `stale` (a dependency changed since capture; read again) or `no-observer` (call `observe()` first; the token is kept).
retrack: Forces the committed observer to rerun once.
`changed` or `unchanged` (whether its dependency set or recorded versions changed), or `no-observer`.

blocks.text: 稳定错误码表，18 个码，唯一声明处 `src/error-code.ts`，`source` 恒为 `'@migaia/reactive'`。（迁移背景：原属于本包的 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE`/`SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`/`GENERATION_DISPOSED`/`SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 五个码已随生命周期原语迁出，归属 `@migaia/lifecycle`，不在本表。）

rows: 未分类 action/batch/untracked/tracked derivation callback 失败；native 尽量原位附码，primitive（含 undefined）/不可变 native 原错保留 cause，已有 semantic identity 不变；非 Error 对象 throw 保留控制身份，供 Resource/Suspense owner 单次准入
在已 dispose 的 `Signal`/`Computed`/自定义 Source 上调用读取或写入方法
求值 `Computed` 时检测到它（直接或间接）读取了自己正在求值的结果
一个属于某 `Runtime` 的节点或已登记函数对象在另一个 `Runtime` 的追踪/所有权边界上被读取、订阅或校验
传入的对象不是由 `createRuntime()` 创建、或不携带内部所有权登记
同一个对象或函数引用被重复登记到不同的 `Runtime`
检测到本库存在多份运行时副本、查询到另一副本已登记的对象或函数，或 `assertSingleRuntimeCopy()` 校验到副本数大于一
跨副本诊断品牌被发现处于非预期形状
单调版本时钟达到配置上限（默认 `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`）后再次申请新版本号
一次冲刷内的重算轮数超过 `maxFlushPasses`（默认 100）
一次冲刷中多个 observer 的 `tick()` 失败、或多个 observable 生命周期钩子失败，作为 `AggregateError` 外壳
`runBatched()` 内业务动作与收尾 flush 同时失败；普通可写错误在 `cause` 附加聚合结果，不可读 `cause` 的三个原值直接置于 `AggregateError.errors`
预留：异步调度策略回调或 `reportError()` 捕获到未处理错误的诊断通道码（默认无内置抛出/上报点）
`capture()` 产生的 token 在 `commitCapture()` 时已失效、已被消费、属于另一个 tracker，或对应 observer 已 dispose
同一个 `IObserverBinding` 被重复调用 `observe()`（已处于 observed 状态）
source/observer binding尝试替换已有graph node的集合，须创建新节点
同一个 `Runtime` 对象被重复注册内部面（`registerInternals()`）
构造 `Runtime`/`Scheduler`/`VersionClock` 时传入的选项不满足取值要求

blocks.text: 调用方应始终以 `error.code === ReactiveErrorCode.xxx` 判别，不要硬编码码值字符串。逐条设计动机见源码 `src/error-code.ts` 的 JSDoc。

track: Records this source as a dependency of the current computed or effect.

notify: Publishes a change that already happened outside the graph (advances the version and notifies dependents).

dispose: Releases the node: removes its dependency edges and stops notifications. Calling it again does nothing.

symbols.name: createResource
symbols.purpose: Functional way to build a `Resource`. `setup` runs once, synchronously, with the runtime, scheduler, an abort signal and `onDispose`; it returns the fetcher, and the data type is inferred from it. Cleanups registered with `onDispose` run in reverse order on `dispose()`. If setup throws, returns a non-function (`RESOURCE_SETUP_INVALID`) or the options are invalid, the signal aborts and the registered cleanups run before the original error is rethrown, with cleanup failures attached through `errors`.
symbols.core:
setup: Function `(context) => fetcher` called once; see `IResourceSetupContext` for what it receives. Register cleanups synchronously inside it.
A `Resource` with the inferred data type; it owns the setup cleanups.
debugName: Label shown in reactive diagnostics and in request error context.
Not set: diagnostics show no label.
ttl: Success lifetime in milliseconds; positive finite lifetimes revalidate on an expired read. `0` and `Infinity` disable time expiration, but changed dependencies, including after suspension, still trigger refetching. Must be ≥ 0 or `Infinity`.
`Infinity`: fresh until a dependency changes or `refetch()` is called.
autoStart: Start the first request in the constructor.
`true`: starts immediately unless the initial snapshot is fresh.
staleWhileRevalidate: Keep showing expired success data while the refresh runs (`refreshing` is `true`) instead of switching to `pending`.
`false`: an expired value is replaced by `pending`.
retry: Retry policy after a failure: a non-negative integer of extra attempts, or `(failureCount, error) => boolean` deciding each retry. A Promise thrown for Suspense does not count as a failure. A throwing policy or invalid result yields `INVALID_OPTION`; the triggering fetch failure stays reachable through `cause` or `errors`, and existing external identity is preserved.
`0`: no retry.
retryDelay: Wait before each retry in milliseconds, or `(failureCount, error) => ms` for backoff. Throwing callbacks or invalid results retain the fetch failure in `cause` or `errors`; policy errors receive `INVALID_OPTION` unless already classified externally.
`0`: retry immediately.
Pass a function when the server is overloaded or rate limited: immediate retries add load at the worst moment. `failureCount` starts at 1, so `1000 * 2 ** (failureCount - 1)` waits 1 s, 2 s, 4 s. You can also read `error` and wait longer for a 429 than for a network error. A plain number is enough when failures are short network blips.
keepAlive: Keep upstream dependencies connected while nothing reads `state`, so changes are still tracked.
`false`: unobserved resources disconnect upstream.
initialSnapshot: Success snapshot from `dehydrate()` (server rendering or persistence) used as the initial state; it is revalidated when expired.
Not set: start from `idle`.
scheduler: Clock and timers for `ttl`, `updatedAt`, `expiresAt` and retry delays; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
`systemScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.
runtime: Reactive runtime from `createRuntime()` that owns the resource graph; the signals the fetcher reads must belong to it.
`defaultRuntime` from `@migaia/reactive`.

blocks.code:
type IResourceOptions<T = unknown> = {
  debugName?: string
  ttl?: number // 默认 Infinity（永不过期，除非依赖变化/手动刷新）
  autoStart?: boolean // 默认 true
  staleWhileRevalidate?: boolean // 默认 false
  retry?: IResourceRetryPolicy // 默认 0（不重试）
  retryDelay?: number | ((failureCount: number, error: unknown) => number) // 默认 0
  keepAlive?: boolean // 默认 false
  initialSnapshot?: IResourceCacheSnapshot<T>
  scheduler?: IScheduler // 默认 @migaia/utils/scheduler 的 systemScheduler
}

type IResourceRetryPolicy = number | ((failureCount: number, error: unknown) => boolean)

blocks.text: 逐项语义与校验：

items: `ttl?: number` —— 成功值的新鲜时长（毫秒）。`0` 与 `Infinity`（默认）表示永不因时间过期，只会因依赖变化/`refetch()`/`invalidate()` 而刷新。非 `Infinity` 时必须是有限非负数，否则抛贴 `INVALID_OPTION` 码的 `RangeError`；`updatedAt + ttl` 运算结果非有限（数值溢出）同样抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。
`autoStart?: boolean` —— 是否在构造函数内立即发起首次请求。默认 `true`。若同时提供了新鲜的 `initialSnapshot`，即使 `autoStart: true` 也不会立即再发一次请求。
`staleWhileRevalidate?: boolean` —— 默认 `false`。为 `true` 时，刷新期间继续展示旧的 `success` 数据（附带 `refreshing: true`），而不是回退到 `pending`。

`retry?: number | (failureCount, error) => boolean` —— 固定次数或自定义判断函数。数字必须是非负整数，否则抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。函数形式在每次失败后被调用一次，用第几次失败（从 1 开始）与错误对象决定是否重试；Suspense 抛出的 thenable 值不计入失败次数（`fetcher` 内部同步抛出一个 thenable 是被当作"需要等待后重跑"处理的，不是一次真实失败）。

`retryDelay?: number | (failureCount, error) => number` —— 固定延迟或按失败次数计算的函数，单位毫秒。数字必须是有限非负数；函数返回非数字时以原生 `TypeError`/`INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝；返回负数/非有限数字则为 `RangeError`/`INVALID_OPTION`。策略抛错或返回非法值时保留触发重试的 fetch 主因，原生策略 Error 尽量原样附码，已有外部身份不改写。
`keepAlive?: boolean` —— 默认 `false`：长时间无人观察 `state` 会在下一个 idle 时机自动休眠（断开上游边、保留依赖版本与缓存），下次读取核对版本；依赖未变且缓存新鲜时继续复用，变更时重拉。设为 `true` 时禁用自动休眠。
`initialSnapshot?: IResourceCacheSnapshot<T>` —— SSR/持久化恢复用的初始成功快照；构造期即 `hydrate()`，格式非法抛 `INVALID_SNAPSHOT`（详见快照类型）。

`scheduler?: IScheduler`（`@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间域与排程来源：TTL/`updatedAt`/`expiresAt`/重试延迟全部走同一个调度器，默认 `@migaia/utils/scheduler` 的 `systemScheduler`（单调时钟）。传入的值必须满足 `{ now(): number; schedule(cb, delayMs): IScheduledTask }` 契约（内部用 `snapshotScheduler` 校验），否则抛 `INVALID_OPTION`；缺宿主能力时该 scheduler 在被调用时才 fail-fast，不会静默降级成微任务。

symbols.name: IResourceOptions
symbols.purpose: Options of `new Resource()`: caching, retries, start-up and snapshots.
symbols.core:
debugName: Label shown in reactive diagnostics and in request error context.
Not set: diagnostics show no label.
ttl: Success lifetime in milliseconds; positive finite lifetimes revalidate on an expired read. `0` and `Infinity` disable time expiration, but changed dependencies, including after suspension, still trigger refetching. Must be ≥ 0 or `Infinity`.
`Infinity`: fresh until a dependency changes or `refetch()` is called.
autoStart: Start the first request in the constructor.
`true`: starts immediately unless the initial snapshot is fresh.
staleWhileRevalidate: Keep showing expired success data while the refresh runs (`refreshing` is `true`) instead of switching to `pending`.
`false`: an expired value is replaced by `pending`.
retry: Retry policy after a failure: a non-negative integer of extra attempts, or `(failureCount, error) => boolean` deciding each retry. A Promise thrown for Suspense does not count as a failure. A throwing policy or invalid result yields `INVALID_OPTION`; the triggering fetch failure stays reachable through `cause` or `errors`, and existing external identity is preserved.
`0`: no retry.
retryDelay: Wait before each retry in milliseconds, or `(failureCount, error) => ms` for backoff. Throwing callbacks or invalid results retain the fetch failure in `cause` or `errors`; policy errors receive `INVALID_OPTION` unless already classified externally.
`0`: retry immediately.
Pass a function when the server is overloaded or rate limited: immediate retries add load at the worst moment. `failureCount` starts at 1, so `1000 * 2 ** (failureCount - 1)` waits 1 s, 2 s, 4 s. You can also read `error` and wait longer for a 429 than for a network error. A plain number is enough when failures are short network blips.
keepAlive: Keep upstream dependencies connected while nothing reads `state`, so changes are still tracked.
`false`: unobserved resources disconnect upstream.
initialSnapshot: Success snapshot from `dehydrate()` (server rendering or persistence) used as the initial state; it is revalidated when expired.
Not set: start from `idle`.
scheduler: Clock and timers for `ttl`, `updatedAt`, `expiresAt` and retry delays; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
`systemScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
debugName: Label shown in reactive diagnostics and in request error context.
Not set: diagnostics show no label.
ttl: Success lifetime in milliseconds; positive finite lifetimes revalidate on an expired read. `0` and `Infinity` disable time expiration, but changed dependencies, including after suspension, still trigger refetching. Must be ≥ 0 or `Infinity`.
`Infinity`: fresh until a dependency changes or `refetch()` is called.
autoStart: Start the first request in the constructor.
`true`: starts immediately unless the initial snapshot is fresh.
staleWhileRevalidate: Keep showing expired success data while the refresh runs (`refreshing` is `true`) instead of switching to `pending`.
`false`: an expired value is replaced by `pending`.
retry: Retry policy after a failure: a non-negative integer of extra attempts, or `(failureCount, error) => boolean` deciding each retry. A Promise thrown for Suspense does not count as a failure. A throwing policy or invalid result yields `INVALID_OPTION`; the triggering fetch failure stays reachable through `cause` or `errors`, and existing external identity is preserved.
`0`: no retry.
retryDelay: Wait before each retry in milliseconds, or `(failureCount, error) => ms` for backoff. Throwing callbacks or invalid results retain the fetch failure in `cause` or `errors`; policy errors receive `INVALID_OPTION` unless already classified externally.
`0`: retry immediately.
Pass a function when the server is overloaded or rate limited: immediate retries add load at the worst moment. `failureCount` starts at 1, so `1000 * 2 ** (failureCount - 1)` waits 1 s, 2 s, 4 s. You can also read `error` and wait longer for a 429 than for a network error. A plain number is enough when failures are short network blips.
keepAlive: Keep upstream dependencies connected while nothing reads `state`, so changes are still tracked.
`false`: unobserved resources disconnect upstream.
initialSnapshot: Success snapshot from `dehydrate()` (server rendering or persistence) used as the initial state; it is revalidated when expired.
Not set: start from `idle`.
scheduler: Clock and timers for `ttl`, `updatedAt`, `expiresAt` and retry delays; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
`systemScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.

blocks.text: 函数式构建 `Resource`。`setup` 只同步执行一次，拿到 `{ runtime, scheduler, signal, debugName, onDispose }`，返回 fetcher；数据类型从 fetcher 推导。`options` 就是 `IResourceOptions` 加上可选的 `runtime`（默认 `@migaia/reactive` 的 `defaultRuntime`）。

items: `onDispose` 注册的清理在 `dispose()` 时按注册的逆序执行，`signal` 同时中止。
`setup` 抛错、返回值不是函数（`RESOURCE_SETUP_INVALID`）或选项非法时，先中止 `signal`、逆序执行已注册清理，再重抛原始错误；清理失败挂在 `errors` 上。
`setup` 返回后再调用 `onDispose` 会抛 `RESOURCE_SETUP_CLOSED`，避免泄漏。

type IResourceOptions<T = unknown> = {
  debugName?: string
  ttl?: number // 默认 Infinity（永不过期，除非依赖变化/手动刷新）
  autoStart?: boolean // 默认 true
  staleWhileRevalidate?: boolean // 默认 false
  retry?: IResourceRetryPolicy // 默认 0（不重试）
  retryDelay?: number | ((failureCount: number, error: unknown) => number) // 默认 0
  keepAlive?: boolean // 默认 false
  initialSnapshot?: IResourceCacheSnapshot<T>
  scheduler?: IScheduler // 默认 @migaia/utils/scheduler 的 systemScheduler
}

type IResourceRetryPolicy = number | ((failureCount: number, error: unknown) => boolean)

blocks.text: 逐项语义与校验：

items: `ttl?: number` —— 成功值的新鲜时长（毫秒）。`0` 与 `Infinity`（默认）表示永不因时间过期，只会因依赖变化/`refetch()`/`invalidate()` 而刷新。非 `Infinity` 时必须是有限非负数，否则抛贴 `INVALID_OPTION` 码的 `RangeError`；`updatedAt + ttl` 运算结果非有限（数值溢出）同样抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。
`autoStart?: boolean` —— 是否在构造函数内立即发起首次请求。默认 `true`。若同时提供了新鲜的 `initialSnapshot`，即使 `autoStart: true` 也不会立即再发一次请求。
`staleWhileRevalidate?: boolean` —— 默认 `false`。为 `true` 时，刷新期间继续展示旧的 `success` 数据（附带 `refreshing: true`），而不是回退到 `pending`。

`retry?: number | (failureCount, error) => boolean` —— 固定次数或自定义判断函数。数字必须是非负整数，否则抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。函数形式在每次失败后被调用一次，用第几次失败（从 1 开始）与错误对象决定是否重试；Suspense 抛出的 thenable 值不计入失败次数（`fetcher` 内部同步抛出一个 thenable 是被当作"需要等待后重跑"处理的，不是一次真实失败）。

`retryDelay?: number | (failureCount, error) => number` —— 固定延迟或按失败次数计算的函数，单位毫秒。数字必须是有限非负数；函数返回非数字时以原生 `TypeError`/`INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝；返回负数/非有限数字则为 `RangeError`/`INVALID_OPTION`。策略抛错或返回非法值时保留触发重试的 fetch 主因，原生策略 Error 尽量原样附码，已有外部身份不改写。
`keepAlive?: boolean` —— 默认 `false`：长时间无人观察 `state` 会在下一个 idle 时机自动休眠（断开上游边、保留依赖版本与缓存），下次读取核对版本；依赖未变且缓存新鲜时继续复用，变更时重拉。设为 `true` 时禁用自动休眠。
`initialSnapshot?: IResourceCacheSnapshot<T>` —— SSR/持久化恢复用的初始成功快照；构造期即 `hydrate()`，格式非法抛 `INVALID_SNAPSHOT`（详见快照类型）。

`scheduler?: IScheduler`（`@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间域与排程来源：TTL/`updatedAt`/`expiresAt`/重试延迟全部走同一个调度器，默认 `@migaia/utils/scheduler` 的 `systemScheduler`（单调时钟）。传入的值必须满足 `{ now(): number; schedule(cb, delayMs): IScheduledTask }` 契约（内部用 `snapshotScheduler` 校验），否则抛 `INVALID_OPTION`；缺宿主能力时该 scheduler 在被调用时才 fail-fast，不会静默降级成微任务。

symbols.name: IResourceSetupContext
symbols.purpose: What `createResource()` hands to its setup callback; the context is frozen and closes when setup returns.
symbols.core:
runtime: Runtime that owns the resource graph: `options.runtime` or `defaultRuntime`.
scheduler: Scheduler the resource uses for TTL and retry timing: `options.scheduler` or `systemScheduler`.
signal: Aborts when the resource is disposed or setup fails; pass it to listeners and long-lived work started in setup.
debugName: Diagnostic name from `options.debugName`, or `undefined`.
onDispose: Registers a synchronous cleanup that runs in reverse order on `dispose()`, or right away when setup fails. Calling it after setup returned throws `RESOURCE_SETUP_CLOSED`.
onDispose.cleanup: Synchronous function, for example `() => socket.close()`; a non-function throws `RESOURCE_SETUP_INVALID`.
The same context, for chaining.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.

import type { IRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'

class Resource<T> implements IObserver, IDisposable {
  constructor(fetcher: IResourceFetcher<T>, runtime: IRuntime, options?: IResourceOptions<T>)

  debugName?: string

  readonly state: IResourceState<T>
  readonly promise: Promise<T>
  readonly disposed: boolean
  readonly refreshing: boolean
  readonly fetchStatus: ResourceFetchStatus

symbols.name: Resource
symbols.purpose: Creates one async data source bound to a reactive runtime. Every request gets a generation; only the result of the newest generation is written to `state`, and replaced requests receive an aborted `signal`. With `autoStart` (default) the first request starts in the constructor unless `initialSnapshot` is fresh.
symbols.core:
fetcher: Function `(context) => value | Promise` that loads the data. `context` comes from the resource for each request: `signal` aborts when the request is replaced, reset, cancelled or disposed; `generation` is the request number; `token` stays the same across retries of one request. Reactive values read synchronously (before the first `await`) become dependencies. Final unclassified fetch failures receive `FETCH_FAILED`; existing external error identity stays intact, and immutable errors or primitive failures remain reachable through `cause`.
runtime: Reactive runtime returned by `createRuntime()` from `@migaia/reactive`; the same runtime must own the signals the fetcher reads and the effects that read `state`. `dispose()` does not dispose it.
A `Resource` instance; invalid options throw `INVALID_OPTION`, an invalid `initialSnapshot` throws `INVALID_SNAPSHOT`.
deps: Reactive values the last request read synchronously; a change in any of them schedules a new request. Read-only, for diagnostics.
depVersions: Version of each dependency seen by the last request, used by the reactive runtime to skip refreshes when nothing really changed.
runtime: The runtime passed to the constructor; the resource registers itself there as an observer.
debugName: Label given by the `debugName` option, shown in reactive diagnostics and request error context.
state: Current state as a reactive read: an effect that reads it reruns when the state changes. Reading an expired success value starts a revalidation. Throws `RESOURCE_DISPOSED` after `dispose()`.
promise: Promise of the current request, or a resolved Promise of a fresh cached value. Readers share the latest published request Promise; a reentrant fetcher cannot overwrite a Promise of a newer request. Reading it starts work only when idle or stale.
disposed: `true` after `dispose()`; still readable afterwards, unlike most members.
refreshing: `true` while a background refresh runs and the previous success data stays visible (`staleWhileRevalidate`).
fetchStatus: `fetching` while any request runs, otherwise `idle`; separate from `state.status`.
isStale: `true` when the cached success value is older than `ttl`; `false` for any other state.
observed: `true` while some effect or computed currently reads `state`; without observers and without `keepAlive` the resource drops its upstream dependencies.
read: Suspense-style read with tracking: returns the data on success, throws the pending Promise while loading, and throws the error after failure or cancellation.
The data of the current success state.
peek: Materializes the current state without tracking, starting work or revalidating TTL. Pending throws its Promise; normal `autoStart: false` idle with no Promise throws `NO_ACTIVE_PROMISE`. Inspect `peekState()` or explicitly start work first.
peekState: Returns the state without tracking, without starting work and without checking `ttl`.
An `IResourceState` snapshot: branch on `status` (`idle`, `pending`, `success` with `data`, `error` / `cancelled` with `error`).
reset: Cancels the running request, drops cached data and returns to `idle`; the next read starts again.
Nothing; the state is now `idle`.
refetch: Starts a new request even if the cache is fresh, aborting the running one.
Promise of the new request result.
invalidate: Marks the cached data as expired and starts a replacement request at once.
Promise of the replacement request result.
cancel: With an active request, aborts it and pauses passive restarts. Pending becomes `cancelled` (`REQUEST_CANCELLED`); a stale-while-revalidate refresh keeps its success data. Without active work this is a no-op; explicit `refetch()` resumes work.
Nothing; active work is cancelled while cached success data may remain.
dehydrate: Captures a v2 success snapshot with portable durations and unchanged caller-owned data. Only time metadata is directly JSON-encodable: BigInt or cyclic data needs caller serialization. Use safe transport or HTML-context encoding; never insert raw JSON into a script element.
An `IResourceCacheSnapshot`, or `undefined` when the state is not `success`.
hydrate: Replaces the state with a success snapshot produced by `dehydrate()`, cancelling any running request. An expired snapshot is revalidated on the next read. Durations are rebased to the receiving scheduler; callers add known transport/storage time to `ageMs` and subtract it from finite `remainingTtlMs` (minimum zero). Old v1 snapshots are rejected.
hydrate.snapshot: Snapshot returned by `dehydrate()` (often on the server); malformed snapshots throw `INVALID_SNAPSHOT`.
Nothing; the state is now `success`.
markDirty: The reactive runtime calls this when a value read by the Resource request changes. It schedules a refresh and groups repeated notifications into that scheduled refresh. Application code changes the input, such as userId.value, and lets the runtime send this notification; it does not need to call markDirty().
Nothing; a refresh is scheduled.
onDependencyDisconnected: The reactive runtime calls this when an input used by the Resource has been disposed and can no longer supply a value. It schedules another request even without an ordinary input change. If that request fails while reading the disposed input, the failure becomes visible in the Resource error state. Application code disposes the input and lets the runtime call this method.
Nothing; a forced refresh is scheduled.
mutate: Replaces the visible data locally (optimistic update, server push, cache write). Any in-flight request is superseded so its late result cannot overwrite this value, and a new TTL window starts. An updater receives the current success data or `undefined`; function-typed data must be passed through an updater.
mutate.next: New data, or an `IResourceUpdater` `(previous) => next`; an updater throw leaves the state unchanged.
This resource, for chaining; after `dispose()` it throws `RESOURCE_DISPOSED`.
subscribe: Delivers the current state now and after every change to code that does not run inside the reactive graph (plain scripts, devtools, Node). Subscribing counts as observation, so it can start and keep requests alive. Listener throws are reported through `runtime.reportError` and do not stop delivery.
subscribe.listener: Function `(state) => void` receiving each `IResourceState`; a non-function throws `INVALID_OPTION`.
An idempotent unsubscribe function; `dispose()` unsubscribes automatically.
select: Creates a reactive value derived from the success data; it is `undefined` while the resource is not in `success`, and it is disposed together with the resource.
select.selector: Function `(data) => result`; a non-function throws `INVALID_OPTION`.
An `IReactiveComputed` from `@migaia/reactive`; read it through `value` inside effects.
[Symbol.dispose]: Same as `dispose()`, so a `using` declaration ends the resource when its block exits.
Nothing; the resource is terminal.
dispose: Ends the resource: cancels the request, removes dependencies and subscriptions. Calling it again does nothing; afterwards data reads and operations throw `RESOURCE_DISPOSED`, while `disposed`, `refreshing` and `observed` stay readable. The runtime is not disposed.
debugName: Label shown in reactive diagnostics and in request error context.
Not set: diagnostics show no label.
ttl: Success lifetime in milliseconds; positive finite lifetimes revalidate on an expired read. `0` and `Infinity` disable time expiration, but changed dependencies, including after suspension, still trigger refetching. Must be ≥ 0 or `Infinity`.
`Infinity`: fresh until a dependency changes or `refetch()` is called.
autoStart: Start the first request in the constructor.
`true`: starts immediately unless the initial snapshot is fresh.
staleWhileRevalidate: Keep showing expired success data while the refresh runs (`refreshing` is `true`) instead of switching to `pending`.
`false`: an expired value is replaced by `pending`.
retry: Retry policy after a failure: a non-negative integer of extra attempts, or `(failureCount, error) => boolean` deciding each retry. A Promise thrown for Suspense does not count as a failure. A throwing policy or invalid result yields `INVALID_OPTION`; the triggering fetch failure stays reachable through `cause` or `errors`, and existing external identity is preserved.
`0`: no retry.
retryDelay: Wait before each retry in milliseconds, or `(failureCount, error) => ms` for backoff. Throwing callbacks or invalid results retain the fetch failure in `cause` or `errors`; policy errors receive `INVALID_OPTION` unless already classified externally.
`0`: retry immediately.
Pass a function when the server is overloaded or rate limited: immediate retries add load at the worst moment. `failureCount` starts at 1, so `1000 * 2 ** (failureCount - 1)` waits 1 s, 2 s, 4 s. You can also read `error` and wait longer for a 429 than for a network error. A plain number is enough when failures are short network blips.
keepAlive: Keep upstream dependencies connected while nothing reads `state`, so changes are still tracked.
`false`: unobserved resources disconnect upstream.
initialSnapshot: Success snapshot from `dehydrate()` (server rendering or persistence) used as the initial state; it is revalidated when expired.
Not set: start from `idle`.
scheduler: Clock and timers for `ttl`, `updatedAt`, `expiresAt` and retry delays; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
`systemScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.
symbols.advanced:
Load data that depends on reactive inputs (user id, filters): changing an input cancels the old request and starts a new one, and an old answer can never overwrite the new state.
Feed React Suspense and error boundaries through `read()`.
Cache with a lifetime (`ttl`), keep showing old data while refreshing (`staleWhileRevalidate`), and restore server-rendered data with `dehydrate()` / `hydrate()`.
One-off loads without inputs, cancellation, retry or expiry (for example static config at startup): a plain `await` is simpler.
parameters: fetcher: IResourceFetcher<T>
runtime: IRuntime
options: IResourceOptions<T> (optional)
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this class.
examples:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { Resource } from '@migaia/resource'

const value = new Resource(({ generation }) => generation, createRuntime(), { autoStart: false })
console.log(value.peekState().status) // idle：请求函数还没被调用
console.log(await value.promise)
value.reset()
console.log(value.peekState().status) // idle：同一个实例，没有缓存数据
console.log(await value.promise) // 更新的 generation
value.dispose()

members.description: Force a new request. Explicit refetches do not reuse a fresh cache entry; passive `promise`/`read()` consumers do.

members.description: Cancel only the active generation; the Resource remains reusable.

members.name: hydrate
members.description: Rebases captured durations into this scheduler; transport/storage elapsed time is caller-owned.

members.name: mutate
members.description: Replaces the visible data locally (optimistic update, server push, cache write). Supersedes any in-flight request so its late result cannot overwrite this value, and starts a fresh TTL window. An updater receives the current success data (or `undefined`). members.name: subscribe
members.description: Calls `listener` with the current state now and after every state change, for consumers that do not run inside the reactive graph. sections.content:
Load data that depends on reactive inputs (user id, filters): changing an input cancels the old request and starts a new one, and an old answer can never overwrite the new state.
Feed React Suspense and error boundaries through `read()`.
Cache with a lifetime (`ttl`), keep showing old data while refreshing (`staleWhileRevalidate`), and restore server-rendered data with `dehydrate()` / `hydrate()`.

declaredConfiguration.name: debugName
declaredConfiguration.description: Human-readable owner label used in reactive diagnostics and request error context.

declaredConfiguration.name: ttl
declaredConfiguration.description: Successful values remain fresh for this many milliseconds. `0` and `Infinity` keep them fresh until a dependency changes or `refetch()` is called.

declaredConfiguration.name: autoStart
declaredConfiguration.description: Start the first request in the constructor. Defaults to true.

declaredConfiguration.name: staleWhileRevalidate
declaredConfiguration.description: Keep stale success data visible while a background refresh runs.

declaredConfiguration.name: retry
declaredConfiguration.description: Retry count or predicate. Suspense Promise throws do not count.

declaredConfiguration.name: retryDelay
declaredConfiguration.description: Milliseconds to wait before the next retry, fixed or computed from the failure number and error. Defaults to 0.

declaredConfiguration.name: keepAlive
declaredConfiguration.description: Keep upstream reactive edges while no state consumer exists.

declaredConfiguration.name: initialSnapshot
declaredConfiguration.description: SSR/persisted success cache used before optional revalidation.

declaredConfiguration.name: scheduler
declaredConfiguration.description: Supplies one scheduler for TTL, `updatedAt`, `expiresAt`, and retry delays. Defaults to utils/scheduler `systemScheduler`. Missing host capabilities fail immediately instead of silently falling back to microtasks.

guidance.id: 取消后显示已取消而不是错误
guidance.heading: 取消后显示已取消而不是错误

blocks.text: 用户点了“取消导出”，界面却弹出“导出失败”，因为取消和失败走进了同一个 `catch`。
手写的状态通常只有“加载中、成功、失败”三种，取消只能塞进“失败”，再靠比较错误信息字符串来区分。
`cancel()` 把还在等待的请求变成 `cancelled` 状态，`state.error` 是原生 `AbortError`。资源本身没有被释放，之后调用 `refetch()` 可以重新开始。
输出：

blocks.code:
状态：cancelled
原因：AbortError
第 2 次导出完成

blocks.text: 取消后状态是 `cancelled`，原因是 `AbortError`；随后 `refetch()` 正常完成，输出“第 2 次导出完成”。
`cancelled` 是单独的状态，界面可以按 `ResourceStatus.cancelled` 显示“已取消”。取消后再读取 `state` 不会自动重启请求，只有显式调用 `refetch()` 才会。

函数式构建 `Resource`。`setup` 只同步执行一次，拿到 `{ runtime, scheduler, signal, debugName, onDispose }`，返回 fetcher；数据类型从 fetcher 推导。`options` 就是 `IResourceOptions` 加上可选的 `runtime`（默认 `@migaia/reactive` 的 `defaultRuntime`）。

items: `onDispose` 注册的清理在 `dispose()` 时按注册的逆序执行，`signal` 同时中止。
`setup` 抛错、返回值不是函数（`RESOURCE_SETUP_INVALID`）或选项非法时，先中止 `signal`、逆序执行已注册清理，再重抛原始错误；清理失败挂在 `errors` 上。
`setup` 返回后再调用 `onDispose` 会抛 `RESOURCE_SETUP_CLOSED`，避免泄漏。

type IResourceOptions<T = unknown> = {
  debugName?: string
  ttl?: number // 默认 Infinity（永不过期，除非依赖变化/手动刷新）
  autoStart?: boolean // 默认 true
  staleWhileRevalidate?: boolean // 默认 false
  retry?: IResourceRetryPolicy // 默认 0（不重试）
  retryDelay?: number | ((failureCount: number, error: unknown) => number) // 默认 0
  keepAlive?: boolean // 默认 false
  initialSnapshot?: IResourceCacheSnapshot<T>
  scheduler?: IScheduler // 默认 @migaia/utils/scheduler 的 systemScheduler
}

type IResourceRetryPolicy = number | ((failureCount: number, error: unknown) => boolean)

blocks.text: 逐项语义与校验：

items: `ttl?: number` —— 成功值的新鲜时长（毫秒）。`0` 与 `Infinity`（默认）表示永不因时间过期，只会因依赖变化/`refetch()`/`invalidate()` 而刷新。非 `Infinity` 时必须是有限非负数，否则抛贴 `INVALID_OPTION` 码的 `RangeError`；`updatedAt + ttl` 运算结果非有限（数值溢出）同样抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。
`autoStart?: boolean` —— 是否在构造函数内立即发起首次请求。默认 `true`。若同时提供了新鲜的 `initialSnapshot`，即使 `autoStart: true` 也不会立即再发一次请求。
`staleWhileRevalidate?: boolean` —— 默认 `false`。为 `true` 时，刷新期间继续展示旧的 `success` 数据（附带 `refreshing: true`），而不是回退到 `pending`。

`retry?: number | (failureCount, error) => boolean` —— 固定次数或自定义判断函数。数字必须是非负整数，否则抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。函数形式在每次失败后被调用一次，用第几次失败（从 1 开始）与错误对象决定是否重试；Suspense 抛出的 thenable 值不计入失败次数（`fetcher` 内部同步抛出一个 thenable 是被当作"需要等待后重跑"处理的，不是一次真实失败）。

`retryDelay?: number | (failureCount, error) => number` —— 固定延迟或按失败次数计算的函数，单位毫秒。数字必须是有限非负数；函数返回非数字时以原生 `TypeError`/`INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝；返回负数/非有限数字则为 `RangeError`/`INVALID_OPTION`。策略抛错或返回非法值时保留触发重试的 fetch 主因，原生策略 Error 尽量原样附码，已有外部身份不改写。
`keepAlive?: boolean` —— 默认 `false`：长时间无人观察 `state` 会在下一个 idle 时机自动休眠（断开上游边、保留依赖版本与缓存），下次读取核对版本；依赖未变且缓存新鲜时继续复用，变更时重拉。设为 `true` 时禁用自动休眠。
`initialSnapshot?: IResourceCacheSnapshot<T>` —— SSR/持久化恢复用的初始成功快照；构造期即 `hydrate()`，格式非法抛 `INVALID_SNAPSHOT`（详见快照类型）。

`scheduler?: IScheduler`（`@migaia/utils/scheduler`）—— 时间域与排程来源：TTL/`updatedAt`/`expiresAt`/重试延迟全部走同一个调度器，默认 `@migaia/utils/scheduler` 的 `systemScheduler`（单调时钟）。传入的值必须满足 `{ now(): number; schedule(cb, delayMs): IScheduledTask }` 契约（内部用 `snapshotScheduler` 校验），否则抛 `INVALID_OPTION`；缺宿主能力时该 scheduler 在被调用时才 fail-fast，不会静默降级成微任务。

guidance.id: 底层依赖-lifecycle-原语的使用方式
guidance.heading: 底层依赖：lifecycle 原语的使用方式

blocks.text: `Resource` 内部直接组合 `@migaia/lifecycle` 与 `@migaia/reactive` 的原语，理解这层有助于诊断边界行为：

items: `createGenerationController()`（来自 `@migaia/lifecycle`）——每次发起请求都调用 `begin()` 开一代新请求；`refetch()`/`invalidate()`/依赖变化都会使旧一代失效（`supersede()`），只有 `isCurrent(token)` 为真的那一代结果才会写入 `state`。`dispose()` 时调用其 `dispose()` 终结控制器。
`createTerminalController()`（来自 `@migaia/lifecycle`）——驱动 `Resource` 自身的容器存活轴（`open → closing → terminal`）；`disposed` getter 直接读它的 `lifecycle === 'terminal'`。
`probeThenable()` / `assimilateCapturedThen()`（来自 `@migaia/utils/function`）——用于安全探测 `fetcher` 同步抛出的值是否是 thenable（Suspense 抛 Promise 模式），只读一次 `.then`，避免 hostile getter 被读取两次或异常被吞掉。
`systemScheduler`（来自 `@migaia/utils/scheduler`）/ `snapshotScheduler()`（来自 `@migaia/lifecycle`）——`scheduler` 选项的默认值与校验函数；TTL 到期判定、重试延迟计时都通过它，不直接使用宿主 `setTimeout`/`Date.now`。
`internalRuntimeOf()` / `createTrackedObserver()`（来自 `@migaia/reactive/extension`）——Resource作为IObserver接入图，仅获得绑定自身的追踪、挂起、重验证与idle能力；依赖集合由reactive内部维护，请求、取消与资源释放仍由Resource负责。

blocks.code: import { RESOURCE_SOURCE, ResourceErrorCode, type IResourceErrorCode } from '@migaia/resource'

blocks.text: 稳定错误码表，9 个码，唯一声明处 `src/error-code.ts`，包自身错误的 `source` 为 `'@migaia/resource'`；已有完整外部身份的错误保留原包身份。 `RESOURCE_SOURCE` 导出这个稳定 source，跨包分类错误时应比较它与 `ResourceErrorCode`，不要复制字符串字面量。

rows: 在已 `dispose()` 的 `Resource` 上调用任意读取/操作方法
请求停止时的原生 AbortError；Resource 主动取消时与 signal.reason 同一，lifecycle replacement reason 保留在 cause
调用方显式 `cancel()` 导致当前 pending 请求被取消，`state` 落入 `cancelled` 所携带的 `DOMException`
请求取消已完成状态收敛，但取消期间的 timer/listener cleanup 失败
读取 `promise`，或在 `pending`/`idle` 状态下调用 `read()`/`peek()` 时，没有正在进行或已缓存的 Promise 可返回
非 v2 快照、负/非有限时长（remaining 可为 null）、本地重建时间戳溢出或 getter 失败
构造/调用时传入的选项（`ttl`、`retry`、`retryDelay`、`scheduler` 等）不满足取值要求
`fetcher` 抛出用于 Suspense 的值，但探测其 `.then` 时 getter 本身抛错，无法判定是否为 thenable
重试耗尽后的未分类 fetch 失败；原生错误尽量保留身份，冻结错误/非 Error 值保留在 cause，已有外部身份不改写

blocks.text: `requestAborted`/`requestCancelled` 抛出/落入状态的值始终是原生 `DOMException`（`name === 'AbortError'`），调用方通常按 `error.name === 'AbortError'` 判定并静默处理，而不是当作真实失败；`code` 只作为附加字段挂上，不改变类型。调用方应始终以 `error.code === ResourceErrorCode.xxx` 判别，不要硬编码码值字符串。

guidance.id: 高阶组合示例-1-suspense-兼容读取-error-boundary
guidance.heading: 高阶组合示例 · 1. Suspense 兼容读取 + Error Boundary

blocks.text: 1. 依赖追踪只认第一个 `await` 之前的同步读取。 `await` 之后再读响应式值不会被追踪；需要时先把值读进局部变量，或者把读取挪进一个 `Computed`。 2. 请求函数要把 `signal` 交给真正可取消的 I/O（例如 `fetch(url, { signal })`）。否则取消只是让 `Resource` 忽略这次结果，底层请求仍会跑完。 3. `refetch()` 总是发起新请求；被动读取（`state`、`promise`、`read()`）只在 `idle` 或数据过期时才发起。 想强制刷新就调用 `refetch()` 或 `invalidate()`。 4. 不再使用时要调用 `dispose()`，否则依赖登记和进行中的请求会一直留着。释放后读取数据和发起请求都抛 `RESOURCE_DISPOSED`；`disposed`、`refreshing`、`observed` 仍可读，`markDirty()`、`onDependencyDisconnected()` 和再次 `dispose()` 是安全的空操作。`dispose()` 不会释放传入的 `runtime`。 5. 默认 `keepAlive: false`。 没人读取 `state` 时，`Resource` 会和上游断开但保留依赖版本与缓存；下次读取时依赖没变且缓存有效就复用原值和 Promise，依赖变了就重新请求。需要“没人看也保持连接”时传 `keepAlive: true`。 6. `cancel()` 之后被动读取不会自动重启。 正在加载的请求被取消后状态是 `cancelled`；后台刷新被取消时保留旧数据并清除 `refreshing`。只有显式 `refetch()` 会重新开始。

`Resource` 自己产生的错误带 `source === RESOURCE_SOURCE`（`@migaia/resource`）和 `ResourceErrorCode` 里的 `code`。已经有完整 `source`/`code` 的外部错误保持原样；没有分类的加载失败在重试结束后附加 `FETCH_FAILED`，原生错误保持原类型，不可修改的错误保留在 `cause` 链上。重试策略本身出错时附加 `INVALID_OPTION`，触发它的加载错误仍可从错误链找到。取消和释放产生的错误是原生 `DOMException`（`name === 'AbortError'`），按 `error.name` 判断即可。
