symbols.name: ResourceErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Table of the stable error codes of this package. Each key names one failure; the values are the strings found on `error.code`.
symbols.core:
resourceDisposed: `RESOURCE_DISPOSED`: a member was used after `dispose()`; create a new resource.
requestAborted: `REQUEST_ABORTED`: Resource-initiated cancellation uses the same native AbortError as its signal reason and rejection. Lifecycle replacement can supply a different signal reason, retained on the `cause` of the Resource AbortError.
requestCancelled: `REQUEST_CANCELLED`: the `AbortError` stored in the `cancelled` state after `cancel()`.
cancellationCleanupFailed: `CANCELLATION_CLEANUP_FAILED`: a timer or listener could not be cleaned after cancellation; the resource still counts as cancelled.
noActivePromise: `NO_ACTIVE_PROMISE`: no request Promise is available, including a valid `autoStart: false` idle `peek()`; inspect `peekState()` or explicitly start a request.
invalidSnapshot: `INVALID_SNAPSHOT`: snapshot version is not `2`, durations are negative/non-finite (only remaining lifetime permits `null`), or rebased local timestamps overflow. Getter failures retain their cause.
invalidOption: `INVALID_OPTION`: an option such as `ttl`, `retry` or `retryDelay` is invalid; fix the options.
fetchFailed: `FETCH_FAILED`: final unclassified fetch failure after retries. Native errors keep identity when writable; immutable errors and primitive values stay reachable through `cause`. Existing foreign source/code is preserved.
setupInvalid: `RESOURCE_SETUP_INVALID`: `createResource()` got a non-function setup, or setup returned a non-function; registered cleanups already ran. Return a fetcher from setup.
setupClosed: `RESOURCE_SETUP_CLOSED`: `onDispose()` was called after setup returned, for example from an async callback; register cleanups synchronously during setup.
suspenseProbeFailed: `SUSPENSE_PROBE_FAILED`: a value thrown by the fetcher has a throwing `then` getter; both errors are kept in `errors`.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.

members.name: resourceDisposed
members.description: Rejects operations guarded by `#assertUsable()` after the `Resource` is disposed. This prevents * reading stale state after tracking stops. Repeated `dispose()` remains a no-op, and lifecycle * inspection getters remain available. Use a new `Resource` for further data reads or * operations.

members.name: requestAborted
members.description: Identifies the native AbortError for a stopped request. Resource-initiated cancellation uses * this same error as signal.reason; lifecycle-owned replacement reasons remain on its cause. * Callers usually recognize `error.name === 'AbortError'` and handle cancellation quietly.

members.name: requestCancelled
members.description: Identifies the `DOMException` in the `cancelled` state when explicit `cancel()` cancels a * pending request. Preserves the native `AbortError` type. Unlike `REQUEST_ABORTED`, which * identifies request rejection, this code identifies explicit cancellation state.

members.name: cancellationCleanupFailed
members.description: Reports timer or listener cleanup failure after request cancellation converges state. * `REQUEST_CANCELLED` identifies the `AbortError` stored in the cancelled state. This code * separates cleanup failures from state errors. Record the cleanup failure and continue treating * the `Resource` as cancelled.

members.name: noActivePromise
members.description: Reports a missing active or cached Promise when reading `promise` or materializing `pending` or * `idle`. This usually indicates inconsistent intermediate state. Check for internal state * changes that bypass the normal `refetch()` or `invalidate()` paths.

members.name: invalidSnapshot
members.description: Rejects a version other than 2, negative/nonfinite age or remaining lifetime, or durations that * cannot be rebased into finite local scheduler timestamps. Accessor failures retain their cause. * `remainingTtlMs: null` means unbounded lifetime. Migrate old absolute-time snapshots * explicitly; their sender clock origin cannot be inferred on the receiver.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Rejects construction or operation options such as invalid `ttl`, retry counts, or `retryDelay`. * Validation rejects invalid configuration before it enters the state machine. Correct the * supplied options. Retry policy failures retain the triggering fetch error in their chain.

members.name: suspenseProbeFailed
members.description: Reports a throwing `.then` getter on a value the `fetcher` throws for Suspense. The probe * cannot determine whether the value is a thenable. `AggregateError.errors` retains both the * original thrown value and getter failure by identity. Enforces `error-codes.md`. Inspect the * hostile getter instead of silently retrying it as an ordinary fetch failure.

members.name: fetchFailed
members.description: A fetcher failure exhausted retry without an existing semantic identity. Mutable native errors * retain type, identity, and stack; immutable errors/non-Error values stay reachable on cause. * Already classified failures retain their originating package. Inspect the request failure * instead of treating it as cancellation or an invalid option.

members.name: setupInvalid
members.description: `createResource()` received a non-function setup, or setup returned something other than a * fetcher function. Registered setup cleanups have already run. Pass a setup callback that * returns `(ctx) => data | Promise<data>`.

members.name: setupClosed
members.description: `onDispose()` was called on a setup context after setup returned (for example from an escaped * context inside an async callback). The cleanup is rejected instead of leaking. Register every * cleanup synchronously inside setup.

symbols.name: ResourceFetchStatus
symbols.purpose: Values of `resource.fetchStatus`: whether a request is running right now, independent of the data shown (a success state can be refreshing in the background).
symbols.core:
idle: `idle`: no request is running.
fetching: `fetching`: a request runs, with or without cached data.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.
examples:
import { Resource, type IResourceOptions } from '@migaia/resource'
import type { IRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'

class Resource<T> implements IObserver, IDisposable {
  constructor(fetcher: IResourceFetcher<T>, runtime: IRuntime, options?: IResourceOptions<T>)

  readonly runtime: IRuntime
  debugName?: string
  readonly deps: ReadonlySet<IObservable>
  readonly depVersions: ReadonlyMap<IObservable, number>

  readonly state: IResourceState<T>
  readonly promise: Promise<T>
  readonly disposed: boolean
  readonly refreshing: boolean
  readonly fetchStatus: ResourceFetchStatus
  readonly isStale: boolean
  readonly observed: boolean

  read(): T
  peek(): T
  peekState(): IResourceState<T>
  reset(): void
  refetch(): Promise<T>
  invalidate(): Promise<T>
  cancel(): void
  dehydrate(): IResourceCacheSnapshot<T> | undefined
  hydrate(snapshot: IResourceCacheSnapshot<T>): void
  dispose(): void

  // IObserver 接口成员：由 @migaia/reactive 的依赖图在内部调用，一般不需要手动调用
  markDirty(): void
  onDependencyDisconnected(): void
}

symbols.name: ResourceStatus
symbols.purpose: Values of `state.status`: the five states of the data state machine (`idle`, `pending`, `success`, `error`, `cancelled`).
symbols.core:
idle: `idle`: nothing requested yet, or after `reset()`.
pending: `pending`: the first data is loading; show a loading view.

guidance.id: 取消后显示已取消而不是错误
guidance.heading: 取消后显示已取消而不是错误

blocks.text: 用户点了“取消导出”，界面却弹出“导出失败”，因为取消和失败走进了同一个 `catch`。
手写的状态通常只有“加载中、成功、失败”三种，取消只能塞进“失败”，再靠比较错误信息字符串来区分。
`cancel()` 把还在等待的请求变成 `cancelled` 状态，`state.error` 是原生 `AbortError`。资源本身没有被释放，之后调用 `refetch()` 可以重新开始。
输出：

blocks.code:
状态：cancelled
原因：AbortError
第 2 次导出完成

blocks.text: 取消后状态是 `cancelled`，原因是 `AbortError`；随后 `refetch()` 正常完成，输出“第 2 次导出完成”。
`cancelled` 是单独的状态，界面可以按 `ResourceStatus.cancelled` 显示“已取消”。取消后再读取 `state` 不会自动重启请求，只有显式调用 `refetch()` 才会。

endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.

endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.

self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.

providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.

authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.

probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.

contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.

report: Synchronous callback receives background or contained failures as error; no return is consumed, and failure handling stays with the original runtime reporter owner.
report.error: Original background or secondary failure supplied by the runtime owner.

Omitted: defaultRpcReporter reports to console.error.

symbols.name: captureRpcBinaryData
symbols.purpose: Synchronously captures the original protocol graph and backing references at the caller-selected snapshot point. Pair with restoreRpcBinary for a complete inline round trip; preparation can finish later.
symbols.core:
message: Normalized IRpcRuntimeEnvelope from the canonical runtime constructor or strict normalizer, containing actual business binary roots.
storage: Application-selected inline or native RpcBinaryStorage matching the negotiated carrier capability.
limit: Optional binary allocation budget, default `16777216` bytes: native storage charges the full backing; inline storage charges offset plus visible bytes. Codec/prehash and the outer carrier own any complete physical-frame limit.
digest: Optional IRpcBinaryDigest; native mode requires it. The asynchronous callback receives each complete original ArrayBuffer and resolves SHA-256 text; rejection fails preparation.
codec: Optional application-held IRpcBinaryDataCodec owns representation encoding and optional inline capture; its throws fail the original preparation; the native prehash path checks encoded physical size, while other representations retain their codec or outer-carrier limit responsibility.
IRpcCapturedBinaryData; malformed graph, backing or budget throws INVALID_ENVELOPE synchronously.
parameters: message: IRpcRuntimeEnvelope
storage: RpcBinaryStorage
limit: number (optional)
digest: IRpcBinaryDigest (optional)
codec: IRpcBinaryDataCodec (optional)
symbols.returns: IRpcCapturedBinaryData

symbols.name: prepareRpcBinary
symbols.purpose: Captures one canonical runtime envelope before yielding, then finishes manifest encoding and complete-backing digests. Pair with restoreRpcBinary; no endpoint, replay or execution state is changed. This entry loads the canonical parser lazily without changing synchronous capture or digest ownership.
symbols.core:
message: Normalized IRpcRuntimeEnvelope from the canonical runtime constructor or strict normalizer, containing actual business binary roots.
storage: Application-selected inline or native RpcBinaryStorage matching the negotiated carrier capability.
limit: Optional binary allocation budget, default `16777216` bytes: native storage charges the full backing; inline storage charges offset plus visible bytes. Codec/prehash and the outer carrier own any complete physical-frame limit.
digest: Optional IRpcBinaryDigest; native mode requires it. The asynchronous callback receives each complete original ArrayBuffer and resolves SHA-256 text; rejection fails preparation.
codec: Optional application-held IRpcBinaryDataCodec owns representation encoding and optional inline capture; its throws fail the original preparation; the native prehash path checks encoded physical size, while other representations retain their codec or outer-carrier limit responsibility.
Promise of IRpcPreparedBinary; failures reject with native coded INVALID_ENVELOPE and retained cause.
parameters: message: IRpcRuntimeEnvelope
storage: RpcBinaryStorage
limit: number (optional)
digest: IRpcBinaryDigest (optional)
codec: IRpcBinaryDataCodec (optional)
symbols.returns: Promise<IRpcPreparedBinary>

guidance.id: 错误树-原生类型与-json-rpc-转换
guidance.heading: 错误树、原生类型与 JSON-RPC 转换

blocks.text: serializeRpcError(value, options, metadata?) 的 value 和 options.report 必填；report 接收 `{ pointer, field, error }`，用于被跳过的属性读取或数据规范化失败，不能用次数统计全部截断。它按 source、code、name、message、stack，加可选 cause/errors/data/route/truncated 输出有界错误树；无身份错误使用 unknown/UNKNOWN。跨 realm 原生类型名和发送方 stack 被保留，deserializeRpcError 校验后还原 Error、RangeError、TypeError 等类型，不重新制造发送方 stack。

RpcWireErrorLimit：maxNesting 48、maxEmbeddingDepth 16、maxNodes 1024、maxStringBytes 65536、maxBytes 1048576。超预算或文本截断会裁掉内容并标 truncated；不保证每次裁剪都 report。循环边被裁去；reachRpcError(value, { report }) 遍历 cause、errors 与 cleanup 错误并按引用去重，RpcErrorReachLimit.maxObjects 为 4096。

normalizeRpcSerializedError(value, options?) 的 options 默认空对象；unknownFields 为 reject（默认）或 ignore，onUnknownField 可选、无默认 callback。deserializeRpcError(value, options?, routes?) 采用相同规则，routes 可接调用方 WeakMap 的 set 能力保存已接纳路由。序列化读取固定字段，某字段 getter 失败可报告并保留根、设置 truncated；不承诺读取错误对象的所有任意自有属性。
第三参数 metadata 的 summaries/routes 都可选，是按 Error 引用查询的 WeakMap get 能力。summaries 可给 code/message 对外摘要并隐藏内部 cause；preserveSerializedError: true 才保留该节点既有后代。routes 提供有界路由诊断，不授予控制权限。

toJsonRpcError(wire, code) 把错误树放入 error.data.migaiaWireError；整数 code 由调用方选定，不默认等于 wire code。fromJsonRpcError 也接受无扩展的普通 JSON-RPC 错误，使用 foreignSource `jsonrpc-2.0` 与整数 code 的字符串。RpcJsonRpcWireError.dataKey 维护扩展键。独立适配器使用自己的 source/code，可直接安装 utils 并用 attachErrorIdentity 保留原生错误；不要冒用官方 RPC 身份。
classifyRpcContractError(error) 只按本地对象引用识别本包签发错误，返回对外 code/message；复制或远端还原的错误返回 undefined。远端 source/code 是诊断身份，不证明本地来源，也不授予重试或控制权。

schema/wire-error 只提供结构校验起点，不等于有界 normalizer。独立实现还须执行 x-migaia-limits、canonical base64url、surrogate 等规则；Schema 的 additionalProperties 与 normalizer 默认 reject 并不等价。用其它语言实现原生对端还需长度前缀、握手和 runtime 信封；JSON-RPC 桥还需其四个扩展方法，由 rpc-process 的协议层负责，不由本包完成连接。

symbols.name: deserializeRpcError
symbols.purpose: Validates a complete received error tree before restoring native Error subclasses and original serialized stacks. It does not convert wire properties into local authority.
symbols.core:
value: Untrusted serialized tree received from the peer or produced by serializeRpcError.
options: Optional IRpcWireErrorOptions; defaults reject unknown fields.
routes: Optional caller-owned WeakMap set port retaining admitted node-only diagnostic routes on restored Error references.
Restored native Error tree; malformed input throws INVALID_WIRE_ERROR before restoration.
unknownFields: Chooses rejection or ignored admission of unknown received error-node fields.
`reject`; unknown fields fail validation.
Use reject for strict received-error schemas; it is the default. Use ignore only when additive fields may be dropped. The observer does not choose or change that policy.
onUnknownField: Optional synchronous application callback receives JSON pointer and unknown field name; returns void. A throw propagates from normalization.
Omitted; no observer is called. The default unknownFields policy still rejects unknown error-node fields.
Use it with unknownFields ignore to record fields dropped from a newer peer’s error. Omit it for no observer; the default reject policy still rejects unknown fields.

options: IRpcWireErrorOptions (optional)
routes: IRpcErrorWireRouteStore (optional)
symbols.returns: Error

guidance.id: 保留原生错误类型与远端原因堆栈
guidance.heading: 保留原生错误类型与远端原因堆栈

blocks.text: 远端操作因范围错误而抛出类型错误，接收方需要两层语义码和原始堆栈，才能辨认失败操作及根因。
只发送错误消息会丢掉原因树、原生类型与堆栈，用该文字在本地重建错误，又会生成接收端堆栈并掩盖原始失败位置。
`serializeRpcError` 投影有界带码树，`deserializeRpcError` 校验后恢复原生类型，须提供 `report` 回调以保留无法读取或规范化字段的失败。
`serializeRpcError(value, options)` 两项必填；options.report 是必填同步回调，本例把每个失败记录放入 reports，没有额外默认报告器。source/code 是错误的语义身份，cause 是原始原因。deserializeRpcError 的 options 可省略，未知字段默认 reject。
输出：

blocks.code:
true true
true true
REQUEST LIMIT 0

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `true true`、`true true`、`REQUEST LIMIT 0`，往返保留两种原生类型、两份堆栈字符串和语义码，未报告字段失败。
恢复会创建新的错误对象，不保留跨边界对象身份；错误树有界，可携带 `cause`、聚合错误子项和截断标记，这些函数不建立连接或执行请求。

guidance.id: 错误树-原生类型与-json-rpc-转换
guidance.heading: 错误树、原生类型与 JSON-RPC 转换

blocks.text: serializeRpcError(value, options, metadata?) 的 value 和 options.report 必填；report 接收 `{ pointer, field, error }`，用于被跳过的属性读取或数据规范化失败，不能用次数统计全部截断。它按 source、code、name、message、stack，加可选 cause/errors/data/route/truncated 输出有界错误树；无身份错误使用 unknown/UNKNOWN。跨 realm 原生类型名和发送方 stack 被保留，deserializeRpcError 校验后还原 Error、RangeError、TypeError 等类型，不重新制造发送方 stack。

RpcWireErrorLimit：maxNesting 48、maxEmbeddingDepth 16、maxNodes 1024、maxStringBytes 65536、maxBytes 1048576。超预算或文本截断会裁掉内容并标 truncated；不保证每次裁剪都 report。循环边被裁去；reachRpcError(value, { report }) 遍历 cause、errors 与 cleanup 错误并按引用去重，RpcErrorReachLimit.maxObjects 为 4096。

normalizeRpcSerializedError(value, options?) 的 options 默认空对象；unknownFields 为 reject（默认）或 ignore，onUnknownField 可选、无默认 callback。deserializeRpcError(value, options?, routes?) 采用相同规则，routes 可接调用方 WeakMap 的 set 能力保存已接纳路由。序列化读取固定字段，某字段 getter 失败可报告并保留根、设置 truncated；不承诺读取错误对象的所有任意自有属性。
第三参数 metadata 的 summaries/routes 都可选，是按 Error 引用查询的 WeakMap get 能力。summaries 可给 code/message 对外摘要并隐藏内部 cause；preserveSerializedError: true 才保留该节点既有后代。routes 提供有界路由诊断，不授予控制权限。

toJsonRpcError(wire, code) 把错误树放入 error.data.migaiaWireError；整数 code 由调用方选定，不默认等于 wire code。fromJsonRpcError 也接受无扩展的普通 JSON-RPC 错误，使用 foreignSource `jsonrpc-2.0` 与整数 code 的字符串。RpcJsonRpcWireError.dataKey 维护扩展键。独立适配器使用自己的 source/code，可直接安装 utils 并用 attachErrorIdentity 保留原生错误；不要冒用官方 RPC 身份。
classifyRpcContractError(error) 只按本地对象引用识别本包签发错误，返回对外 code/message；复制或远端还原的错误返回 undefined。远端 source/code 是诊断身份，不证明本地来源，也不授予重试或控制权。

schema/wire-error 只提供结构校验起点，不等于有界 normalizer。独立实现还须执行 x-migaia-limits、canonical base64url、surrogate 等规则；Schema 的 additionalProperties 与 normalizer 默认 reject 并不等价。用其它语言实现原生对端还需长度前缀、握手和 runtime 信封；JSON-RPC 桥还需其四个扩展方法，由 rpc-process 的协议层负责，不由本包完成连接。

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
source: Stable semantic package source copied from the original error or supplied by the transport context.
code: Stable semantic error code retained across serialization; classify it together with source.
name: Original native error class name or application-assigned diagnostic identity.
message: Diagnostic message preserved with the owning failure; never use it as an authorization decision.
stack: Original serialized stack text; restoration preserves it rather than regenerating a local stack.
cause: Optional serialized primary cause node preserving the original causal chain.
errors: Optional ordered serialized aggregate children preserving original failure order.
data: Portable data carried by the owning wire node; never replaces its semantic discriminator.
truncated: True marks a deliberately bounded error projection; absence means this node was not marked truncated.
The serializer omitted information to stay within bounds.
route: Optional one-to-four original node IDs, each 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters, held only as diagnostics.

guidance.id: 报告不可读字段并继续生成线上错误
guidance.heading: 报告不可读字段并继续生成线上错误

blocks.text: 诊断序列化遇到消息访问器会抛错的错误对象，丢弃整条诊断会同时掩盖原操作与新的字段读取失败。
构建 JSON 对象时直接读取属性，会让访问器异常逃出日志路径，若忽略该异常，又会丢失字段被省略的依据。
`serializeRpcError` 捕获支持字段，并把被省略的读取失败交给 `report`；本例先保存错误堆栈，再设置会抛错的消息访问器，收集报告记录供检查。
options.report 的 entry 包含 pointer、field、error；本例 error 是 message getter 的原始失败。第三参数 metadata 未提供，不启用调用方摘要或路由表。Object.defineProperty 是构造本地失败样本，不是 normalizer 的配置项。
输出：

blocks.code:
Error UNKNOWN
1 message true

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `Error UNKNOWN`、`1 message true`，仍返回线上错误，报告指出不可读的消息字段并保留原始 `TypeError`。
`report` 必填，同步收到指针、字段和原始失败；这些记录是本地诊断依据，不是额外线上字段，未编码错误使用未知来源与错误码兜底，不可读字段遵守有界序列化策略。

guidance.heading: 错误树、原生类型与 JSON-RPC 转换

blocks.text: serializeRpcError(value, options, metadata?) 的 value 和 options.report 必填；report 接收 `{ pointer, field, error }`，用于被跳过的属性读取或数据规范化失败，不能用次数统计全部截断。它按 source、code、name、message、stack，加可选 cause/errors/data/route/truncated 输出有界错误树；无身份错误使用 unknown/UNKNOWN。跨 realm 原生类型名和发送方 stack 被保留，deserializeRpcError 校验后还原 Error、RangeError、TypeError 等类型，不重新制造发送方 stack。

RpcWireErrorLimit：maxNesting 48、maxEmbeddingDepth 16、maxNodes 1024、maxStringBytes 65536、maxBytes 1048576。超预算或文本截断会裁掉内容并标 truncated；不保证每次裁剪都 report。循环边被裁去；reachRpcError(value, { report }) 遍历 cause、errors 与 cleanup 错误并按引用去重，RpcErrorReachLimit.maxObjects 为 4096。

normalizeRpcSerializedError(value, options?) 的 options 默认空对象；unknownFields 为 reject（默认）或 ignore，onUnknownField 可选、无默认 callback。deserializeRpcError(value, options?, routes?) 采用相同规则，routes 可接调用方 WeakMap 的 set 能力保存已接纳路由。序列化读取固定字段，某字段 getter 失败可报告并保留根、设置 truncated；不承诺读取错误对象的所有任意自有属性。
第三参数 metadata 的 summaries/routes 都可选，是按 Error 引用查询的 WeakMap get 能力。summaries 可给 code/message 对外摘要并隐藏内部 cause；preserveSerializedError: true 才保留该节点既有后代。routes 提供有界路由诊断，不授予控制权限。

toJsonRpcError(wire, code) 把错误树放入 error.data.migaiaWireError；整数 code 由调用方选定，不默认等于 wire code。fromJsonRpcError 也接受无扩展的普通 JSON-RPC 错误，使用 foreignSource `jsonrpc-2.0` 与整数 code 的字符串。RpcJsonRpcWireError.dataKey 维护扩展键。独立适配器使用自己的 source/code，可直接安装 utils 并用 attachErrorIdentity 保留原生错误；不要冒用官方 RPC 身份。
classifyRpcContractError(error) 只按本地对象引用识别本包签发错误，返回对外 code/message；复制或远端还原的错误返回 undefined。远端 source/code 是诊断身份，不证明本地来源，也不授予重试或控制权。

schema/wire-error 只提供结构校验起点，不等于有界 normalizer。独立实现还须执行 x-migaia-limits、canonical base64url、surrogate 等规则；Schema 的 additionalProperties 与 normalizer 默认 reject 并不等价。用其它语言实现原生对端还需长度前缀、握手和 runtime 信封；JSON-RPC 桥还需其四个扩展方法，由 rpc-process 的协议层负责，不由本包完成连接。

symbols.name: RpcContractErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Stable semantic codes owned by the runtime-neutral contract package. Each stable key below identifies one wire choice or diagnostic bound.
symbols.core:
callbackFailed: `CALLBACK_FAILED`: a warning, scheduler or cleanup callback failed without prior semantic identity. Native mutable errors retain identity, type and stack; other values stay on cause. Safe wire summaries do not expose callback text.
invalidDescriptor: `INVALID_DESCRIPTOR`: invalid stable component identity/version; correct local configuration.
invalidEnvelope: `INVALID_ENVELOPE`: reject the invalid semantic message without executing it.
invalidStream: `INVALID_STREAM`: reject the invalid event, sequence or value budget and terminate only its stream.
invalidFrame: `INVALID_FRAME`: discard malformed physical or empty batch framing.
frameLimitExceeded: `FRAME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`: complete physical or retained reassembly bytes exceeded a bound.
frameAssemblyExpired: `FRAME_ASSEMBLY_EXPIRED`: not all ordered fragments arrived before the assembly timer.
invalidWireError: `INVALID_WIRE_ERROR`: reject the malformed bounded serialized error tree.
handshakeInvalid: `HANDSHAKE_INVALID`: malformed encoding, JSON or first-channel negotiation fields.
handshakeIncompatible: `HANDSHAKE_INCOMPATIBLE`: peer protocol, version or mandatory runtime baseline is incompatible.
handshakeRejected: `HANDSHAKE_REJECTED`: the remote rejected negotiation; inspect the retained remote cause.

guidance.id: 错误树-原生类型与-json-rpc-转换
guidance.heading: 错误树、原生类型与 JSON-RPC 转换

blocks.text: serializeRpcError(value, options, metadata?) 的 value 和 options.report 必填；report 接收 `{ pointer, field, error }`，用于被跳过的属性读取或数据规范化失败，不能用次数统计全部截断。它按 source、code、name、message、stack，加可选 cause/errors/data/route/truncated 输出有界错误树；无身份错误使用 unknown/UNKNOWN。跨 realm 原生类型名和发送方 stack 被保留，deserializeRpcError 校验后还原 Error、RangeError、TypeError 等类型，不重新制造发送方 stack。

RpcWireErrorLimit：maxNesting 48、maxEmbeddingDepth 16、maxNodes 1024、maxStringBytes 65536、maxBytes 1048576。超预算或文本截断会裁掉内容并标 truncated；不保证每次裁剪都 report。循环边被裁去；reachRpcError(value, { report }) 遍历 cause、errors 与 cleanup 错误并按引用去重，RpcErrorReachLimit.maxObjects 为 4096。

normalizeRpcSerializedError(value, options?) 的 options 默认空对象；unknownFields 为 reject（默认）或 ignore，onUnknownField 可选、无默认 callback。deserializeRpcError(value, options?, routes?) 采用相同规则，routes 可接调用方 WeakMap 的 set 能力保存已接纳路由。序列化读取固定字段，某字段 getter 失败可报告并保留根、设置 truncated；不承诺读取错误对象的所有任意自有属性。
第三参数 metadata 的 summaries/routes 都可选，是按 Error 引用查询的 WeakMap get 能力。summaries 可给 code/message 对外摘要并隐藏内部 cause；preserveSerializedError: true 才保留该节点既有后代。routes 提供有界路由诊断，不授予控制权限。

toJsonRpcError(wire, code) 把错误树放入 error.data.migaiaWireError；整数 code 由调用方选定，不默认等于 wire code。fromJsonRpcError 也接受无扩展的普通 JSON-RPC 错误，使用 foreignSource `jsonrpc-2.0` 与整数 code 的字符串。RpcJsonRpcWireError.dataKey 维护扩展键。独立适配器使用自己的 source/code，可直接安装 utils 并用 attachErrorIdentity 保留原生错误；不要冒用官方 RPC 身份。
classifyRpcContractError(error) 只按本地对象引用识别本包签发错误，返回对外 code/message；复制或远端还原的错误返回 undefined。远端 source/code 是诊断身份，不证明本地来源，也不授予重试或控制权。

schema/wire-error 只提供结构校验起点，不等于有界 normalizer。独立实现还须执行 x-migaia-limits、canonical base64url、surrogate 等规则；Schema 的 additionalProperties 与 normalizer 默认 reject 并不等价。用其它语言实现原生对端还需长度前缀、握手和 runtime 信封；JSON-RPC 桥还需其四个扩展方法，由 rpc-process 的协议层负责，不由本包完成连接。

guidance.id: 保留原生错误类型与远端原因堆栈
guidance.heading: 保留原生错误类型与远端原因堆栈

blocks.text: 远端操作因范围错误而抛出类型错误，接收方需要两层语义码和原始堆栈，才能辨认失败操作及根因。
只发送错误消息会丢掉原因树、原生类型与堆栈，用该文字在本地重建错误，又会生成接收端堆栈并掩盖原始失败位置。
`serializeRpcError` 投影有界带码树，`deserializeRpcError` 校验后恢复原生类型，须提供 `report` 回调以保留无法读取或规范化字段的失败。
`serializeRpcError(value, options)` 两项必填；options.report 是必填同步回调，本例把每个失败记录放入 reports，没有额外默认报告器。source/code 是错误的语义身份，cause 是原始原因。deserializeRpcError 的 options 可省略，未知字段默认 reject。
输出：

blocks.code:
true true
true true
REQUEST LIMIT 0

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `true true`、`true true`、`REQUEST LIMIT 0`，往返保留两种原生类型、两份堆栈字符串和语义码，未报告字段失败。
恢复会创建新的错误对象，不保留跨边界对象身份；错误树有界，可携带 `cause`、聚合错误子项和截断标记，这些函数不建立连接或执行请求。

guidance.id: 报告不可读字段并继续生成线上错误
guidance.heading: 报告不可读字段并继续生成线上错误

blocks.text: 诊断序列化遇到消息访问器会抛错的错误对象，丢弃整条诊断会同时掩盖原操作与新的字段读取失败。
构建 JSON 对象时直接读取属性，会让访问器异常逃出日志路径，若忽略该异常，又会丢失字段被省略的依据。
`serializeRpcError` 捕获支持字段，并把被省略的读取失败交给 `report`；本例先保存错误堆栈，再设置会抛错的消息访问器，收集报告记录供检查。
options.report 的 entry 包含 pointer、field、error；本例 error 是 message getter 的原始失败。第三参数 metadata 未提供，不启用调用方摘要或路由表。Object.defineProperty 是构造本地失败样本，不是 normalizer 的配置项。
输出：

blocks.code:
Error UNKNOWN
1 message true

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `Error UNKNOWN`、`1 message true`，仍返回线上错误，报告指出不可读的消息字段并保留原始 `TypeError`。
`report` 必填，同步收到指针、字段和原始失败；这些记录是本地诊断依据，不是额外线上字段，未编码错误使用未知来源与错误码兜底，不可读字段遵守有界序列化策略。

guidance.id: 错误树-原生类型与-json-rpc-转换
guidance.heading: 错误树、原生类型与 JSON-RPC 转换

blocks.text: serializeRpcError(value, options, metadata?) 的 value 和 options.report 必填；report 接收 `{ pointer, field, error }`，用于被跳过的属性读取或数据规范化失败，不能用次数统计全部截断。它按 source、code、name、message、stack，加可选 cause/errors/data/route/truncated 输出有界错误树；无身份错误使用 unknown/UNKNOWN。跨 realm 原生类型名和发送方 stack 被保留，deserializeRpcError 校验后还原 Error、RangeError、TypeError 等类型，不重新制造发送方 stack。

RpcWireErrorLimit：maxNesting 48、maxEmbeddingDepth 16、maxNodes 1024、maxStringBytes 65536、maxBytes 1048576。超预算或文本截断会裁掉内容并标 truncated；不保证每次裁剪都 report。循环边被裁去；reachRpcError(value, { report }) 遍历 cause、errors 与 cleanup 错误并按引用去重，RpcErrorReachLimit.maxObjects 为 4096。

normalizeRpcSerializedError(value, options?) 的 options 默认空对象；unknownFields 为 reject（默认）或 ignore，onUnknownField 可选、无默认 callback。deserializeRpcError(value, options?, routes?) 采用相同规则，routes 可接调用方 WeakMap 的 set 能力保存已接纳路由。序列化读取固定字段，某字段 getter 失败可报告并保留根、设置 truncated；不承诺读取错误对象的所有任意自有属性。
第三参数 metadata 的 summaries/routes 都可选，是按 Error 引用查询的 WeakMap get 能力。summaries 可给 code/message 对外摘要并隐藏内部 cause；preserveSerializedError: true 才保留该节点既有后代。routes 提供有界路由诊断，不授予控制权限。

toJsonRpcError(wire, code) 把错误树放入 error.data.migaiaWireError；整数 code 由调用方选定，不默认等于 wire code。fromJsonRpcError 也接受无扩展的普通 JSON-RPC 错误，使用 foreignSource `jsonrpc-2.0` 与整数 code 的字符串。RpcJsonRpcWireError.dataKey 维护扩展键。独立适配器使用自己的 source/code，可直接安装 utils 并用 attachErrorIdentity 保留原生错误；不要冒用官方 RPC 身份。
classifyRpcContractError(error) 只按本地对象引用识别本包签发错误，返回对外 code/message；复制或远端还原的错误返回 undefined。远端 source/code 是诊断身份，不证明本地来源，也不授予重试或控制权。

schema/wire-error 只提供结构校验起点，不等于有界 normalizer。独立实现还须执行 x-migaia-limits、canonical base64url、surrogate 等规则；Schema 的 additionalProperties 与 normalizer 默认 reject 并不等价。用其它语言实现原生对端还需长度前缀、握手和 runtime 信封；JSON-RPC 桥还需其四个扩展方法，由 rpc-process 的协议层负责，不由本包完成连接。

symbols.purpose: Creates an ordered bounded fragment framer and receiver. Call its own accept method; retention is separated by transport source and message identifier.

id: Application or protocol-owner correlation identifier; preserve it on replies and controls for the same task.
version: Positive component format version chosen by the component owner, independent of package versions.
inputEncodedType: Encoded carrier domain accepted by frame; installation validates codec compatibility.
Arbitrary message-object carrier; no string or byte encoding is imposed.
Text carrier values require a string-compatible codec boundary.
Byte carrier values require an actual Uint8Array encoding.
outputEncodedType: Carrier domain yielded after reassembly, independent from physical fragment objects.
frame: Synchronously partitions one encoded value or returns a whole-frame value when no fragmentation is needed.
frame.value: Encoded message from the matching codec.
frame.context: Transport-owned IRpcFrameContext with actual source and sender-assigned messageId.
Ordered physical frame array; size or fragment-count excess throws FRAME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
accept: Synchronously admits an ordered fragment or whole carrier into the original source/message assembly.
accept.frame: Received physical whole value or fragment from the matching sender framer.
accept.context: Receiver carrier context with actual source and matching messageId.
IRpcFrameAcceptResult: pending, complete value, or rejected original coded Error.
close: Idempotently closes reassembly, revoking each timer before cancellation so synchronous reentry cancels it once, and drops incomplete messages.
close.reason: Optional caller close reason; built-in framers do not encode or transmit it.
Retained state is released; future receives are rejected where the framer owns terminal state.
chunkBytes: Positive safe-integer fragment size: bytes for binary, UTF-16 code units for strings; cannot exceed maxMessageBytes.
`16384` units per fragment.
maxMessageBytes: Positive safe-integer size ceiling for complete inbound/outbound values and reassembly; string counts UTF-16 code units, binary counts bytes. Cannot exceed maxBufferedBytes.
`16777216` encoded units per message.
maxChunks: Positive safe-integer maximum declared fragments for one message.
`4096` fragments per message.
maxBufferedBytes: Positive safe-integer total retained incomplete data across all source/message pairs.
`67108864` retained encoded units.
maxConcurrentMessages: Positive safe-integer maximum simultaneous incomplete source/message assemblies.
`256` concurrent incomplete messages.
assemblyTimeoutMs: Positive safe-integer timer deadline after the first fragment before marking its assembly expired.
`30000` milliseconds from first fragment.
now: Optional synchronous application clock callback returning a numeric time; current implementation snapshots but never invokes it.
Omitted; no application clock callback is invoked.
Supply only when sharing a framer configuration shape that already includes a clock. Current assembly expiry retains this callback but never invokes it; omission has the same expiry behavior. Use schedule to control expiry.
schedule: Optional synchronous timer adapter receives a no-argument expiry callback and delayMs; returns the opaque handle passed to cancel. A failed scheduler keeps prior semantic identity or gains `CALLBACK_FAILED`; unattachable failures remain on `cause`.
Host setTimeout when available; no timer when the host lacks it.
Set it when the carrier owns a timer queue. Return one handle for the expiry callback; cancel receives that handle. Omission uses host setTimeout when available, otherwise no timer is armed.
cancel: Optional synchronous timer cancellation receives the original handle returned by schedule; cleanup failure is observed through host `reportError` or terminal host reporting. A reporter failure stays secondary; the frame result is preserved.
Host clearTimeout when available.
Set it when using a custom schedule so completed or closed assemblies release their pending timer. It receives the original opaque handle. Omission uses host clearTimeout when available.

symbols.name: createStringFramer
symbols.purpose:
Creates an ordered bounded string fragment framer. frame(value, context) returns either one whole string or ordered rpc.frame.v1 fragments. context.source is the caller-owned source namespace and context.messageId is the sender correlation id; neither authenticates a peer.

accept(frame, context) returns pending, complete with a reassembled string, or rejected with an Error carrying a semantic code. Assemblies are isolated by both context fields. close() clears retained assemblies/timers and makes later accept calls reject; it does not send network messages.
symbols.core:
options: Optional application IRpcFramerOptions, default {} with the field defaults below. Numeric limits must be positive safe integers; chunkBytes cannot exceed maxMessageBytes, which cannot exceed maxBufferedBytes.
An IRpcFramer for string carrier values; ordered fragments share original state and close releases retained buffers/timers. Invalid limits throw INVALID_FRAME or FRAME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
id: Application or protocol-owner correlation identifier; preserve it on replies and controls for the same task.
version: Positive component format version chosen by the component owner, independent of package versions.
inputEncodedType: Encoded carrier domain accepted by frame; installation validates codec compatibility.
Arbitrary message-object carrier; no string or byte encoding is imposed.
Text carrier values require a string-compatible codec boundary.
Byte carrier values require an actual Uint8Array encoding.
outputEncodedType: Carrier domain yielded after reassembly, independent from physical fragment objects.
frame: Synchronously partitions one encoded value or returns a whole-frame value when no fragmentation is needed.
frame.value: Encoded message from the matching codec.
frame.context: Transport-owned IRpcFrameContext with actual source and sender-assigned messageId.
Ordered physical frame array; size or fragment-count excess throws FRAME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
accept: Synchronously admits an ordered fragment or whole carrier into the original source/message assembly.
accept.frame: Received physical whole value or fragment from the matching sender framer.
accept.context: Receiver carrier context with actual source and matching messageId.
IRpcFrameAcceptResult: pending, complete value, or rejected original coded Error.
close: Idempotently closes reassembly, revoking each timer before cancellation so synchronous reentry cancels it once, and drops incomplete messages.
close.reason: Optional caller close reason; built-in framers do not encode or transmit it.
Retained state is released; future receives are rejected where the framer owns terminal state.
chunkBytes: Positive safe-integer fragment size: bytes for binary, UTF-16 code units for strings; cannot exceed maxMessageBytes.
`16384` units per fragment.
maxMessageBytes: Positive safe-integer size ceiling for complete inbound/outbound values and reassembly; string counts UTF-16 code units, binary counts bytes. Cannot exceed maxBufferedBytes.
`16777216` encoded units per message.
maxChunks: Positive safe-integer maximum declared fragments for one message.
`4096` fragments per message.
maxBufferedBytes: Positive safe-integer total retained incomplete data across all source/message pairs.
`67108864` retained encoded units.
maxConcurrentMessages: Positive safe-integer maximum simultaneous incomplete source/message assemblies.
`256` concurrent incomplete messages.
assemblyTimeoutMs: Positive safe-integer timer deadline after the first fragment before marking its assembly expired.
`30000` milliseconds from first fragment.
now: Optional synchronous application clock callback returning a numeric time; current implementation snapshots but never invokes it.
Omitted; no application clock callback is invoked.
Supply only when sharing a framer configuration shape that already includes a clock. Current assembly expiry retains this callback but never invokes it; omission has the same expiry behavior. Use schedule to control expiry.
schedule: Optional synchronous timer adapter receives a no-argument expiry callback and delayMs; returns the opaque handle passed to cancel. A failed scheduler keeps prior semantic identity or gains `CALLBACK_FAILED`; unattachable failures remain on `cause`.
Host setTimeout when available; no timer when the host lacks it.
Set it when the carrier owns a timer queue. Return one handle for the expiry callback; cancel receives that handle. Omission uses host setTimeout when available, otherwise no timer is armed.
cancel: Optional synchronous timer cancellation receives the original handle returned by schedule; cleanup failure is observed through host `reportError` or terminal host reporting. A reporter failure stays secondary; the frame result is preserved.
Host clearTimeout when available.
Set it when using a custom schedule so completed or closed assemblies release their pending timer. It receives the original opaque handle. Omission uses host clearTimeout when available.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
push: Consumes arbitrary read chunks and returns every complete parsed value in physical order.
push.chunk: Original incoming Uint8Array chunk from the connection reader.
Parsed unknown values; malformed framing or JSON throws JSONRPC_FRAME_INVALID.
finish: Checks physical end-of-input for an incomplete retained header or body.
Returns void with no partial frame; otherwise throws JSONRPC_FRAME_INVALID.
close: Idempotently drops retained bytes and makes later pushes return no messages.
All decoder-owned retained bytes are released.
bufferedBytes: Current retained header plus received body bytes, not the full declared body capacity.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content: Implement an independent compatible peer using the original protocol-owned data shape.

symbols.name: createRpcStreamFrameDecoder
symbols.purpose: Creates a bounded native network-order length-prefix decoder. Pair with encodeRpcStreamFrame; callbacks receive complete owned byte payloads or the first framing failure.
symbols.core:
options: Application synchronous onFrame(frame) and onError(error) callbacks documented by IRpcStreamFrameDecoderOptions; callback throws propagate.
IRpcStreamFrameDecoder; no timer or physical connection is acquired.
onFrame: Synchronously consumes each complete decoder-owned byte payload after internal assembly state is released.
onFrame.frame: Complete Uint8Array payload freshly assembled by the decoder; no four-byte prefix is included.
Return void; a throw propagates through push without being converted to an onError callback.
Always supply the complete-payload consumer. It runs synchronously after assembly state is released, and a throw propagates to push(). There is no default consumer.
onError: Synchronously receives the first malformed-frame error after the decoder becomes terminal and releases retained state.
onError.error: Original coded INVALID_FRAME or FRAME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED error created by the decoder.
Return void; callback throws propagate to the decoder caller.
Always supply a framing failure sink. The first malformed or truncated frame makes the decoder terminal, then invokes it once. There is no default sink, and callback throws propagate to the caller.
parameters: options: IRpcStreamFrameDecoderOptions

symbols.purpose: Application callbacks for complete native length-prefix payloads and original terminal framing failures.
symbols.core:
onFrame: Synchronously consumes each complete decoder-owned byte payload after internal assembly state is released.

Return void; a throw propagates through push without being converted to an onError callback.
Always supply the complete-payload consumer. It runs synchronously after assembly state is released, and a throw propagates to push(). There is no default consumer.
onError: Synchronously receives the first malformed-frame error after the decoder becomes terminal and releases retained state.
onError.error: Original coded INVALID_FRAME or FRAME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED error created by the decoder.
Return void; callback throws propagate to the decoder caller.
Always supply a framing failure sink. The first malformed or truncated frame makes the decoder terminal, then invokes it once. There is no default sink, and callback throws propagate to the caller.

symbols.name: acceptRpcHandshake
symbols.purpose: Responder selects the highest shared major, lower shared minor, first remote codec also offered locally and exact capability intersection. Pair with createRpcHello and completeRpcHandshake.
symbols.core:
local: Responder application actual IRpcHandshakeOffer.
hello: First-channel text or bytes returned by the initiator createRpcHello.
options: Optional IRpcEnvelopeOptions controlling unknown-field observation.
ok true carries reply and agreement; incompatibility returns ok false with rejection reply/error. Malformed input throws HANDSHAKE_INVALID.
onUnknownField: Optional synchronous application callback receives JSON pointer and unknown field name; returns void. A throw propagates from normalization.
Absent: additive unknown fields are ignored without warning.
Observe allowed additive fields during a version rollout. The callback receives pointer and field and must return void; a throw aborts normalization. Omit it to ignore those fields silently.
parameters: local: IRpcHandshakeOffer
hello: IRpcHandshakeText

nativeBinary: Native authenticated manifests verify full backing integrity before authentication replay commit.

symbols.name: normalizePortable
symbols.purpose:
Snapshots supported portable values without sending or executing a request. The default wire domain is null, boolean, finite number, string, array, plain record or a canonical bytes tag; Uint8Array becomes {$rpc: "bytes", base64url}. Records become frozen null-prototype snapshots.

Rejects cycles, nonfinite numbers and unsupported objects with INVALID_ENVELOPE. Ordinary record getters are read once and can execute user code. Native binary belongs to an independently negotiated profile, not the default wire result.
symbols.core:
value: Application or peer value requiring a portable data-only snapshot.
depth: Optional existing traversal depth, default 0 at the root; RPC_PORTABLE_MAX_DEPTH is 64. Ordinary application calls omit this traversal-integration parameter.
active: Optional caller-provided ancestor Set for the same traversal, default undefined with traversal-local cycle tracking. It tracks active ancestors rather than deduplicating all repeated references.
nativeBinary: Optional native-binary branch flag, default false; true admits native bytes, or a synchronous rejection callback supplies the failure boundary.
IRpcWirePortableValue by default, or negotiated IRpcPortableValue with native binary enabled; invalid data throws INVALID_ENVELOPE.

depth: number (optional)
active: Set<object> (optional)
depth: number

outcome: Retained original business completion and target generation from the provider idempotency store.

operation: Control operation selected by the owning protocol grammar.
state: Outcome-result lookup state present only on result controls.
stream: IRpcRuntimeStream present only on a stream control operation.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
cancel: Cancel the original correlated runtime operation.
stream: Transmit a producer or consumer stream event.
terminal: Transmit actual scalar or group completion.
lookup: Read the original provider store without dispatching business work.
result: Return actual store continuity and retained outcome facts.

Absent: no deadline is declared by this data record.
idempotencyKey: Application-issued stable operation key reused only when requesting the same business effect.
Absent: no idempotency lookup or reservation is requested.

payload: Optional application portable business input; omitted input creates no payload field.

symbols.name: IRpcFramerOptions
symbols.purpose: Snapshot of bounded fragment-retention policy captured by each fragment framer constructor.
symbols.core:
chunkBytes: Positive safe-integer fragment size: bytes for binary, UTF-16 code units for strings; cannot exceed maxMessageBytes.
`16384` units per fragment.
maxMessageBytes: Positive safe-integer size ceiling for complete inbound/outbound values and reassembly; string counts UTF-16 code units, binary counts bytes. Cannot exceed maxBufferedBytes.
`16777216` encoded units per message.
maxChunks: Positive safe-integer maximum declared fragments for one message.
`4096` fragments per message.
maxBufferedBytes: Positive safe-integer total retained incomplete data across all source/message pairs.
`67108864` retained encoded units.
maxConcurrentMessages: Positive safe-integer maximum simultaneous incomplete source/message assemblies.
`256` concurrent incomplete messages.
assemblyTimeoutMs: Positive safe-integer timer deadline after the first fragment before marking its assembly expired.
`30000` milliseconds from first fragment.
now: Optional synchronous application clock callback returning a numeric time; current implementation snapshots but never invokes it.
Omitted; no application clock callback is invoked.
Supply only when sharing a framer configuration shape that already includes a clock. Current assembly expiry retains this callback but never invokes it; omission has the same expiry behavior. Use schedule to control expiry.
schedule: Optional synchronous timer adapter receives a no-argument expiry callback and delayMs; returns the opaque handle passed to cancel. A failed scheduler keeps prior semantic identity or gains `CALLBACK_FAILED`; unattachable failures remain on `cause`.
Host setTimeout when available; no timer when the host lacks it.
Set it when the carrier owns a timer queue. Return one handle for the expiry callback; cancel receives that handle. Omission uses host setTimeout when available, otherwise no timer is armed.
cancel: Optional synchronous timer cancellation receives the original handle returned by schedule; cleanup failure is observed through host `reportError` or terminal host reporting. A reporter failure stays secondary; the frame result is preserved.
Host clearTimeout when available.
Set it when using a custom schedule so completed or closed assemblies release their pending timer. It receives the original opaque handle. Omission uses host clearTimeout when available.

symbols.name: abort
symbols.signature: export declare const abort: () => IRpcPlugin;
symbols.purpose:
Returns an option-free plugin enabling correlated remote cancellation. Install it in both endpoint middleware tuples and pass a caller-owned signal in send options. Running providers must observe context.signal and stop cooperatively; local rejection alone does not prove that remote work stopped.

The examples use application-chosen id values and a caller-created memory transport pair. Both transport and connect({ transport }) refer to the same side; memory options default to {}, with asynchronous delivery and no value cloning. middlewares is the required installation tuple; targetIds is an optional application seed list, default []. provide registers an application method whose context.data is the request and context.success(value) forms its reply. send(targetId, method, data, options?) takes the target and method named by that application; options defaults to {}. Dispose each endpoint, then close the borrowed pair as its creator.

Immutable plugin definition installed by the endpoint middleware tuple.
Installs the original abort capability into one canonical endpoint construction transaction; it has no standalone network effect.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content:
Returns an option-free plugin enabling correlated remote cancellation. Install it in both endpoint middleware tuples and pass a caller-owned signal in send options. Running providers must observe context.signal and stop cooperatively; local rejection alone does not prove that remote work stopped.

The examples use application-chosen id values and a caller-created memory transport pair. examples:
import { connect, createEndpoint } from '@migaia/rpc-core'
import { createMemoryTransportPair } from '@migaia/rpc-core/adapters/memory'

const [left, right] = createMemoryTransportPair()
const server = await createEndpoint({
  id: 'server',
  transport: right,
  middlewares: [connect({ transport: right })]
})
server.provide('double', (context) => context.success((context.data as number) * 2))
const client = await createEndpoint({
  id: 'client',
  targetIds: ['server'],
  transport: left,
  middlewares: [connect({ transport: left })]
})
console.log(await client.send<number>('server', 'double', 21))
await client.dispose()
await server.dispose()
left.close()

import { connect, createEndpoint } from '@migaia/rpc-core'
import { createMemoryTransportPair } from '@migaia/rpc-core/adapters/memory'

const [left, right] = createMemoryTransportPair()
const endpoint = await createEndpoint({
  id: 'local',
  transport: left,
  middlewares: [connect({ transport: left })]
})
await endpoint.dispose()
console.log(left.closed, right.closed)
left.close()
console.log(left.closed, right.closed)

symbols.name: createEndpoint
symbols.signature: export declare const createEndpoint: IPublicCallable;
symbols.purpose:
Creates the full canonical endpoint with provider, outbound, discovery and control roots; actual middleware tuple narrows optional ping/manual controls.

The examples use application-chosen id values and a caller-created memory transport pair. Both transport and connect({ transport }) refer to the same side; memory options default to {}, with asynchronous delivery and no value cloning. middlewares is the required installation tuple; targetIds is an optional application seed list, default []. provide registers an application method whose context.data is the request and context.success(value) forms its reply. send(targetId, method, data, options?) takes the target and method named by that application; options defaults to {}. Dispose each endpoint, then close the borrowed pair as its creator.
symbols.core:
config: Application IRpcFactoryConfig whose actual protocol/codec/framer/transport types satisfy both directed pipeline edges; middlewares is the actual finite installation tuple.
Promise of the selected endpoint surface; invalid inputs fail before publication, failed construction rolls back and preserves original/cleanup causes. An unclassified middleware install failure gains CALLBACK_FAILED without replacing mutable native type/stack; foreign semantic identities stay intact and immutable values remain on cause.
provide: Registers one provider for a unique method name; duplicate registration throws PROVIDER_DUPLICATED.
provide.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
provide.provider: Application callback receives IRpcContext and returns context.success or context.failed synchronously or asynchronously. Legacy ordinary throws usually become INTERNAL; trusted wire summaries and SCHEMA_INVALID retain public classification. Runtime operations serialize the original failure.
The same endpoint for chaining; disposal rejects new registrations.
on: Registers a one-way event listener; callbacks receive IRpcContext and async failures are observed through endpoint hooks.
on.event: Application event name matching the sender dispatch method.
on.listener: Application callback receives IRpcContext, returns void or Promise<void>, and should not retain expired response operations.
Idempotent unsubscriber removes only this registration.
send: Sends a correlated scalar request to the selected receiver and waits for one actual provider result.
send.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
send.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
send.data: Application request payload validated by the installed contract/codec.
send.options: Optional ISendOptions supplied by the caller; timeout, cancellation, transfer, idempotency and trace remain explicit.
Promise of provider data; remote business failure, cancellation, deadline, transport or lifecycle failure rejects with its native coded error. A synchronous UUID admission failure releases operation signal listeners; ordinary send cancellation keeps RpcAbortError.
sendAll: Sends the same scalar method to the statically configured target seeds and keeps each target success/failure separately.
sendAll.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
sendAll.data: Application payload sent independently to every selected target.
sendAll.options: Caller ISendOptions applied to the selected fan-out operations.
IRpcFanoutResult maps receiver/target keys to fulfilled data or original rejected errors.
dispatch: Sends a legacy one-way event without awaiting business completion; pair with on on the receiving endpoint.
dispatch.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
dispatch.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
dispatch.data: Application event payload for the receiving listener.
Returns void once dispatch is initiated; failures are contained in endpoint hooks.
dispatchAll: Dispatches one event to the statically configured target seeds without waiting for business listeners.
dispatchAll.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
dispatchAll.data: Application event payload for each selected target.
Returns void after scheduling selected dispatches; hooks observe failures.
group: Reserves every request-only step before execution, then runs in order until first failure; successful earlier effects are not rolled back.
group.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
group.steps: Application nonempty method/payload array admitted as IRpcRuntimeGroupSteps.
group.options: Optional IRpcRuntimeGroupOptions with actual ordering/cancellation/idempotency and local send controls.
Promise of actual step outcomes; unsupported native group capability rejects before dispatch.
outcome: Reads an original logical key outcome from the provider store without executing providers again.
outcome.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
outcome.idempotencyKey: Original application-issued key used for the same earlier logical operation.
IRpcRuntimeOutcomeResult reports pending/done/unknown and store continuity; unknown never proves nonexecution.
announceClose: Announces a bounded drain window to one peer while leaving actual physical close with its owning adapter.
announceClose.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
announceClose.options: Caller drainMs duration and optional receiverId from discovery; this is a relative peer announcement.
Resolves when the close control is sent; it does not await remote resource disposal.
ping: Checks one actual receiver liveness; requires installed ping capability and actual negotiated support.
ping.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
ping.receiverId: Specific receiver identifier returned by discovery candidates or connect.getServerList; never invent an instance address.
ping.options: Optional IRpcPingOptions with local signal and deadline override.
Promise<boolean> for the observed reply; disposal settles an active ping as false. Calling after disposal or without ping capability throws its coded error. Ping cancellation does not require abort middleware.
pingAll: Checks liveness of the statically configured target seeds and retains individual success/failure results.
IRpcFanoutResult<boolean> keyed by the selected actual receivers.
connect: Connection/discovery controls derived from the actual middleware tuple; manual mode exposes query and registration operations.
discovery: Read-only candidate listing and explicit receiver pin controls sharing the canonical discovery owner.
hooks: Local diagnostic subscription facade; hooks.on receives IRpcHookEvent and returns an unsubscriber.
dispose: Idempotently stops admission, drains owned work and releases middleware/adapter resources in the canonical lifecycle order.
Promise resolves after disposal; cleanup failures remain reachable through standard cause/errors traversal, including all failures in the same batch; future operations fail ENDPOINT_DISPOSED.
id: Application-assigned stable local endpoint identifier included in outgoing routes.
scheduler: Application monotonic IScheduler shared by endpoint deadlines and PluginHost; now must be finite nonnegative milliseconds.
systemScheduler uses host monotonic time and timers.
Pass the application’s monotonic scheduler when endpoint deadlines must share its clock. Omit it to use the host scheduler.
wallClock: Application IWallClock supplies only wire sentAt and hook timestamps as nonnegative safe-integer epoch milliseconds.
systemWallClock uses the host epoch clock.
Set a wall clock when wire timestamps and diagnostic timestamps must use the application clock. It does not control deadlines.
transport: Actual application adapter selected by top-level config or native connect middleware; native source evidence remains adapter-owned.
Absent: use the selected connect middleware transport; otherwise construction fails.
Supply the exact original carrier side owned by this caller; choose a transport factory for the supported host.
protocol: Canonical semantic IRpcProtocol descriptor selected independently of codec encoding.
rpcProtocolV1 is the default canonical protocol.
Use the protocol descriptor agreed by both ends. Omit it for Core’s default protocol.
codec: ICodec from @migaia/serialize/codec whose encoded output exactly matches the selected framer input.
identityCodecV1 preserves the canonical semantic envelope.
Use a codec whose output matches the framer input. Both ends must agree on the encoded representation.
framer: IRpcFramer from rpc-contract/framing whose actual output is accepted by the selected transport.
messageFramerV1 uses complete unfragmented messages.
Use the framer agreed by both ends; its output must match the transport’s accepted frame.
targetIds: Optional known-peer base identifiers from application deployment configuration; automatic discovery can resolve more later.
Empty seed list; discovery remains available.
provider: Application map of unique method names to IRpcProvider callbacks installed before endpoint construction returns.
Absent: register providers later through provide.
Register startup handlers here when they must exist before ingress starts. Later registrations can use provide on a provider-capable endpoint.
providerLimits: Optional IRpcProviderLimits applied to the existing shared execution/replay admission owner.
Global 256, per-peer 64, replay per-peer 1024.
Bound active provider work when expensive operations need backpressure. The defaults are 256 global and 64 per peer.
idempotency: Optional actual original result store and authenticated scope function for keyed provider work.
Absent: use the endpoint-owned canonical keyed replay policy.
Provide an outcome store on the serving endpoint when retries carry the same idempotency key. A shared store also needs a session scope.
idempotency.store: Optional caller-held IRpcIdempotencyStore shared only across actual intended sessions.
Absent: use the original endpoint-local store.
idempotency.scope: Synchronous application callback receives actual admitted token and senderId, returns a stable scope string; it must not treat arbitrary wire claims as identity.
Absent: canonical admitted-session scope is used.
Derive isolation from an admitted token when sharing an outcome store across sessions.
replay: Outbound active identifiers plus settled tombstone retention, separate from business result storage.
Use maxEntries 4096 and ttlMs 310000.
Size retained outbound identifiers for the request rate and replay window. This ledger is separate from the keyed business-result store.
replay.maxEntries: Maximum retained outbound request identities including active operations and settled tombstones.
`4096` retained outbound identities.
replay.ttlMs: Scheduler milliseconds to retain settled outbound request identity tombstones.
`310000` milliseconds after settlement.
middlewares: Required ordered finite tuple of actual middleware definitions installed atomically by PluginHost.
features: Optional finite immutable tuple of actual native IRpcFeature roots; dependencies remain private and only selected public surfaces are projected.
Empty tuple adds no user-defined features.
Install application features when endpoint-owned cleanup should release them. Omit this tuple when no extra feature is needed.
construction: Caller construction cancellation/deadline; failure still rolls back every installed middleware in original lifecycle order.
Absent: no caller abort or construction deadline.
construction.signal: Optional caller cancellation signal controlling construction and its complete rollback.
Absent: construction has an uncancelled native signal.
construction.timeoutMs: Finite nonnegative construction deadline or false to disable; rollback retains the primary failure and cleanup failures.
Absent or false: no construction deadline.
Disable only the construction deadline.
Use false to rely solely on caller cancellation; use a finite budget when construction must finish within a deadline.
symbols.advanced: Compose actual endpoint or runtime peers while keeping transport and lifecycle ownership with their canonical owners.
parameters: config: TConfig & IChecked<TConfig>
config: ILegacyDefault<TTargetId, TMiddlewares, TFeatures>
symbols.returns: Promise<IRecursiveProvideSurface<IFullEndpointSurface<ITarget<TConfig>, IFactoryDiscoveryMode<IMiddlewares<TConfig>>, IFactoryPingCapability<IMiddlewares<TConfig>>, IMiddlewares<TConfig>, IFeatures<TConfig>> & TAdditionalSurface>> | Promise<IRecursiveProvideSurface<IFullEndpointSurface<TTargetId, IFactoryDiscoveryMode<TMiddlewares>, IFactoryPingCapability<TMiddlewares>, TMiddlewares, TFeatures> & TAdditionalSurface>>
examples:
import { connect, createEndpoint } from '@migaia/rpc-core'
import { createMemoryTransportPair } from '@migaia/rpc-core/adapters/memory'

const [left, right] = createMemoryTransportPair()
const server = await createEndpoint({
  id: 'server',
  transport: right,
  middlewares: [connect({ transport: right })]
})
server.provide('double', (context) => context.success((context.data as number) * 2))
const client = await createEndpoint({
  id: 'client',
  targetIds: ['server'],
  transport: left,
  middlewares: [connect({ transport: left })]
})
console.log(await client.send<number>('server', 'double', 21))
await client.dispose()
await server.dispose()
left.close()

import { connect, createEndpoint } from '@migaia/rpc-core'
import { createMemoryTransportPair } from '@migaia/rpc-core/adapters/memory'

const [left, right] = createMemoryTransportPair()
const endpoint = await createEndpoint({
  id: 'local',
  transport: left,
  middlewares: [connect({ transport: left })]
})
await endpoint.dispose()
console.log(left.closed, right.closed)
left.close()
console.log(left.closed, right.closed)

symbols.name: IRpcAuthenticationConfig
symbols.purpose: Installs original per-frame protection, actual physical-session binding and replay checks; encryption runs before signing, verification before decryption.
symbols.core:
encrypt: Outbound sync/async encryption runs after the endpoint wraps its encoded value with replay metadata and before signing. Throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with its cause.
encrypt.value: Replay-bound authentication envelope produced by the endpoint, including its encoded payload; not the bare application payload.
encrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Encrypted value or its Promise, passed unchanged into sign.
Leave encrypt and decrypt out together when messages need signatures but not encryption. In that case, sign receives the unencrypted authentication envelope: the message data together with the information used to detect replay. Omitting encryption does not remove signing or verification.
Configure `encrypt` with `decrypt` for confidentiality and `sign` with `verify` for integrity; `encodedType` names the actual protected representation.
decrypt: Inbound sync/async decryption runs on the value recovered by verify. The endpoint then validates the recovered authentication envelope and replay binding.
decrypt.value: Verified protected value returned by verify.
decrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Recovered replay-bound authentication envelope or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with the original cause.
Omit decrypt only when encrypt is also omitted. After verify checks the signature and recovers the inner value, the endpoint directly checks that value as the authentication envelope, including its replay information. It does not try to decrypt the value.
sign: Outbound sync/async signing runs after optional encryption and returns the complete protected frame representation. Signing and verification are required even without encryption.
sign.value: Encrypted value when encrypt exists, otherwise the replay-bound authentication envelope.
sign.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Signed representation or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED. Keep the declared encodedType output domain.
There is no default signing function. Provide sign together with verify whenever authentication is enabled. This remains required when encrypt and decrypt are configured: encryption alone is insufficient, and omitting sign rejects the configuration.
verify: Inbound sync/async verification receives the protected frame and must recover its authenticated inner value; returning a boolean is not a verification verdict protocol.
verify.value: Protected value received at the authentication pipeline edge.
verify.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Authenticated inner value or its Promise, passed to decrypt when configured; reject or throw on invalid signatures. Local reporting retains the original verification failure, which may be sensitive; the peer receives a sanitized summary. Other returned values still undergo envelope/replay validation.
There is no default verification function. Provide verify together with sign so incoming protected messages can be checked and their inner values recovered. If sign is supplied without verify, construction rejects the configuration before the endpoint becomes active.
encodedType: Declared protected-output domain must match the next physical pipeline edge. Encrypt/decrypt and sign/verify are complete pairs, at least signing is required, and encryption additionally requires signing.
any: do not impose a declared protected-output value category.
Leave the declared output domain unconstrained; transforms may still change representation.
Declare that the protected output is text for the subsequent pipeline edge.
Declare that the protected output is a byte array for the subsequent pipeline edge.

trace: Optional caller-issued opaque diagnostic trace; downstream calls must pass it explicitly.

timeoutMs: Remaining actual provider deadline derived from the original endpoint monotonic clock; absent without a deadline.

failed: Constructs explicit application failure without replacing it with an internal exception.
failed.message: Application-readable semantic failure description.
failed.code: Application-owned stable semantic failure code.
IRpcProviderResult to return; after lifetime expiry returns a failure result carrying PROVIDER_CONTEXT_EXPIRED.
dispatchTo: Issues a provider-scoped one-way dispatch using the original provider execution owner.
dispatchTo.input: Application method/data and optional explicitly chosen target id; original execution controls validate its route.
Returns void after dispatch initiation; provider lifecycle and endpoint hooks contain later failures.

symbols.core:
provide: Registers one provider for a unique method name; duplicate registration throws PROVIDER_DUPLICATED.
provide.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
provide.provider: Application callback receives IRpcContext and returns context.success or context.failed synchronously or asynchronously. Legacy ordinary throws usually become INTERNAL; trusted wire summaries and SCHEMA_INVALID retain public classification. Runtime operations serialize the original failure.
The same endpoint for chaining; disposal rejects new registrations.
on: Registers a one-way event listener; callbacks receive IRpcContext and async failures are observed through endpoint hooks.
on.event: Application event name matching the sender dispatch method.
on.listener: Application callback receives IRpcContext, returns void or Promise<void>, and should not retain expired response operations.
Idempotent unsubscriber removes only this registration.
send: Sends a correlated scalar request to the selected receiver and waits for one actual provider result.
send.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
send.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
send.data: Application request payload validated by the installed contract/codec.
send.options: Optional ISendOptions supplied by the caller; timeout, cancellation, transfer, idempotency and trace remain explicit.
Promise of provider data; remote business failure, cancellation, deadline, transport or lifecycle failure rejects with its native coded error. A synchronous UUID admission failure releases operation signal listeners; ordinary send cancellation keeps RpcAbortError.
sendAll: Sends the same scalar method to the statically configured target seeds and keeps each target success/failure separately.
sendAll.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
sendAll.data: Application payload sent independently to every selected target.
sendAll.options: Caller ISendOptions applied to the selected fan-out operations.
IRpcFanoutResult maps receiver/target keys to fulfilled data or original rejected errors.
dispatch: Sends a legacy one-way event without awaiting business completion; pair with on on the receiving endpoint.
dispatch.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
dispatch.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
dispatch.data: Application event payload for the receiving listener.
Returns void once dispatch is initiated; failures are contained in endpoint hooks.
dispatchAll: Dispatches one event to the statically configured target seeds without waiting for business listeners.
dispatchAll.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
dispatchAll.data: Application event payload for each selected target.
Returns void after scheduling selected dispatches; hooks observe failures.
group: Reserves every request-only step before execution, then runs in order until first failure; successful earlier effects are not rolled back.
group.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
group.steps: Application nonempty method/payload array admitted as IRpcRuntimeGroupSteps.
group.options: Optional IRpcRuntimeGroupOptions with actual ordering/cancellation/idempotency and local send controls.
Promise of actual step outcomes; unsupported native group capability rejects before dispatch.
outcome: Reads an original logical key outcome from the provider store without executing providers again.
outcome.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
outcome.idempotencyKey: Original application-issued key used for the same earlier logical operation.
IRpcRuntimeOutcomeResult reports pending/done/unknown and store continuity; unknown never proves nonexecution.
announceClose: Announces a bounded drain window to one peer while leaving actual physical close with its owning adapter.
announceClose.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
announceClose.options: Caller drainMs duration and optional receiverId from discovery; this is a relative peer announcement.
Resolves when the close control is sent; it does not await remote resource disposal.
ping: Checks one actual receiver liveness; requires installed ping capability and actual negotiated support.
ping.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
ping.receiverId: Specific receiver identifier returned by discovery candidates or connect.getServerList; never invent an instance address.
ping.options: Optional IRpcPingOptions with local signal and deadline override.
Promise<boolean> for the observed reply; disposal settles an active ping as false. Calling after disposal or without ping capability throws its coded error. Ping cancellation does not require abort middleware.
pingAll: Checks liveness of the statically configured target seeds and retains individual success/failure results.
IRpcFanoutResult<boolean> keyed by the selected actual receivers.
connect: Connection/discovery controls derived from the actual middleware tuple; manual mode exposes query and registration operations.
discovery: Read-only candidate listing and explicit receiver pin controls sharing the canonical discovery owner.
hooks: Local diagnostic subscription facade; hooks.on receives IRpcHookEvent and returns an unsubscriber.
dispose: Idempotently stops admission, drains owned work and releases middleware/adapter resources in the canonical lifecycle order.
Promise resolves after disposal; cleanup failures remain reachable through standard cause/errors traversal, including all failures in the same batch; future operations fail ENDPOINT_DISPOSED.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import IRpcError from @migaia/rpc-core, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use IRpcError when its type contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when IRpcError does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.content: Use a maintained type example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
source: Stable source identifying the owner that originally created this error.
code: Original semantic code identifying the actual failure branch.
cause: Exact original failure preserved on the cause chain when supplied.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content: Compose actual endpoint or runtime peers while keeping transport and lifecycle ownership with their canonical owners.

blocks.text: 错误保留原生类型、message、stack 与 cause；错误形状用 IRpcError，平台/拓扑值域用 IRpcPlatformValue / IRpcTransportTopologyValue。按稳定 source/code 而非 message 分支，远端身份只作诊断，不授予本地控制权。

isRpcErrorInstance / isRpcRemoteError / isRpcTimeoutError 按稳定字段跨 realm/副本判断，不能依赖 instanceof；isRpcError 只检查字符串 code，不能替代错误族守卫。RpcError、RpcRemoteError、RpcTimeoutError 等仅类型导出，唯一公开可构造类为 RpcLifecycleError，供持有自身释放状态的消费方使用。

准入拒绝，具体原因看提供方 onRejected
载体失败，已送达与否需对账
路径缺失、重复登记、未结算
过期 context 结算返回 ok:false
值域、尺寸、二进制或 schema 错误

能力未协商或归属/实例有歧义
配置非法，含不适用的 transfer
无目标或同名实例不唯一
认证失败，先修会话/凭据
已交付项以外的流结果未知
业务已执行，结果未保留，不换键重执行
目标代次不符/退役，转发调用可能已执行
属性访问或转字符串失败，保留原因
冷 Probe listener、中间件安装或 reporter 失败，检查 cause / 宿主队列

blocks.text: 认证 reason 为 RpcAuthenticationRejectionReason.sessionUnknown（重新发现会话）或 challengeInvalid（修正帧）。手动 connect.query 取消保留原生 DOMException/AbortError，CANCELLED 的 cause 指向 signal.reason。Core serializeRpcError/deserializeRpcError 还保留本层脱敏与转发路由元数据；树结构与 JSON-RPC 映射由 rpc-contract 拥有。
