declaredConfiguration.name: type
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional plugin route, defaulting through each registry call to primaryType.

declaredConfiguration.name: context
declaredConfiguration.description: Diagnostic label, default stream.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxInFlight
declaredConfiguration.description: Backpressure limit for concurrent requests. Defaults to 1, waiting for each encoded slice before encoding the next. Only one slice is in flight at that setting. Higher limits overlap encoding with worker processing at the cost of retaining more slices in memory.

declaredConfiguration.name: targetMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Target duration per slice. Defaults to 8 ms, leaving about half a 16.7 ms frame at 60 fps for rendering and other work.

declaredConfiguration.name: minItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Minimum slice size, default 64; must be a positive safe integer.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum slice size, default 250000; must be a positive safe integer at least minItems.

declaredConfiguration.name: initialItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Initial size, default 2048; a positive safe integer clamped to the configured min/max bounds.

declaredConfiguration.name: yieldTo
declaredConfiguration.description: Yield mechanism. Defaults to `scheduler.schedule(resolve, 0)`. Can use `scheduler.yield()` for finer scheduling or requestIdleCallback for a more conservative yield. A custom callback owns its own cancellation and settlement; it cannot forcibly interrupt consumer work.

declaredConfiguration.name: signal
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional cooperative cancellation signal, default undefined; checked between slice admissions.

declaredConfiguration.name: scheduler
declaredConfiguration.description: Required runtime-neutral scheduler. Core has no default timer and never directly accesses host `setTimeout`, `performance`, or `Date.now`.

blocks.text: SerializeCodecError(message, details) 的 details 必含 code、type、phase、chunkIndex、bytesConsumed，可选 context、source、cause；source 默认 @migaia/serialize，TCode 默认 ISerializeErrorCode，上层可用自己的 code 联合与 source 复用它。phase 为 encode/decode，cause 保留原对象。registry 编解码失败和原生构造/生命周期失败载体不同，统一按 (source, code) 判断，不能只靠 instanceof。

rows: ENCODE_FAILED：编码、空输出或流迭代失败；cause 保留原错。
INVALID_CHUNK：tuple/标签/数据错、value 混流或转 wire。
ABORTED：协作式取消；可能为 SerializeCodecError 或 tagged 原生错误，取决于边界。
INVALID_OPTION：插件、版本、portable、scheduler、流选项、Base64 或输出准入非法。
ENV_UNSUPPORTED：Encoding 等必需宿主能力缺失。

blocks.text: tagSerializeError(error, code, context?) 返回原错误并附只读 source/code，context 未提供保持未设；同身份重复附加幂等，context 仅补一次。冲突委托 utils，抛 (@migaia/utils, ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT)，原错误在 cause，不能静默改写身份。

ISerializeTaggedError 为原生错误附 source/code/context 的类型；ISerializeTypeError、ISerializeRangeError 保持各自原生类型，ISerializeLifecycleError 另允许 errors。createSerializeError、createSerializeTypeError、createSerializeRangeError 分别构造带码 Error/TypeError/RangeError；code/message 必填，options 默认未提供，均允许 cause/context，普通 Error 另允许 errors 的冻结快照。错误码是公开 API，错误 factory 不改写 stack。空输出进度为 0；decode 坏 chunk 进度为 0；decode parser 原错携带该段字节数；外层 stream 重新包装保留自己的片序，不丢掉内层原因。
value 不能转文本/字节或混用时应回到业务对象处理；CODEC_NOT_FOUND 先检查 types 与存档的 type；REGISTRY_DISPOSED 需要新 registry；collectStream 合并含 bytes 的多段须显式 encoder。大数据仍阻塞时检查初始片大小、上下限与 yieldTo，不能把切片当作抢占式终止。

完整组合顺序为：创建 registry；逐片 encode 并交实际 sink；接收端逐片 decode；旧格式用记录的 type 读取，新写默认 primaryType；需要文本边界时再显式做 UTF-8/Base64；最后 await dispose，若设 deadline，记住它只限排空。包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test 与单独 build，不把未复核历史测量当作性能结论。

source: Identifies this package as `@migaia/serialize`; combine it with `code` when classifying failures.
code: Stable semantic failure code from `SerializeErrorCode`, independent from diagnostic message text.
context: Optional caller label copied from operation or error construction, identifying the affected resource.
Omitted when the caller provides no context label.
errors: Optional frozen copied snapshot of nonempty secondary failure input; does not replace the original cause.
Absent for omitted or empty error lists.

blocks.text: SerializeCodecError(message, details) 的 details 必含 code、type、phase、chunkIndex、bytesConsumed，可选 context、source、cause；source 默认 @migaia/serialize，TCode 默认 ISerializeErrorCode，上层可用自己的 code 联合与 source 复用它。phase 为 encode/decode，cause 保留原对象。registry 编解码失败和原生构造/生命周期失败载体不同，统一按 (source, code) 判断，不能只靠 instanceof。

rows: ENCODE_FAILED：编码、空输出或流迭代失败；cause 保留原错。
INVALID_CHUNK：tuple/标签/数据错、value 混流或转 wire。
ABORTED：协作式取消；可能为 SerializeCodecError 或 tagged 原生错误，取决于边界。
INVALID_OPTION：插件、版本、portable、scheduler、流选项、Base64 或输出准入非法。
ENV_UNSUPPORTED：Encoding 等必需宿主能力缺失。

blocks.text: tagSerializeError(error, code, context?) 返回原错误并附只读 source/code，context 未提供保持未设；同身份重复附加幂等，context 仅补一次。冲突委托 utils，抛 (@migaia/utils, ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT)，原错误在 cause，不能静默改写身份。

ISerializeTaggedError 为原生错误附 source/code/context 的类型；ISerializeTypeError、ISerializeRangeError 保持各自原生类型，ISerializeLifecycleError 另允许 errors。createSerializeError、createSerializeTypeError、createSerializeRangeError 分别构造带码 Error/TypeError/RangeError；code/message 必填，options 默认未提供，均允许 cause/context，普通 Error 另允许 errors 的冻结快照。错误码是公开 API，错误 factory 不改写 stack。空输出进度为 0；decode 坏 chunk 进度为 0；decode parser 原错携带该段字节数；外层 stream 重新包装保留自己的片序，不丢掉内层原因。
value 不能转文本/字节或混用时应回到业务对象处理；CODEC_NOT_FOUND 先检查 types 与存档的 type；REGISTRY_DISPOSED 需要新 registry；collectStream 合并含 bytes 的多段须显式 encoder。大数据仍阻塞时检查初始片大小、上下限与 yieldTo，不能把切片当作抢占式终止。

完整组合顺序为：创建 registry；逐片 encode 并交实际 sink；接收端逐片 decode；旧格式用记录的 type 读取，新写默认 primaryType；需要文本边界时再显式做 UTF-8/Base64；最后 await dispose，若设 deadline，记住它只限排空。包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test 与单独 build，不把未复核历史测量当作性能结论。

symbols.name: ISerializeRegistry
symbols.purpose: Registry instance returned by createSerializeRegistry, owning parser admission, asynchronous operation tracking and two-phase shutdown. Close cancels admission; dispose drains then releases resources with stable promise identity.
symbols.core:
primaryType: Default write and read type captured from the first plugin passed to `createSerializeRegistry`.
types: Snapshot of registered type strings in plugin order; no registration API adds formats after construction.
has: Checks whether a format is currently registered; returns false after disposal clears the parser table.
has.type: Format tag copied from a stored envelope or chosen from this registry types list.
`true` for a registered format, `false` otherwise; it does not start any parser work.
encode: Runs one parser and assembles its chunks into one complete result. Caller cancellation or close rejects promptly even if parser work ignores its signal.
encode.value: Application value supplied by the caller and admitted by the selected parser.
encode.options: Optional operation fields: `type` defaults to the first plugin; `signal` defaults to no caller signal; `context` defaults to `anonymous`. Obtain type from plugin registration or an envelope and signal from an abort controller.
A `Promise<ISerializeChunk>`: one value, concatenated text, or merged bytes. Rejects with `REGISTRY_DISPOSED`, `CODEC_NOT_FOUND`, `ABORTED`, `ENCODE_FAILED` or `INVALID_CHUNK`; parser failure remains on cause.
decode: Validates one chunk then runs its selected parser, preserving the original payload identity where the parser permits.
decode.chunk: Chunk returned by encode or reconstructed from a stored envelope; select its original format through options.type.
decode.options: Optional `type`, `signal` and `context`; defaults are the first plugin, no caller signal, and `anonymous`. Read type from the stored envelope, and signal from an abort controller.
A promise of the parser result. Rejects on closure, unknown format, cancellation, malformed chunks or parser failure with `REGISTRY_DISPOSED`, `CODEC_NOT_FOUND`, `ABORTED`, `INVALID_CHUNK` or `DECODE_FAILED`.
close: Synchronously stops admission and aborts the registry closing signal. Repeated calls are harmless; parser disposers are not invoked here.
Admission is closed and running public operations observe cancellation; use dispose to wait for resource cleanup.
dispose: Closes admission, drains pending parser work, then awaits owned parser disposers. Repeated calls return the same promise; the first admitted call fixes its deadline.
dispose.options: Optional `deadlineAt`: finite absolute time in the construction scheduler clock. Default is no deadline; obtain it from scheduler.now() plus a duration. Expired deadlines skip draining but still clean parsers.
Shared `Promise<void>` settling after parser cleanup. A deadline emits a diagnostic rather than a timeout rejection; cleanup follows the configured throw or report policy.

value 不能转文本/字节或混用时应回到业务对象处理；CODEC_NOT_FOUND 先检查 types 与存档的 type；REGISTRY_DISPOSED 需要新 registry；collectStream 合并含 bytes 的多段须显式 encoder。大数据仍阻塞时检查初始片大小、上下限与 yieldTo，不能把切片当作抢占式终止。

symbols.name: sliceByFrameBudget
symbols.purpose: Yields array slices and measures consumer work between yield and resume to adjust the next slice size. It waits between slices using an injected scheduler or yield callback; a target duration is adaptive rather than preemptive.
symbols.core:
items: Caller-owned source array; each yielded slice is a shallow array copy with original item references.
AsyncGenerator of readonly array slices. Invalid options throw INVALID_OPTION; an aborted signal throws ABORTED. Early return stops future slices.
targetMs: Positive finite consumer processing budget in milliseconds; measured elapsed time adjusts the next slice size.
`8` milliseconds per slice; this is a target rather than a hard execution deadline.
minItems: Positive safe integer lower bound on items per slice, reducing overhead from very small batches.
`64` items, including the lower clamp applied to the initial slice.
maxItems: Positive safe integer upper bound on items per slice; must be at least `minItems`.
`250000` items; adaptive growth never exceeds this upper bound.
initialItems: Positive safe integer initial size before consumer timing is available; clamped between the item bounds.
`2048` items before clamping to `minItems` and `maxItems`.
yieldTo: Optional no-argument async callback invoked between slices. Resolve after yielding execution; a throw or rejection stops iteration.
A `Promise<void>` whose fulfillment permits the next slice; rejection reaches the stream consumer.
Schedules a zero-delay task with the supplied scheduler; its wait observes cancellation.
Use a host task or frame callback when consumers must let other work run between slices. The callback returns Promise<void>; rejection stops iteration. Omission schedules a zero-delay task through scheduler and observes cancellation.
signal: Caller-owned structural `IAbortSignal`, usually from `createAbortController().signal`, requests cooperative cancellation.
`undefined`: no caller cancellation signal is installed.
scheduler: Required `IScheduler`, with no default: `now()` returns finite monotonic milliseconds; `schedule(callback, delayMs)` asynchronously schedules the no-argument callback and returns a task with idempotent `cancel()` and optional `unref()`. An optional `defer(callback)` is part of the scheduler contract but is not required for slicing. Use `systemScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler` for host scheduling.

ISerializeTaggedError 为原生错误附 source/code/context 的类型；ISerializeTypeError、ISerializeRangeError 保持各自原生类型，ISerializeLifecycleError 另允许 errors。createSerializeError、createSerializeTypeError、createSerializeRangeError 分别构造带码 Error/TypeError/RangeError；code/message 必填，options 默认未提供，均允许 cause/context，普通 Error 另允许 errors 的冻结快照。错误码是公开 API，错误 factory 不改写 stack。空输出进度为 0；decode 坏 chunk 进度为 0；decode parser 原错携带该段字节数；外层 stream 重新包装保留自己的片序，不丢掉内层原因。
value 不能转文本/字节或混用时应回到业务对象处理；CODEC_NOT_FOUND 先检查 types 与存档的 type；REGISTRY_DISPOSED 需要新 registry；collectStream 合并含 bytes 的多段须显式 encoder。大数据仍阻塞时检查初始片大小、上下限与 yieldTo，不能把切片当作抢占式终止。

symbols.name: createSerializeRegistry
symbols.purpose: Creates a registry owning a nonempty plugin set and parser cleanup. The first plugin selects default writes and reads; types and methods are captured at construction and duplicate types reject. Chunks carry only kind and payload, so older formats must be selected using their separately stored `type`. The migration case uses JSON parser options `replacer` and `reviver`: both receive the current property key (including an empty root key) and value, synchronously return its replacement, and default to `undefined`. The old reader maps numeric theme 0 to light through its reviver; `space` defaults to undefined (compact output), and `decoder` defaults to a host TextDecoder when bytes are decoded. sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Creates a registry owning a nonempty plugin set and parser cleanup. The first plugin selects default writes and reads; types and methods are captured at construction and duplicate types reject. Chunks carry only kind and payload, so older formats must be selected using their separately stored `type`. The migration case uses JSON parser options `replacer` and `reviver`: both receive the current property key (including an empty root key) and value, synchronously return its replacement, and default to `undefined`. The old reader maps numeric theme 0 to light through its reviver; `space` defaults to undefined (compact output), and `decoder` defaults to a host TextDecoder when bytes are decoded. Returning undefined from the replacer omits an object property. These plugin options are separate from registry options below.

guidance.id: 操作上下文-写选项与快照
guidance.heading: 操作上下文、写选项与快照

blocks.text: `IOperationContext` 是异步方法末尾的可选参数；`IWriteOptions` 额外允许 conflictPolicy。

rows: undefined。结构兼容 IAbortSignal：aborted 为 boolean，addEventListener/removeEventListener 为函数。保留原信号引用。
undefined；提供时为非负安全整数，允许 0。实现层负责超时计时和与外部信号组合，本包只校验。
undefined；提供时必须为 1 到 4096 的整数，用于实现层的分页迭代。
快照未提供时仍为 undefined；写入契约的缺省策略为 conflict。合法值是 'conflict'、'replace' 或 undefined。

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy.conflict` 的值为 `'conflict'`，表示已存在则失败；`ConflictPolicy.replace` 的值为 `'replace'`，表示覆盖。使用该常量和 IConflictPolicy，不另造重复常量或别名。

`snapshotOperationContext(ctx)` 接受上下文或 undefined。undefined 原样返回；合法对象的 signal、timeoutMs、pageSize、conflictPolicy 各读一次，返回冻结快照。再次传入本函数产物会返回同一个对象，不重复读取原 getter。非法对象、字段、信号结构或 getter 失败抛 INVALID_ARGUMENT，原始原因通过 cause 保留。`assertOperationContext(ctx)` 调用相同校验，只丢弃返回值。
冻结的是上下文字段，不是信号状态。已经 aborted 的有效信号也能通过形状校验；本包不等待操作、不启动计时器、不创建取消引擎。取消感知后端用 ABORTED 结束等待，不保证原生 AbortError；已经进入原子提交的写应报告真实提交结果，不伪报回滚。

`ISyncWriteOptions` 只允许可选 conflictPolicy。`snapshotSyncWriteOptions(options)` 接受对象或 undefined，读取 signal、timeoutMs、conflictPolicy，拒绝非 undefined 的 signal/timeoutMs；显式的 undefined 字段合法。额外 pageSize 不读取，也不提供同步分页。返回新对象 { conflictPolicy }，不冻结，省略策略仍为 undefined；`assertSyncWriteOptions(options)` 只校验、不返回快照。非法结构、字段或 getter 失败均为 INVALID_ARGUMENT。

guidance.heading: 操作上下文、写选项与快照

blocks.text: `IOperationContext` 是异步方法末尾的可选参数；`IWriteOptions` 额外允许 conflictPolicy。

rows: undefined。结构兼容 IAbortSignal：aborted 为 boolean，addEventListener/removeEventListener 为函数。保留原信号引用。
undefined；提供时为非负安全整数，允许 0。实现层负责超时计时和与外部信号组合，本包只校验。
undefined；提供时必须为 1 到 4096 的整数，用于实现层的分页迭代。
快照未提供时仍为 undefined；写入契约的缺省策略为 conflict。合法值是 'conflict'、'replace' 或 undefined。

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy.conflict` 的值为 `'conflict'`，表示已存在则失败；`ConflictPolicy.replace` 的值为 `'replace'`，表示覆盖。使用该常量和 IConflictPolicy，不另造重复常量或别名。

`snapshotOperationContext(ctx)` 接受上下文或 undefined。undefined 原样返回；合法对象的 signal、timeoutMs、pageSize、conflictPolicy 各读一次，返回冻结快照。再次传入本函数产物会返回同一个对象，不重复读取原 getter。非法对象、字段、信号结构或 getter 失败抛 INVALID_ARGUMENT，原始原因通过 cause 保留。`assertOperationContext(ctx)` 调用相同校验，只丢弃返回值。
冻结的是上下文字段，不是信号状态。已经 aborted 的有效信号也能通过形状校验；本包不等待操作、不启动计时器、不创建取消引擎。取消感知后端用 ABORTED 结束等待，不保证原生 AbortError；已经进入原子提交的写应报告真实提交结果，不伪报回滚。

`ISyncWriteOptions` 只允许可选 conflictPolicy。`snapshotSyncWriteOptions(options)` 接受对象或 undefined，读取 signal、timeoutMs、conflictPolicy，拒绝非 undefined 的 signal/timeoutMs；显式的 undefined 字段合法。额外 pageSize 不读取，也不提供同步分页。返回新对象 { conflictPolicy }，不冻结，省略策略仍为 undefined；`assertSyncWriteOptions(options)` 只校验、不返回快照。非法结构、字段或 getter 失败均为 INVALID_ARGUMENT。

blocks.text: `IOperationContext` 是异步方法末尾的可选参数；`IWriteOptions` 额外允许 conflictPolicy。

rows: undefined。结构兼容 IAbortSignal：aborted 为 boolean，addEventListener/removeEventListener 为函数。保留原信号引用。
undefined；提供时为非负安全整数，允许 0。实现层负责超时计时和与外部信号组合，本包只校验。
undefined；提供时必须为 1 到 4096 的整数，用于实现层的分页迭代。
快照未提供时仍为 undefined；写入契约的缺省策略为 conflict。合法值是 'conflict'、'replace' 或 undefined。

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy.conflict` 的值为 `'conflict'`，表示已存在则失败；`ConflictPolicy.replace` 的值为 `'replace'`，表示覆盖。使用该常量和 IConflictPolicy，不另造重复常量或别名。

`snapshotOperationContext(ctx)` 接受上下文或 undefined。undefined 原样返回；合法对象的 signal、timeoutMs、pageSize、conflictPolicy 各读一次，返回冻结快照。再次传入本函数产物会返回同一个对象，不重复读取原 getter。非法对象、字段、信号结构或 getter 失败抛 INVALID_ARGUMENT，原始原因通过 cause 保留。`assertOperationContext(ctx)` 调用相同校验，只丢弃返回值。
冻结的是上下文字段，不是信号状态。已经 aborted 的有效信号也能通过形状校验；本包不等待操作、不启动计时器、不创建取消引擎。取消感知后端用 ABORTED 结束等待，不保证原生 AbortError；已经进入原子提交的写应报告真实提交结果，不伪报回滚。

`ISyncWriteOptions` 只允许可选 conflictPolicy。`snapshotSyncWriteOptions(options)` 接受对象或 undefined，读取 signal、timeoutMs、conflictPolicy，拒绝非 undefined 的 signal/timeoutMs；显式的 undefined 字段合法。额外 pageSize 不读取，也不提供同步分页。返回新对象 { conflictPolicy }，不冻结，省略策略仍为 undefined；`assertSyncWriteOptions(options)` 只校验、不返回快照。非法结构、字段或 getter 失败均为 INVALID_ARGUMENT。

blocks.text: `IOperationContext` 是异步方法末尾的可选参数；`IWriteOptions` 额外允许 conflictPolicy。

rows: undefined。结构兼容 IAbortSignal：aborted 为 boolean，addEventListener/removeEventListener 为函数。保留原信号引用。
undefined；提供时为非负安全整数，允许 0。实现层负责超时计时和与外部信号组合，本包只校验。
undefined；提供时必须为 1 到 4096 的整数，用于实现层的分页迭代。
快照未提供时仍为 undefined；写入契约的缺省策略为 conflict。合法值是 'conflict'、'replace' 或 undefined。

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy.conflict` 的值为 `'conflict'`，表示已存在则失败；`ConflictPolicy.replace` 的值为 `'replace'`，表示覆盖。使用该常量和 IConflictPolicy，不另造重复常量或别名。

`snapshotOperationContext(ctx)` 接受上下文或 undefined。undefined 原样返回；合法对象的 signal、timeoutMs、pageSize、conflictPolicy 各读一次，返回冻结快照。再次传入本函数产物会返回同一个对象，不重复读取原 getter。非法对象、字段、信号结构或 getter 失败抛 INVALID_ARGUMENT，原始原因通过 cause 保留。`assertOperationContext(ctx)` 调用相同校验，只丢弃返回值。
冻结的是上下文字段，不是信号状态。已经 aborted 的有效信号也能通过形状校验；本包不等待操作、不启动计时器、不创建取消引擎。取消感知后端用 ABORTED 结束等待，不保证原生 AbortError；已经进入原子提交的写应报告真实提交结果，不伪报回滚。

`ISyncWriteOptions` 只允许可选 conflictPolicy。`snapshotSyncWriteOptions(options)` 接受对象或 undefined，读取 signal、timeoutMs、conflictPolicy，拒绝非 undefined 的 signal/timeoutMs；显式的 undefined 字段合法。额外 pageSize 不读取，也不提供同步分页。返回新对象 { conflictPolicy }，不冻结，省略策略仍为 undefined；`assertSyncWriteOptions(options)` 只校验、不返回快照。非法结构、字段或 getter 失败均为 INVALID_ARGUMENT。

maxBinaryBytes: Each binary key buffer may contain at most 1048576 bytes; this is not a sum over all buffers.

guidance.id: 只读取一次操作选项-把取消执行留给后端
guidance.heading: 只读取一次操作选项，把取消执行留给后端

blocks.text: 通过访问器提供的选项可能在校验和使用之间变化，各层重读又可能得到不同的超时或策略。`snapshotOperationContext()` 只读取一次四个字段并冻结记录；再次传入该快照会复用同一对象。已取消的信号仍可被接纳，因为函数只校验意图，实际取消与超时由后端实现。
本例四个字段各由一个 getter 提供：signal 是原生 AbortSignal，timeoutMs 为允许的 0，pageSize 为 1–4096 内的 100，conflictPolicy 为 `replace`（覆盖）。字段省略都保持 undefined；另一策略 `conflict` 表示已存在则失败。取消和计时由实际后端执行。
输出：

blocks.code:
冻结: true
复用快照: true
字段读取次数: 4
信号已取消: true
选项: 0 100 replace

blocks.text: 依次输出 `冻结: true`、`复用快照: true`、`字段读取次数: 4`、`信号已取消: true`、`选项: 0 100 replace`。两次调用合计每字段只读取一次，保留原信号且允许零超时；函数没有建立定时器或取消订阅。

guidance.heading: 报告契约错误时保留原始失败

blocks.text: 校验边界捕获原生失败后只报告消息，调用方无法再检查原始原因。手写诊断字段也容易遗漏来源和错误码。用相应公开错误码及原始 `cause` 构造 `StorageContractError`，由它持有稳定身份字段和原生原因链。
第一个参数是公开码 INVALID_ARGUMENT；第二个参数的 backend 为 `memory`，cause 为同一个 TypeError。可选 key 本例省略，默认 undefined；details 默认空对象。可选第三个 message 省略，使用由 code 生成的默认消息。冻结错误实例不会冻结 cause。

blocks.code:
import { StorageContractError, StorageContractErrorCode } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const cause = new TypeError('分页大小无效')
const error = new StorageContractError(StorageContractErrorCode.invalidArgument, {
  backend: 'memory',
  cause
})
console.log('来源:', error.source)
console.log('错误码:', error.code)
console.log('后端:', error.backend)
console.log('保留原错:', error.cause === cause)
console.log('原错消息:', (error.cause as Error).message)
console.log('冻结:', Object.isFrozen(error))

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
来源: @migaia/storage-contract
错误码: INVALID_ARGUMENT
后端: memory
保留原错: true
原错消息: 分页大小无效
冻结: true

blocks.text: 依次输出 `来源: @migaia/storage-contract`、`错误码: INVALID_ARGUMENT`、`后端: memory`、`保留原错: true`、`原错消息: 分页大小无效`、`冻结: true`。原生原因链指向同一个原始对象。错误实例已冻结，但不会冻结原因对象。

`new StorageContractError(code, details?, message?)` 创建错误后立即冻结。code 必填；details 默认 {}，字段 backend、key、cause 都可选，默认 undefined。backend 为 IBackendKind，key 为字符串或 IStorageKey，cause 是原始失败。message 省略时为 `[storage-contract] ${code}`。name 为 StorageContractError，source 恒为 `STORAGE_CONTRACT_SOURCE`，即 `'@migaia/storage-contract'`，不重写 stack，标准 cause 仍可追到原对象。
`isStorageContractError(value)` 使用本包类的 instanceof 判断。错误码属于公开 API；实现包自己的错误 source 与这里不同，使用 (source, code) 判断归属。web codec、迁移和扩展的附加诊断细节属于 storage-web，不扩进本包错误详情。

rows: 描述符、上下文、同步写或事务选项等非法；修正参数，不重试相同坏输入。
键类型、深度、节点、字节限制、循环、空数组或空洞非法；修正键。
所需能力不存在；先做能力分支或换实现，不静默降级。
已结束的实例继续使用；新建 store。
实现层操作被信号或超时取消；按取消处理，原子提交返回真实结果。

blocks.text: 字节 guard 从 `@migaia/utils/bytes` 导入，不再从本包转出。内部槽品牌识别与字节是否仍可读是两件事，detached 对象仍可能保持品牌。`intrinsicConstructorName(value)` 只做尽力诊断：会观察可修改的原型、constructor 和 name，非对象、null 或读取失败返回 undefined。不能把它用于安全、类型或协议判断。

members.name: invalidArgument
members.description: A public argument or descriptor fails contract shape validation. Applies to codec descriptors, * capability descriptors, key domains, transaction options, and operation contexts. * * Enforces runtime public argument and contract shape validation. Adapter-specific configuration * validation uses the web `INVALID_CONFIG` code instead. * * The caller corrects the argument before retrying. The failure persists until the argument * changes.

members.name: invalidKey
members.description: An `IStorageKey` violates the key domain through an invalid type, excessive depth, node count * or binary bytes, a cycle, or an empty array. * * Enforces contract key validation. * * The caller corrects the key rather than retrying the same invalid key.

members.name: unsupported
members.description: An operation requires a capability that the current backend does not provide. Examples include * failed `asRecordStore` narrowing and a structured codec on a text-only backend. * * Enforces contract capability narrowing. * * The caller checks `capabilities` or `isRecordStore`, or selects a backend with the required * capability. The operation does not silently fall back.

members.name: disposed
members.description: A storage operation runs after the store is disposed, violating the lifecycle contract. * * Enforces contract lifecycle semantics. * * The caller creates a new store instead of reusing the closed instance.

members.name: aborted
members.description: `IOperationContext.signal` cancels an operation or `timeoutMs` expires. * * Enforces contract cancellation semantics. * * The caller handles the result as cancellation. A write that has entered atomic commit reports * the actual commit result rather than claiming rollback.

symbols.name: StorageErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Table of this package’s 37 stable error codes; values are the strings on error.code. `INDEX_BACKFILL_FAILED` identifies backfill and failed-readiness persistence failing together on a native AggregateError.
symbols.core:
unavailable: `BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE`: storage is disabled or missing (private mode); pick `memoryStorageHost` or ask for access.
quotaExceeded: `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`: the browser quota is full; delete data or use IndexedDB.
valueTooLarge: `VALUE_TOO_LARGE`: a cookie value is over 4 KB.
serializeFailed: `SERIALIZE_FAILED`: encoding the value failed.
deserializeFailed: `DESERIALIZE_FAILED`: decoding the stored value failed.
validationFailed: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: the schema rejected the value.
migrationFailed: `MIGRATION_FAILED`: a migration function threw.
transactionFailed: `TRANSACTION_FAILED`: the IndexedDB transaction failed or the callback threw.
duplicateKey: `DUPLICATE_KEY`: the key is used by another channel; pass `conflictPolicy: "replace"` to overwrite.
versionUnsupported: `VERSION_UNSUPPORTED`: stored data is newer than this code.
extensionFailed: `EXTENSION_FAILED`: a schema, codec or comparator threw.
transactionConflict: `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT`: data changed concurrently; re-read and retry.
writeFailed: `WRITE_FAILED`: a written cookie was not visible afterwards.
cookieScopeAmbiguous: `COOKIE_SCOPE_AMBIGUOUS`: one cookie name is visible in several scopes.
invalidConfig: `INVALID_CONFIG`: an option or scope is invalid.
indexOrphan: `INDEX_ORPHAN`: an index points to a missing record; rebuild it.
indexUniqueConflict: `INDEX_UNIQUE_CONFLICT`: a unique index key belongs to another record.
indexQueryInvalidated: `INDEX_QUERY_INVALIDATED`: data changed during paging; restart the query.
liveQueryDisposed: `LIVE_QUERY_DISPOSED`: the live query was disposed; create a new one.
indexBackfillStale: `INDEX_BACKFILL_STALE`: an index backfill checkpoint expired; reconnect and retry.
indexBackfillFailed: `INDEX_BACKFILL_FAILED`: backfill and persisting failed readiness both failed. The native AggregateError keeps the primary error first in errors and as cause, followed by the persistence failure; inspect both original objects before retrying.
backendIdInvalid: `BACKEND_ID_INVALID`: the backend id breaks the id rule.
backendDuplicate: `BACKEND_DUPLICATE`: the id is already installed.
backendNotInstalled: `BACKEND_NOT_INSTALLED`: no backend with this id; there is no default.
backendPluginInvalid: `BACKEND_PLUGIN_INVALID`: the plugin or its store breaks the contract.
backendInstallFailed: `BACKEND_INSTALL_FAILED`: installation failed and was rolled back; see `cause`.
storageHostBusy: `STORAGE_HOST_BUSY`: another installation is running; retry after it settles.
storageHostDisposed: `STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSED`: the host was disposed; create a new one.
storageHostDisposeFailed: `STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSE_FAILED`: cleanup failed; the host is still terminal.
liveQueryDisposeFailed: `LIVE_QUERY_DISPOSE_FAILED`: query cleanup failed; see `errors`.
reactiveFeatureInvalid: `REACTIVE_FEATURE_INVALID`: the reactive Feature does not match the backend.
reactiveTopologyInvalid: `REACTIVE_TOPOLOGY_INVALID`: the Feature graph is unknown, duplicated or cyclic.
reactiveServiceNotInstalled: `REACTIVE_SERVICE_NOT_INSTALLED`: install a reactive plugin before creating queries.
reactiveAdapterNotInstalled: `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_NOT_INSTALLED`: the backend id is not reactive.
reactiveAdapterFailed: `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_FAILED`: the adapter failed; later changes may recover.
reactiveAdapterDisposeFailed: `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_DISPOSE_FAILED`: adapter cleanup failed.
backendDisposeFailed: `BACKEND_DISPOSE_FAILED`: backend cleanup failed.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.

members.name: unavailable
members.description: A storage backend is unavailable because a private-mode probe fails or localStorage, IndexedDB, * or `document` is disabled or missing. * * The caller selects `memoryStorageHost` explicitly or asks the user to enable storage access, * rather than retrying the same unavailable backend. Enforces the availability probe contract.

members.name: quotaExceeded
members.description: A write reaches the browser quota, such as `QuotaExceededError` or Firefox's * `NS_ERROR_DOM_QUOTA_REACHED`. * * The caller removes unneeded data or selects IndexedDB. The failure persists until storage * conditions change.

members.name: valueTooLarge
members.description: A serialized cookie assignment exceeds the 4 KB limit. * * The caller shortens the value, name, or attributes, or stores the data in IndexedDB. The * library does not silently truncate the assignment.

members.name: serializeFailed
members.description: Serialization fails because `JSON.stringify` throws, codec `encode` returns unexpected output, * or a memory write fails during `structuredClone`. * * The caller checks whether the value can be serialized. This is a data shape failure rather than * a backend failure.

members.name: deserializeFailed
members.description: Deserialization fails because `JSON.parse` throws, an envelope is malformed, or codec `decode` * returns unexpected output. * * The caller checks whether an external writer or newer version changes the stored data. * `onInvalid` handles the `decode` stage.

members.name: validationFailed
members.description: Schema validation fails because `ISchemaAdapter.validate` throws. The Standard Schema adapter * converts returned issues into a validation failure. * * The caller corrects the data to match the schema. `onInvalid` handles the `validate` stage.

members.name: migrationFailed
members.description: A migration function fails. * * Failure to migrate one record does not affect other records. The caller isolates the failure at * the `migrate` stage or repairs the migration logic.

members.name: transactionFailed
members.description: A transaction or exclusive entity commit fails, including IndexedDB creation/commit, host * coordination, or a callback error outside the storage error family. * * The caller checks whether the transaction crosses the automatic commit boundary or its scope * escapes. Transient concurrency failures can be retried.

members.name: duplicateKey
members.description: A logical key conflicts across the value, bytes, and record channels without `conflictPolicy: * 'replace'`. * * The caller changes the key or explicitly selects `replace` to atomically remove the same key * from other channels.

members.name: versionUnsupported
members.description: Entity envelope `__v` or the IndexedDB schema version exceeds the version known to the current * code. * * The caller upgrades the code or downgrades the data. Older code must not misread or overwrite * data from a newer version.

members.name: extensionFailed
members.description: An extension such as schema, codec, `namespaceCodec`, comparator, or diagnostic throws an * unclassified exception. * * The caller checks the extension implementation. `extensionStage` identifies the failed * extension, and `cause` retains the original exception.

members.name: transactionConflict
members.description: A read revision, global epoch, or KV entity snapshot changes before its atomic/exclusive * commit, causing a concurrent write conflict. * * The caller reads again and retries the entire transaction. This is a retryable concurrency * conflict rather than data corruption.

members.name: writeFailed
members.description: A cookie is not visible after a write because the browser silently rejects it. * * The caller checks cookie attributes (`path`, `domain`, `SameSite`, and `secure`) and capacity. * Privacy policies may still remove the cookie asynchronously.

members.name: cookieScopeAmbiguous
members.description: Multiple visible cookie scopes share a name, so the target value's scope is ambiguous. * * The caller gives each scope a unique cookie name or fixes the scope at construction to avoid * ambiguity.

members.name: invalidConfig
members.description: Web adapter input or configuration validation fails. Covers cookie `SameSite`, `Secure`, * `Partitioned`, and scope settings; IndexedDB factory, store names, and `IDBKeyRange`; * migration, schema, entity, and namespace codecs; backend options; and `selectCodec`'s * `onDiagnostic`. * * Contract shape validation uses `storage-contract`'s `INVALID_ARGUMENT`. This code covers * adapter configuration only, as a local exception to unified argument validation. * * The caller corrects the configuration before retrying. The argument or configuration failure * persists until it changes.

members.name: indexOrphan
members.description: IndexedDB sidecar contains an index row whose authoritative record is absent. Callers should * repair or rebuild the index rather than treating the skipped row as a successful query result.

members.name: indexUniqueConflict
members.description: An indexed mutation would assign one logical unique key to two authoritative records. * Uniqueness is enforced inside the record/sidecar transaction; callers must choose a different * indexed value or remove the competing record before retrying.

members.name: indexQueryInvalidated
members.description: A native `iterateRecordIndex` page observed the global or scope mutation epoch change between * pages. Each page validates a short readonly transaction, then closes it before yielding; * callers must restart the query rather than trust a mixed snapshot.

members.name: liveQueryDisposed
members.description: A live-query consumer attempted to refresh after terminal disposal. Disposal cannot revive * subscriptions or owned reactive state; callers must create a new live query instead of reusing * the disposed handle.

members.name: indexBackfillStale
members.description: A backfill operation presented an expired owner, stale generation, or conflicting checkpoint. * The batch must be rejected and rolled back; callers should retry through a fresh repository * operation after the current handle is reacquired.

members.name: indexBackfillFailed
members.description: Secondary-index backfill failed and persisting its failed readiness also failed. The caller * inspects the native aggregate's original cause/errors before retrying; neither the primary * failure nor the persistence failure may be discarded.

members.name: backendIdInvalid
members.description: A backend definition contains an invalid identifier. Callers must correct the bounded backend * ID before retrying installation.

members.name: backendDuplicate
members.description: A backend ID is already present in the host install batch or registry. Callers must use a * distinct ID or wait for the existing batch before retrying.

members.name: backendNotInstalled
members.description: A lookup requested a valid backend ID that has not been installed. Callers must install that * exact backend or select an installed ID.

members.name: backendPluginInvalid
members.description: A backend plugin or store failed its runtime contract check. Callers must repair the plugin * definition rather than relying on an unvalidated store.

members.name: backendInstallFailed
members.description: Backend creation, preparation, or PluginHost installation failed. Callers may retry after * fixing the cause, while the failed batch remains unpublished.

members.name: storageHostBusy
members.description: A host mutation was requested while another install batch is active. Callers must wait for that * batch to settle and explicitly retry.

members.name: storageHostDisposed
members.description: A host or its public operation was used after sealing or terminal disposal. Callers must create * a new host instead of reviving this one.

members.name: storageHostDisposeFailed
members.description: Host cleanup collected one or more failures. Callers must treat the host as terminal while * inspecting the aggregate errors for cleanup diagnostics.

members.name: liveQueryDisposeFailed
members.description: Live-query request or owned reactive cleanup collected one or more failures. Callers must treat * the query as terminal and inspect AggregateError.errors.

members.name: reactiveFeatureInvalid
members.description: A reactive feature descriptor, brand, provider seam, or adapter result is invalid. Callers must * correct the exact feature/backend pairing before retrying.

members.name: reactiveTopologyInvalid
members.description: Reactive feature topology contains an unknown, duplicate, malformed, or cyclic node. Callers * must repair the feature set before any host mutation occurs.

members.name: reactiveServiceNotInstalled
members.description: Host live-query service is not installed. Callers must install the admitted reactive service * before requesting a query.

members.name: reactiveAdapterNotInstalled
members.description: The requested backend lacks its reactive adapter or is not installed. Callers must use an * installed adapter-bound backend ID, with no default fallback.

members.name: reactiveAdapterFailed
members.description: A reactive adapter event, poll, or authoritative read failed. Callers should observe the query * error state and allow a later invalidation or poll to recover.

members.name: reactiveAdapterDisposeFailed
members.description: Reactive adapter, poller, query, or service cleanup collected failures. Callers must treat the * adapter as terminal and inspect AggregateError.errors.

members.name: backendDisposeFailed
members.description: Direct backend quiescence, transport, connection, or channel cleanup collected failures. * Callers must treat the backend as terminal and inspect all errors.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Table of this package’s 37 stable error codes; values are the strings on error.code. `INDEX_BACKFILL_FAILED` identifies backfill and failed-readiness persistence failing together on a native AggregateError.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import StorageErrorCode from @migaia/storage-web, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use StorageErrorCode when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when StorageErrorCode does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
unavailable: `BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE`: storage is disabled or missing (private mode); pick `memoryStorageHost` or ask for access.
quotaExceeded: `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`: the browser quota is full; delete data or use IndexedDB.
valueTooLarge: `VALUE_TOO_LARGE`: a cookie value is over 4 KB.
serializeFailed: `SERIALIZE_FAILED`: encoding the value failed.
deserializeFailed: `DESERIALIZE_FAILED`: decoding the stored value failed.
validationFailed: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: the schema rejected the value.
migrationFailed: `MIGRATION_FAILED`: a migration function threw.
transactionFailed: `TRANSACTION_FAILED`: the IndexedDB transaction failed or the callback threw.
duplicateKey: `DUPLICATE_KEY`: the key is used by another channel; pass `conflictPolicy: "replace"` to overwrite.
versionUnsupported: `VERSION_UNSUPPORTED`: stored data is newer than this code.
extensionFailed: `EXTENSION_FAILED`: a schema, codec or comparator threw.
transactionConflict: `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT`: data changed concurrently; re-read and retry.
writeFailed: `WRITE_FAILED`: a written cookie was not visible afterwards.
cookieScopeAmbiguous: `COOKIE_SCOPE_AMBIGUOUS`: one cookie name is visible in several scopes.
invalidConfig: `INVALID_CONFIG`: an option or scope is invalid.
indexOrphan: `INDEX_ORPHAN`: an index points to a missing record; rebuild it.
indexUniqueConflict: `INDEX_UNIQUE_CONFLICT`: a unique index key belongs to another record.
indexQueryInvalidated: `INDEX_QUERY_INVALIDATED`: data changed during paging; restart the query.
liveQueryDisposed: `LIVE_QUERY_DISPOSED`: the live query was disposed; create a new one.
indexBackfillStale: `INDEX_BACKFILL_STALE`: an index backfill checkpoint expired; reconnect and retry.
indexBackfillFailed: `INDEX_BACKFILL_FAILED`: backfill and persisting failed readiness both failed. The native AggregateError keeps the primary error first in errors and as cause, followed by the persistence failure; inspect both original objects before retrying.
backendIdInvalid: `BACKEND_ID_INVALID`: the backend id breaks the id rule.
backendDuplicate: `BACKEND_DUPLICATE`: the id is already installed.
backendNotInstalled: `BACKEND_NOT_INSTALLED`: no backend with this id; there is no default.
backendPluginInvalid: `BACKEND_PLUGIN_INVALID`: the plugin or its store breaks the contract.
backendInstallFailed: `BACKEND_INSTALL_FAILED`: installation failed and was rolled back; see `cause`.
storageHostBusy: `STORAGE_HOST_BUSY`: another installation is running; retry after it settles.
storageHostDisposed: `STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSED`: the host was disposed; create a new one.
storageHostDisposeFailed: `STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSE_FAILED`: cleanup failed; the host is still terminal.
liveQueryDisposeFailed: `LIVE_QUERY_DISPOSE_FAILED`: query cleanup failed; see `errors`.
reactiveFeatureInvalid: `REACTIVE_FEATURE_INVALID`: the reactive Feature does not match the backend.
reactiveTopologyInvalid: `REACTIVE_TOPOLOGY_INVALID`: the Feature graph is unknown, duplicated or cyclic.
reactiveServiceNotInstalled: `REACTIVE_SERVICE_NOT_INSTALLED`: install a reactive plugin before creating queries.
reactiveAdapterNotInstalled: `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_NOT_INSTALLED`: the backend id is not reactive.
reactiveAdapterFailed: `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_FAILED`: the adapter failed; later changes may recover.
reactiveAdapterDisposeFailed: `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_DISPOSE_FAILED`: adapter cleanup failed.
backendDisposeFailed: `BACKEND_DISPOSE_FAILED`: backend cleanup failed.

blocks.text: StorageError(code,details?,message?) 的 code 必填，details 可省略；source 固定 @migaia/storage-web，顶层 message 默认 `[storage-web] ${code}`，可用第三参数覆盖。details 可含 backend/key/existingChannel/attemptedChannel/extensionStage/operation/cause；cause 可以 undefined，存在时保留原始对象与其 message/stack，不承诺顶层 message 等于底层异常。实例浅冻结，不深冻结 cause。已有 StorageError 补充 operation/stage 元数据时，新边界保留原 message，并把完整旧错误放 cause。

STORAGE_WEB_SOURCE、StorageErrorCode、StorageErrorText 为稳定公开常量；业务分支比较 source/code，文本主要供扩展实现复用。storage-contract 的 INVALID_ARGUMENT/INVALID_KEY/UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY/STORE_DISPOSED/ABORTED 从其独立入口导入；跨 schema/codec/namespace 传播已有 storage 家族错误时保留原码与原因，不二次覆盖。

rows: 后端缺失/拒写、配额、完整 Cookie assignment 过大
编码/解码、结构化复制或 envelope 失败
事务/独占提交失败，或 revision/epoch/快照变化
持久化 schema 或 entity envelope 高于当前代码
扩展回调未归类失败，查看 extensionStage/cause
Cookie 回读不可见或同名 scope 歧义
投影无原记录、唯一键占用、分页失效
回填与失败状态都失败，或 owner/代次/检查点失效
ID 非法、重复或未安装
plugin/store 契约非法，或 batch 安装失败
Host 正忙、终态或清理失败
reactive 定义或依赖图非法
缺服务或所选 backend adapter
查询/失效失败或终态清理失败

blocks.text: 遇到不可用后端，显式提示或选择 memory；Cookie 写失败检查 scope/策略；冲突先区分跨通道重复、unique 占用与乐观竞争；未知版本升级代码，不删图跳迁移；structured 数据落 text-only 时显式换 codec 或后端；live query 跨页刷新按 consistency 判断，不把提示当全量复制。Host/Query/backend 关闭后新建，不尝试复活。

symbols.purpose: Stable message texts used by this package, for custom backends and codecs that want the same wording; branch on `code`, not on text.
symbols.core:
entityUniqueSnapshotChanged: The KV raw-text snapshot changed during preparation; `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT` asks the caller to retry the complete write.
entityMigrationGraphIncomplete: Entity construction omitted an upgrade step from 2 through the current version; correct the graph before retrying.
standardSchemaIssuesInvalid: A Standard Schema implementation returned malformed issue entries rather than message-bearing objects.
namespaceCodecEncodeInvalid: A namespace encoder returned a non-string physical key.
namespaceCodecDecodeInvalid: A namespace decoder returned neither a string key nor undefined for another namespace.
webStorageInjectionInvalid: Injected Web Storage lacks part of the required storage interface.
webStorageLengthInvalid: The live Web Storage length is not a nonnegative safe integer.
webStorageKeyInvalid: Live Web Storage enumeration did not provide a string key for a visible index.
webStorageKeyDuplicate: Live Web Storage enumeration returned the same physical key more than once.
indexedDbChangeHintKeyInvalid: An IndexedDB coordination hint contains an undecodable storage key.
indexedDbUpgradeTransactionMissing: An IndexedDB upgrade event omitted the platform-owned upgrade transaction.
cookieDocumentBecameInvalid: An admitted cookie document stopped exposing its cookie property as a string.
entityComparatorInvalid: An entity ordering callback returned an invalid comparison number.
storageKeyDecodeLimitExceeded: An encoded key exceeded the supported decode depth or node limits.
storageKeyWireInvalid: An encoded key is not the required two-slot wire tuple.
storageKeyBinaryTooLarge: A binary storage key exceeds the public encoded-key size bound.
storageKeyWireTagInvalid: An encoded storage key uses an unknown wire type tag.
backendIdInvalid: A backend identifier violates the registration name grammar before mutation.
backendDuplicate: A backend identifier is already installed or duplicated in the install batch.
backendNotInstalled: A valid backend identifier has no installed registry entry.
backendPluginInvalid: A backend plugin or returned store violates its public contract.
backendInstallFailed: Backend factory creation, preparation or PluginHost installation failed.
storageHostBusy: A host mutation was requested while another install batch was running.
storageHostDisposed: A host operation ran after the host sealed or reached terminal disposal.
storageHostDisposeFailed: Several host cleanup failures are summarized while disposal remains terminal.
liveQueryDisposeFailed: Several live-query cleanup failures are summarized after disposal.
reactiveFeatureInvalid: A reactive provider, feature or adapter descriptor has an invalid shape.
reactiveTopologyInvalid: Reactive feature topology has an unknown dependency, duplicate or cycle.
reactiveServiceNotInstalled: A live-query service was requested before installing its reactive plugin.
reactiveAdapterNotInstalled: The requested backend has no installed reactive adapter.
reactiveAdapterFailed: An adapter event, polling operation or authoritative read failed recoverably.
reactiveAdapterDisposeFailed: Reactive adapter or service cleanup produced aggregated failures.
liveQueryFailed: A live-query extension callback failed and its original cause is retained.
backendDisposeFailed: Direct backend cleanup failed and is reported through the storage boundary.
indexOrphan: An index sidecar row has no authoritative entity record.
indexQueryInvalidated: Concurrent mutation invalidated a native paged index query.
liveQueryDisposed: A permanently disposed live query was used again and must be recreated.
indexBackfillStale: The index backfill handle is stale and the query must retry.
indexBackfillProjectionTooLarge: Backfill projection work exceeded its fixed bound before sidecar writes.
indexBackfillDecodedTooLarge: Decoded backfill payload exceeded its fixed bound before issuing a partial batch.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Stable message texts used by this package, for custom backends and codecs that want the same wording; branch on `code`, not on text.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import StorageErrorText from @migaia/storage-web, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use StorageErrorText when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when StorageErrorText does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
entityUniqueSnapshotChanged: The KV raw-text snapshot changed during preparation; `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT` asks the caller to retry the complete write.
entityMigrationGraphIncomplete: Entity construction omitted an upgrade step from 2 through the current version; correct the graph before retrying.
standardSchemaIssuesInvalid: A Standard Schema implementation returned malformed issue entries rather than message-bearing objects.
namespaceCodecEncodeInvalid: A namespace encoder returned a non-string physical key.
namespaceCodecDecodeInvalid: A namespace decoder returned neither a string key nor undefined for another namespace.
webStorageInjectionInvalid: Injected Web Storage lacks part of the required storage interface.
webStorageLengthInvalid: The live Web Storage length is not a nonnegative safe integer.
webStorageKeyInvalid: Live Web Storage enumeration did not provide a string key for a visible index.
webStorageKeyDuplicate: Live Web Storage enumeration returned the same physical key more than once.
indexedDbChangeHintKeyInvalid: An IndexedDB coordination hint contains an undecodable storage key.
indexedDbUpgradeTransactionMissing: An IndexedDB upgrade event omitted the platform-owned upgrade transaction.
cookieDocumentBecameInvalid: An admitted cookie document stopped exposing its cookie property as a string.
entityComparatorInvalid: An entity ordering callback returned an invalid comparison number.
storageKeyDecodeLimitExceeded: An encoded key exceeded the supported decode depth or node limits.
storageKeyWireInvalid: An encoded key is not the required two-slot wire tuple.
storageKeyBinaryTooLarge: A binary storage key exceeds the public encoded-key size bound.
storageKeyWireTagInvalid: An encoded storage key uses an unknown wire type tag.
backendIdInvalid: A backend identifier violates the registration name grammar before mutation.
backendDuplicate: A backend identifier is already installed or duplicated in the install batch.
backendNotInstalled: A valid backend identifier has no installed registry entry.
backendPluginInvalid: A backend plugin or returned store violates its public contract.
backendInstallFailed: Backend factory creation, preparation or PluginHost installation failed.
storageHostBusy: A host mutation was requested while another install batch was running.
storageHostDisposed: A host operation ran after the host sealed or reached terminal disposal.
storageHostDisposeFailed: Several host cleanup failures are summarized while disposal remains terminal.
liveQueryDisposeFailed: Several live-query cleanup failures are summarized after disposal.
reactiveFeatureInvalid: A reactive provider, feature or adapter descriptor has an invalid shape.
reactiveTopologyInvalid: Reactive feature topology has an unknown dependency, duplicate or cycle.
reactiveServiceNotInstalled: A live-query service was requested before installing its reactive plugin.
reactiveAdapterNotInstalled: The requested backend has no installed reactive adapter.
reactiveAdapterFailed: An adapter event, polling operation or authoritative read failed recoverably.
reactiveAdapterDisposeFailed: Reactive adapter or service cleanup produced aggregated failures.
liveQueryFailed: A live-query extension callback failed and its original cause is retained.
backendDisposeFailed: Direct backend cleanup failed and is reported through the storage boundary.
indexOrphan: An index sidecar row has no authoritative entity record.
indexQueryInvalidated: Concurrent mutation invalidated a native paged index query.
liveQueryDisposed: A permanently disposed live query was used again and must be recreated.
indexBackfillStale: The index backfill handle is stale and the query must retry.
indexBackfillProjectionTooLarge: Backfill projection work exceeded its fixed bound before sidecar writes.
indexBackfillDecodedTooLarge: Decoded backfill payload exceeded its fixed bound before issuing a partial batch.

blocks.text: StorageError(code,details?,message?) 的 code 必填，details 可省略；source 固定 @migaia/storage-web，顶层 message 默认 `[storage-web] ${code}`，可用第三参数覆盖。details 可含 backend/key/existingChannel/attemptedChannel/extensionStage/operation/cause；cause 可以 undefined，存在时保留原始对象与其 message/stack，不承诺顶层 message 等于底层异常。实例浅冻结，不深冻结 cause。已有 StorageError 补充 operation/stage 元数据时，新边界保留原 message，并把完整旧错误放 cause。

STORAGE_WEB_SOURCE、StorageErrorCode、StorageErrorText 为稳定公开常量；业务分支比较 source/code，文本主要供扩展实现复用。storage-contract 的 INVALID_ARGUMENT/INVALID_KEY/UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY/STORE_DISPOSED/ABORTED 从其独立入口导入；跨 schema/codec/namespace 传播已有 storage 家族错误时保留原码与原因，不二次覆盖。

rows: 后端缺失/拒写、配额、完整 Cookie assignment 过大
编码/解码、结构化复制或 envelope 失败
事务/独占提交失败，或 revision/epoch/快照变化
持久化 schema 或 entity envelope 高于当前代码
扩展回调未归类失败，查看 extensionStage/cause
Cookie 回读不可见或同名 scope 歧义
投影无原记录、唯一键占用、分页失效
回填与失败状态都失败，或 owner/代次/检查点失效
ID 非法、重复或未安装
plugin/store 契约非法，或 batch 安装失败
Host 正忙、终态或清理失败
reactive 定义或依赖图非法
缺服务或所选 backend adapter
查询/失效失败或终态清理失败

blocks.text: 遇到不可用后端，显式提示或选择 memory；Cookie 写失败检查 scope/策略；冲突先区分跨通道重复、unique 占用与乐观竞争；未知版本升级代码，不删图跳迁移；structured 数据落 text-only 时显式换 codec 或后端；live query 跨页刷新按 consistency 判断，不把提示当全量复制。Host/Query/backend 关闭后新建，不尝试复活。

symbols.name: cookiesHost
symbols.purpose: Creates a cookie store with a fixed scope. `set(key, value, { maxAge | expires })` writes a cookie; values over 4096 bytes throw `VALUE_TOO_LARGE`; several visible scopes of one name throw `COOKIE_SCOPE_AMBIGUOUS`.
symbols.core:
A cookie store with `sync`; HttpOnly cookies are invisible, so `has()` false does not prove absence.
namespace: Prefix that isolates this store; `keys()` and `clearValues()` only see this namespace.
`default`.
namespaceCodec: How namespace and key become one physical key; changing it changes the stored format.
`lengthPrefixedNamespaceCodec` (`sw1:3:app:theme`).
scope: Fixed cookie scope `{ path, domain, sameSite, secure, partitioned }` used for every write and delete; `sameSite: "none"` and `partitioned` require `secure: true`.
`{ path: "/" }`.
document: Object with a `cookie` string, for tests.
`globalThis.document`; missing throws `BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE`.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.

symbols.name: defineEntity
symbols.purpose: Defines a typed record kind: primary key, schema, codec, version with migrations, read validation and secondary indexes. Use the curried form `defineEntity<T>()({...})` when declaring `indexes`. `connect(store)` binds it to a store.
symbols.core:
An `IEntityDefinition`; every target step from 2 through version must be declared. A version above 1 with omitted migrations is also incomplete and throws `INVALID_CONFIG`.
name: Entity name; non-empty and not starting with `__`.
key: Property of the domain object used as primary key.
schema: Validation and stored-shape conversion.
`passthrough()`: no validation.
codec: How records are encoded on the backend.
`structuredCodec` on IndexedDB / memory, `jsonCodec` on text backends.
version: Current data version, a positive safe integer.
`1`.
migrations: Functions for every version from 2 to `version`; a missing step throws `INVALID_CONFIG`.
Not set: only valid with `version: 1`.
migrations.<targetVersion>: Async `(previous, context) => upgradedValue` step keyed by the target version. `previous` is the prior stored representation; migration precedes `schema.decode`. The context supplies `fromVersion`, `toVersion`, and optional `signal` (undefined when the operation has none). The returned value proceeds to the next step, decoding, and read validation. Ordinary step failures become `MIGRATION_FAILED` with the original cause; `StorageContractError` and `StorageError` with `INVALID_CONFIG` retain their classification.
validateOnRead: Validate records when reading them.
`true`.
onDiagnostic: Receives diagnostic messages (full scans, fallbacks).
`console.warn`.
Set a callback when scans, skipped invalid records or backend fallback choices should appear in application diagnostics. It receives explanatory text without changing query results. Omitting it sends diagnostics to console.warn.
defaultOrderBy: Default sort of `list` / `stream`.
Not set: key order.
indexes: Secondary indexes `{ name: { path | paths | select, unique?, multiEntry?, revision? } }`.
Not set: no indexes.
indexes.<name>.path: Single object path, such as `email`, whose value becomes the index key. Use exactly one of `path`, compound `paths`, or custom `select`; index names must be nonempty and must not begin with `__`.
indexes.<name>.unique: Whether one projected key may belong to only one record; replacement by its existing owner is allowed.
`false`.
Reject another owner with `INDEX_UNIQUE_CONFLICT`.
Allow several records to share the projected key.
indexes.<name>.multiEntry: For `path`, expand an array into separate index keys when true; false keeps one key. Compound paths permit only false, and custom selectors must omit this field.
`false` for path projections.
Project array elements separately.
Keep a single key.
indexes.<name>.revision: Positive safe-integer projection revision; custom selectors require an explicit revision.
`1` for path or compound projections.

declaredConfiguration.description: Secondary projections are entity-owned and backend-neutral.

declaredConfiguration.name: name
declaredConfiguration.description: Nonempty entity namespace; names beginning with the reserved __ prefix are rejected.

declaredConfiguration.name: key
declaredConfiguration.description: Names the domain object property used as its primary key.

declaredConfiguration.name: schema
declaredConfiguration.description: Defaults to `passthrough`, which returns values without validation.

declaredConfiguration.name: codec
declaredConfiguration.description: Applies on every backend through `selectCodec` using `store.capabilities`. Structured backends do not bypass an explicitly configured codec. When omitted, IndexedDB and memory default to `structuredCodec`, preserving objects through native structured cloning. Key-value-only backends default to `jsonCodec`.

declaredConfiguration.name: version
declaredConfiguration.description: Positive safe-integer envelope version; defaults to 1.

declaredConfiguration.name: migrations
declaredConfiguration.description: Complete own step table from version 2 through the configured version; omitted only for version 1.

declaredConfiguration.name: validateOnRead
declaredConfiguration.description: Defaults to `true` because persisted data survives version changes, making invalid reads more common than invalid writes.

declaredConfiguration.name: onDiagnostic
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional scan/fallback diagnostic receiver; omission uses the host console warning path.

declaredConfiguration.name: defaultOrderBy
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional default domain comparator; omission orders by the canonical primary key.

symbols.core:
path: Caller-selected `IObjectPathInput<TDomain>` identifying one domain value used as the index key or multi-entry source.
paths: Nonempty caller-selected path list; each record projects a compound tuple key in this exact order, with multi-entry disabled.
unique: Whether each projected logical key may belong to only one record. Native and fallback paths use the same owner rule: a different owner rejects with `INDEX_UNIQUE_CONFLICT`, while replacement by the same id, reuse after deletion, compound keys and multi-entry keys follow the same rule.
`false`: several records may share one logical index key.
Enforce uniqueness across different records for every projected key.
Permit different records to share a projected key.
multiEntry: Single-path option expanding an array projection into several keys. Compound paths permit only false; custom selectors must express multiplicity in their result and reject this field.
`false` for path projections; absent for custom selectors.
Expand a single path’s array elements into separate index entries.
Keep one projected key, including a compound tuple.
revision: Positive safe integer chosen by the caller for projection identity and backfill fingerprinting; custom selectors require it explicitly.
`1` for path and compound projections; no omission is allowed for custom selectors.
select: Synchronous caller-owned `(value) => projection` receiving the domain record. Return a single key, multiple keys or undefined to omit indexing. Ordinary throws in fallback write validation cross the existing `EXTENSION_FAILED` boundary with operation `entity.index.project` and the original cause; native backfill preserves original error identity.
select.value: Domain record supplied by the entity repository during index projection.
`{ kind: "single", key }`, `{ kind: "multiple", keys }` or undefined; every returned key must satisfy `IStorageKey`.

symbols.name: IRepository
symbols.purpose: Typed access to one entity on one store. Fallback unique validation adds full-scan schema and projection reads without a persistent sidecar or a native capability claim. Record put, batch and migration validate the final draft and update the internal two-slot key `[REPOSITORY_KEY_PREFIX, entityName]` (`REPOSITORY_KEY_PREFIX` is `"__storage_web_entity_v2__"`) to detect concurrent new owners; raw record enumeration can see this marker, while entity queries and migration exclude it. KV preparation runs schema and codec callbacks outside the lock, then verifies the raw-text snapshot under an exclusive commit lock; changes during preparation yield retryable `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT`. Host Web Locks guarantee cross-page uniqueness and are provided by modern browsers. Injected ports without a host lock serialize within one module instance. Server-rewritten cookies follow the server and are outside this uniqueness constraint.

get: Reads one record by primary key, migrating and validating it.
get.id: Primary key value (the `key` property of the record).

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Typed access to one entity on one store. Fallback unique validation adds full-scan schema and projection reads without a persistent sidecar or a native capability claim. Record put, batch and migration validate the final draft and update the internal two-slot key `[REPOSITORY_KEY_PREFIX, entityName]` (`REPOSITORY_KEY_PREFIX` is `"__storage_web_entity_v2__"`) to detect concurrent new owners; raw record enumeration can see this marker, while entity queries and migration exclude it. KV preparation runs schema and codec callbacks outside the lock, then verifies the raw-text snapshot under an exclusive commit lock; changes during preparation yield retryable `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT`. Host Web Locks guarantee cross-page uniqueness and are provided by modern browsers. Injected ports without a host lock serialize within one module instance. Server-rewritten cookies follow the server and are outside this uniqueness constraint.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
state: Read-only reactive value `{ status, value?, error? }`; read it in an effect to follow changes.
consistency: What the adapter promises: `mode`, `visibility`, `pollIntervalMs`.
ready: Resolves after the first run settled (success or error).
refresh: Starts a new run; an older late result never overwrites it.
Resolves when the run settled.
dispose: Stops refreshes, cancels the current run and releases the subscription; repeated calls share one Promise.
Resolves when released.

sections.content: Show a list that updates when another tab writes to IndexedDB.

symbols.name: ILiveQueryState
symbols.purpose: Live-query state projected from the authoritative resource result, retaining a previous value during refresh, failure or disposal when available.
symbols.core:
status: Query discriminant selecting initial load, usable value, refresh, failure or disposed state.
The initial query is pending; a previous value is optional.
A successful result is available and no refresh is in progress.
Keep the last successful value while a new query is running.
The query failed; inspect the error and any retained prior value.
The query has stopped permanently, with its final optional value or error.
value: Last usable result, required for ready and refreshing, and optional for loading, error and disposed states.
error: Original query failure required in the error branch and optionally retained after disposal.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this type.

symbols.name: IStorageHostCreateOptions
symbols.purpose: Options of `createStorageHost()`.
symbols.core:
plugins: Initial plugins installed atomically; ids must be unique.
`[]`: an empty host.
installTimeoutMs: Deadline of one whole installation batch.
`30000`.
scheduler: Clock for installation, rollback and cleanup.
`systemScheduler`.
report: Receives late rejections and cleanup diagnostics.
Not set: diagnostics are dropped.
Supply a reporter when a timed-out initializer or delayed cleanup can fail after its caller has finished. The callback observes those secondary failures. Omission drops these diagnostics; throwing from it does not replace the installation or disposal result.

symbols.name: StorageHostFacade
symbols.purpose: The host class used by `createStorageHost`; constructing it directly gives an empty host to fill with `await host.use(plugin)`.
symbols.core:
A new empty StorageHostFacade with snapped scheduler and installation budget; no backend is installed by construction. Install backend plugins through use() and await dispose() at the end of its lifetime.
extensions: APIs added by installed plugins (custom `definePlugin` installs).
use: Installs more plugins after creation; the whole batch is published atomically or rolled back. A second `use()` during installation throws `STORAGE_HOST_BUSY`.
use.plugins: Plugin handles with new, unique ids.
The same host, typed with the new backends.
backend: Returns the store installed under an id.
backend.id: Id given to the plugin (`memoryBackendPlugin({ id })`).
The store; unknown ids throw `BACKEND_NOT_INSTALLED`.
hasBackend: Tells whether an id is installed (also narrows its type).
hasBackend.id: Backend id to check.
`true` when installed.
backends: Returns a copied map of all installed stores by id; its ReadonlyMap type prevents typed mutation, but the map is not frozen at runtime.
A fresh `ReadonlyMap<string, IKeyValueStore>`; mutating the copy never changes host registrations.
hasReactiveBackend: Tells whether an id has a reactive adapter.
hasReactiveBackend.id: Backend id to check.
`true` when reactive.
reactiveBackend: Returns the reactive handle of an id: `{ id, store, liveQuery }`.
reactiveBackend.id: Id of a backend installed with a `*Reactive` plugin.
An `IReactiveBackendHandle`, or `undefined` when the id has no installed reactive adapter.
dispose: Stops admission, cancels an installation in progress, waits for running work, then releases adapters and stores. Repeated dispose calls share one Promise; other Host operations reject with `STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSED` after closing begins.
Resolves when released; cleanup errors are aggregated.
liveQuery: Only with reactive backends: creates a live query; see `ILiveQueryOptions`.
liveQuery.options: `{ backendId, runtime, query, ... }`.
An `ILiveQuery`.
installTimeoutMs: Deadline of one installation batch.
`30000`.
scheduler: Clock for installation and cleanup.
`systemScheduler`.
report: Receives late rejections and cleanup diagnostics.
Not set.
Supply a reporter when a timed-out initializer or delayed cleanup can fail after its caller has finished. The callback observes those secondary failures. Omission drops these diagnostics; throwing from it does not replace the installation or disposal result.

sections.content: Creates an IndexedDB store with values, bytes, records, transactions, iteration and secondary indexes. The connection opens once and yields to version upgrades from other tabs. `ensureRecordIndexes` races shared opening against the operation deadline through `raceWithAbort`; stopping one waiter leaves shared preparation owned by the backend. `iterateRecordIndex` uses one deadline across the whole iterator, including buffered yields, and releases its abort subscription and timer in finally when iteration completes or the consumer calls return.

Events plus polling.

JS-visible writes of the origin (no HttpOnly), eventually.
Writes from any context of the origin, eventually.
subscribe: Starts listening and calls `context.invalidate(change)` for known changes, or `context.invalidate()` to refresh every query on this adapter when no payload is available.

symbols.name: createStoreDevTools
symbols.purpose: Subscribes to an existing reactive store to collect bounded state history, completed actions and optional runtime trace. Replay hydrates local state and never reverses business side effects; dispose the session after inspection.
symbols.core:
store: Live IReactiveStore returned by @migaia/store-light createStore(); the caller keeps ownership and must dispose the diagnostic session before releasing it.
Caller-owned IStoreDevTools. Construction snapshots options and initial state; invalid options throw Error/INVALID_OPTION, while unclassified initial clock or clone failures carry CALLBACK_FAILED. Existing foreign identities remain unchanged.
maxHistory: Safe integer at least one limiting retained state-history entries; old entries are evicted chronologically.
`100` history entries; it does not bound the action queue.
maxTrace: Safe integer at least one bounding both runtime trace and action queues independently.
`1000` entries per queue for actions and runtime trace.
captureRuntimeTrace: False skips runtime subscription and automatic completed-action capture; manual recordAction remains available.
`true`: capture runtime-wide events and completed action outcomes.
Subscribe to the Store Runtime, including other Stores using it.
Skip Runtime trace and automatic actions; manual recordAction remains enabled.
Keep the default true to inspect events and completed actions across the shared runtime. Choose false for selected manual actions or to avoid that subscription. Store history and recordAction() remain available.
now: Synchronous no-argument clock returning application milliseconds. Preparation classifies unowned failures as CALLBACK_FAILED; manual capture throws and automatic capture reports through the runtime.
Date.now supplies ordinary wall-clock timestamps.
Supply your clock when timestamps must match another log or remain fixed across repeated captures. Snapshots and action records call it. Without it, timestamps use Date.now().
clone: Synchronous (state) callback receives store.$plain() or a retained replay snapshot and returns a diagnostic copy. Snapshot and replay cloning classify unowned failures as CALLBACK_FAILED; automatic capture reports them, while manual record and replay throw. Store hydration errors retain their own path. Apply redaction here.
ClonePolicy.diagnostic from @migaia/store-middleware/tolerant-clone clones best-effort. structuredClone may convert class instances to ordinary objects; reference sharing and prototype preservation are not guaranteed.
Set it to redact snapshots or choose how special values are copied. Return a record synchronously; keep required fields if replay is needed. Without it, diagnostic cloning copies values best-effort without redaction.
parameters: store: IReactiveStore<S>
options: IStoreDevToolsOptions (optional)
symbols.returns: IStoreDevTools

symbols.name: IStoreDevTools
symbols.purpose: Caller-owned local diagnostic session subscribed to an existing reactive store, with bounded history and runtime traces.
symbols.core:
history: Frozen chronological array snapshot of retained IStoreHistoryEntry entries, bounded by maxHistory. Entry state is shallow-frozen after cloning.
actions: Frozen chronological array of manual and completed runtime action traces, bounded by maxTrace rather than maxHistory.
trace: Frozen chronological array of original runtime events, bounded by maxTrace; empty when runtime capture is disabled.
record: Prepares the clock and cloned store snapshot, checks that the session is still active, then publishes one history entry. Callback failure or disposal during preparation leaves queues and the next history ID unchanged.
record.label: Optional application label; omitted defaults to state change. Initial construction and clear use initial.
Frozen IStoreHistoryEntry with a new monotonic ID. Unclassified clock or clone failures become CALLBACK_FAILED; writable native errors retain identity, foreign identities remain unchanged, and immutable errors or primitive values remain on cause.
recordAction: Prepares an application action record and session timestamp, then checks session activity before publishing. Disposal from a getter or clock prevents publication; payload and errors retain their supplied identity.
recordAction.trace: Application-created action name, optional payload, durationMs and error; omit timestamp because the session supplies it.
No return value; the operation is complete. After disposal it throws SESSION_DISPOSED.
jumpTo: Clones a retained history state into store.$hydrate(), suppressing replay-generated history; business side effects are not undone.
jumpTo.id: ID returned by tools.record() or read from tools.history; an entry trimmed by maxHistory is no longer available.
No return value; unknown IDs throw RangeError/UNKNOWN_HISTORY_ENTRY. Unclassified replay clone failures receive CALLBACK_FAILED, while complete foreign identities stay unchanged; frozen errors and primitive values remain on cause. Store hydration failures propagate from Store without this catch; replay suppression is restored in either case.
clear: Prepares one current initial snapshot and rechecks session activity before clearing all three queues. A preparation failure or disposal leaves queues and history ID unchanged; success retains only the new entry without resetting IDs.
dispose: Idempotently closes the session and cancels store and runtime subscriptions; it neither disposes the store nor clears diagnostic queues.
No value. One cleanup failure propagates unchanged; several produce CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError. The session remains terminal even after cleanup failure.

No return value; the operation is complete. After disposal it throws SESSION_DISPOSED.

guidance.heading: Cell 生命周期、清理与 guard

blocks.text: 新 cell 在最后一个订阅者离开时尝试回收；从未成功接上观察者的临时 cell 通过所属 Runtime 的 idle 通道清理，默认微任务。删除成员时仍有观察者的 cell 保留并发布缺失值，直到退订。Object/Map/Set 的 prune 只整理已删除且无观察者的 key/member，不释放活观察者；Array 仅走自动路径。
集合不会感知组件卸载或请求结束，应用必须调用 dispose。dispose 通过集合 owner 同时释放仍拥有的 Signal 与 pool 引用，重复是空操作；随后数据读写及 prune 拒绝，但仍可读 runtime/disposed。借入 Runtime 不由集合销毁。它不承诺清空 backing data、清除已有快照或销毁应用对象。

guard 是同步写入许可检查，签名 `assertMutationAllowed(operation?:string):void`，每个公开写入入口调用一次，包括最终没有变化的写入；读方法不调用。操作名如 `users.set(u1)`，来自 debugName 与具体方法，不是 IndexedOperation 值。Object.update 的 guard 先于 updater；拒绝时 updater 不执行。可组合 store-middleware 的 MutationPolicy 与 runInAction，策略及 action 范围由那个包负责；使用它应另行安装该包。本包只保证外层提交没有发生，不回滚回调自己的外部副作用。
`IndexedOperation` 为消费方诊断/日志提供 `read:'read'`、`write:'write'`、`delete:'delete'`；`IIndexedOperation` 是这些值的联合。本包方法不直接引用该词表。

symbols.core:
initial: Initial iterable, default `[]` for an empty array; strings are accepted as characters.
runtime: `IRuntime` from `@migaia/reactive`; omitted uses `defaultRuntime`. Use its graph for observing this collection; collection disposal does not dispose the Runtime.
Caller-owned ObservableArray; dispose it after its observers are released. Invalid input throws a tagged TypeError with INVALID_OPTION.
runtime: IRuntime selected at construction; tracked reads belong to its graph and mutations use its batching.
disposed: Whether terminal disposal has disconnected collection-owned signals; ordinary reads and writes then reject.
dispose: Idempotently disconnects collection-owned signals and releases cell-pool references without disposing the caller Runtime. Backing data and existing snapshots are not cleared.
Nothing; the collection is terminal and later data access throws COLLECTION_DISPOSED.
length: Current array length, tracked through the structure signal rather than individual index cells.
at: Reads one integer index; negative indexes are relative to the current end and also observe structure.
at.index: Integer position, accepting negative positions from the end; nonintegers throw INVALID_INDEX.
Element or undefined outside bounds; owning Runtime tracking observes that index.
snapshot: Reads the revision and caches a shallow-frozen array until length or element values change.
Readonly shallow array snapshot; nested values retain identity.
peek: Makes a fresh shallow-frozen array copy without any dependency tracking.
Untracked readonly shallow copy, independent of snapshot caching.
set: Replaces an existing nonnegative index after guard admission; changed cell and revision commit in one Runtime batch, including synchronous schedulers. Object.is-equal values do not notify.
set.index: Integer within [0, length); nonintegers throw INVALID_INDEX and other positions INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE.
set.value: Application value to store; nested objects retain their original identity.
Nothing; the selected cell and revision update when the value changes.
push: Appends values in one batch; an empty argument list leaves revisions unchanged.
push.values: Application values to append in argument order.
New array length after the append operation.
pop: Removes the final element, marks any observed index absent and updates structure in one batch.
Removed final value, or undefined when already empty.
splice: Applies native splice positioning and integer coercion to a copied array, then commits changed indexes in one batch.
splice.start: Native splice start position; negative positions count from the end.
splice.deleteCount: Omitted removes through the end; explicitly undefined means zero removals.
splice.items: Application values inserted at the selected position.
Shallow-frozen array of removed elements; inserted values keep identity.
replace: Materializes the entire iterable before replacing data, then updates only materialized index cells in one batch. Equal-length inputs still require a full value comparison; this is not a constant-time replacement.
replace.values: Complete replacement iterable; strings are accepted as characters.
Nothing; values and changed length/revision are committed.
clear: Replaces the array with an empty array through the same guarded replacement path.
Nothing; the array is empty and affected observations are invalidated.
mutationGuard: Caller-owned IMutationGuard from @migaia/store-light; each mutation invokes assertMutationAllowed(operation) before changing data. Existing foreign source/code stays unchanged.
