symbols.name: IStoreMiddlewareBinding
symbols.purpose: Canonical frozen managed handle returned by bindStoreMiddleware, carrying all host capabilities plus the original light Store reference. Live revision/getters and fluent return identity preserve every Store member. Releasing this binding leaves the Store alive.
symbols.core:
identity: Immutable host identity `{ name, id }`: `name` from the `identity` option, `id` unique per host; used in errors and diagnostics.
plugin: Enable/disable controls: `plugin.disable(name)` hides a plugin (extensions, Features, stages) without releasing resources, `plugin.enable(name)` restores it in place, `plugin.disabled()` lists disabled names.
pipelineMode: Always sync: store event host construction overrides any supplied pipeline mode.
revision: Live revision getter from the same canonical managed host; plugin commits update it without replacing the Store domain or fluent handle identity.
config: Per-plugin configuration store. `config.get("plugin.key")` reads a frozen snapshot (unknown paths return `undefined`); `config.update(name, recipe)` merges a patch copy-on-write and commits only after the plugin `update` hook succeeds.
useSync: Installs synchronously and returns handles in input order. A declared setup immediately throws SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL. A thenable install result rejects as PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED with INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE on cause; its later rejection is reported through the diagnostic third argument, not inserted retroactively into the immediate cause chain.
useSync.plugins: Plugin definitions with synchronous install.
The handle tuple in input order.
Building a host that must be usable right after construction.
use: Installs one or more plugins as one batch, in Feature dependency order (argument order does not matter). Either every plugin is published or the batch is rolled back in reverse order.
use.plugins: Definitions from `definePlugin()` or plugin factories such as `level()`. Names must be unique and must not contain `.`.
A Promise of the handle tuple in input order. Install failures reject with `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` (original error on `cause`, `detail.failedName`); missing providers throw `PREREQUISITE_*` directly.
Plugins with async `setup` or `install`, or plugins added at runtime.
unUse: Removes a plugin: runs its `beforeRelease`, waits for running pipelines, withdraws extensions, Features and stages, then runs its disposers and releases resources in reverse order.
unUse.name: Name of the installed plugin.
unUse.options: `policy`: what happens to plugins that require it (`reject` default, `cascade`, `suspend`); `dryRun: true` returns the plan without changing anything.
{ ok: true, affected }, or { ok: false, errors, affected } after cleanup failure or PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup after a drain timeout, records/reports that failure and adds no physicalCompletion protocol. dryRun:true returns IPluginDependencyPlan.
activate: Installs a plugin that was registered with `activation: "lazy"`, first activating any lazy providers it requires. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a failure leaves it registered so it can be retried.
activate.name: Name of the lazy plugin.
The handle of the activated plugin; the original install error on failure.
Defer expensive plugins until the first request needs them.
replace: Hot-swaps a plugin: installs `next` first (the old one keeps serving if that fails), then rebinds dependents that implement `onDependencyReplaced` and restarts the others; the old generation is disposed after its running pipelines drain.
replace.name: Name of the installed plugin.
replace.next: New definition with the same name (otherwise `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`).
The handle of the new generation. Old extracted extension functions throw `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`; a failed dependent restart throws `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED` after the replacement took effect.
runPipeline: Runs `value` through host and plugin stages and calls `done` with the final value. Only the holder of a `defineHost()` handle can call it (subclasses use the protected method), so the domain decides when the pipeline runs.
runPipeline.value: Input value.
runPipeline.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops the value.
`void` in sync modes, a Promise in async modes; host disposal aborts the run with `HOST_DISPOSING`.
dispose: Stops host admission, runs binding disposers in reverse order, then delegates plugin lifecycle cleanup. Every disposer is attempted and binding errors precede plugin errors.
Shared Promise<IPluginHostDisposalResult> with logicalTerminal, cleanupComplete and cleanupErrors. Binding throws are reported in this result; unfinished physical cleanup remains reachable through physicalCompletion.
usePipeline: Adds a synchronous processing function to the host pipeline. Receive the current value and call next(newValue) to continue with a value for the next function. Omitting next() stops processing. The host adapts this synchronous function to its selected mode, so this registration method works in every host mode.
usePipeline.stage: Sync stage; call `next(value)` to continue, omit it to stop the value.
The host itself, so calls can be chained.
useAsyncPipeline: Registers a step that can await other work before or after the next event-processing step. This requires async mode. Store event hosts process events synchronously, so this call throws PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH, meaning the requested step does not match the host mode. Use usePipeline for synchronous steps.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (value, next) => { await next(value) }`; code after `await next()` runs after downstream.
The host itself.
useGeneratorPipeline: Registers a generator function that uses yield to supply a processed value. That form runs only in generator or async-generator mode. On a Store event host, registration throws PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH because its event pipeline accepts synchronous next-style steps only. To transform an event here, register usePipeline and pass the resulting event to next before the callback returns.
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: `function* (value)`; return a value or a `GENERATOR_*` signal.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Registers a function that combines awaited work with values supplied through yield. Only async-generator mode can execute that combination. Store event hosts cannot await yielded results, so this registration fails with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH, the error for an incompatible step mode. Complete asynchronous preparation before emitting the store event, then use usePipeline for the remaining synchronous handling.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: `async function* (value)`; drained completely before the next stage.
mutationPolicy: Exact caller policy object or a newly created off policy; share the same policy with the Store when enforcing actions-only writes.
emit: Synchronously runs an event through the host pipeline. Missing continuation reports MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED; other pipeline failures may propagate from this public method.
emit.event: IMiddlewareEvent from host domain methods, Store trace binding or explicit caller construction using the event constants.
No result after synchronous delivery; this is the direct emission boundary rather than isolated business-action observation.
runAction: Emits isolated start, runs fn inside mutation policy and Runtime batch, then emits isolated end or error. Synchronous business failures retain native identity or remain reachable through cause/errors under the policy callback contract; observer failures are reported.
runAction.name: Application-selected action label propagated to all three action phases.
runAction.fn: Synchronous no-argument business callback; return T or throw. Promises are returned without awaiting, so async continuations and rejections are outside action scope.
runAction.metadata: Optional caller diagnostic record; defaults to absent and retains its reference.
Exact fn return or policy-classified synchronous failure; foreign Reactive/pipeline errors keep their package identity. Action duration covers synchronous execution only.
recordState: Emits an isolated state observation without changing Store state. Middleware failures are reported rather than reaching the business caller.
recordState.name: Application-selected state observation label.
recordState.previous: Previous snapshot owned by the caller or binding clone policy.
recordState.next: Next snapshot owned by the caller or binding clone policy.
recordState.metadata: Optional diagnostic record, absent by default and retained by reference.
No result after isolated observation; state application is a separate capability.
recordError: Emits one isolated diagnostic-error event. Reentrant calls while handling an error report directly to Runtime without starting another middleware pipeline.
recordError.phase: Caller diagnostic phase identifying the failed subsystem or operation.
recordError.error: Original diagnostic failure value retained by identity.
recordError.metadata: Optional caller metadata; defaults to absent and is not cloned.
No result; observation failures are routed to Runtime.
connectDevTools: Installs a plugin that initializes an adapter, sends events after recording sync continuation and before downstream execution and subscribes to normalized commands. Pair with createReduxDevToolsAdapter when using a Redux extension-shaped connection.
connectDevTools.adapter: IDevToolsAdapter from createReduxDevToolsAdapter or caller implementation; init/send are required and subscribe is optional.
connectDevTools.name: Optional unique plugin name chosen by the application; defaults to store-devtools.
Promise<void> after plugin installation. Invalid adapter uses INVALID_OPTION; install failures retain plugin-host semantics; jump/reset without applyState uses DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY.
attachBindingDisposer: While open, registers synchronous cleanup in reverse order before delegated plugin-host disposal. Once closing starts, registration invokes the disposer immediately; a synchronous failure propagates with CALLBACK_FAILED identity or preserves its foreign owner.
attachBindingDisposer.disposer: Caller-owned IDisposer accepting no arguments and returning nothing; throws are collected into structured disposal cleanupErrors.
No result; an open host retains cleanup until disposal, while a closing host finishes it before this call returns.
store: Exact IReactiveStore originally supplied to bindStoreMiddleware; lifecycle ownership remains with the caller.

blocks.text: Host 的 use/unUse/dispose、插件失败回滚、配置与资源逆序清理归 plugin-host。同一 Host 插件名唯一。dispose 首先关闭 binding disposer 登记，再同步按后进先出调用，尝试全部清理，之后卸载插件；不等待 disposer 返回的 Promise，应登记同步函数。重入登记立即执行；晚登记失败按 callback 身份规则同步传播。

重复 dispose 返回同一 Promise，结果为 `{logicalTerminal,cleanupComplete,cleanupErrors}`，可保留 plugin-host 的其它物理清理信息。绑定 disposer 失败排在 cleanupErrors 前面，然后是插件清理失败；这些被收集而不以清理异常拒绝 Promise。cleanupComplete 沿用插件清理完成状态，表示物理完成，不表示 cleanupErrors 必为空。关闭不会销毁借入 Store/Runtime；Store 可继续工作，只是不再被这一绑定观察。领域闭包没有统一的 open 守卫，保留的 runAction 仍可执行 fn；关闭插件接纳不等于取消任意业务回调。

rows: Host options 或 DevTools adapter 形状/读取失败
stage 遗漏 next，向 Runtime 报告
immutable 数据不受支持或克隆失败
没有已有身份的同步 action、初始 binding clone 或 binding disposer 失败
支持的 Redux 状态命令 JSON 无效，报告并跳过
绑定设置失败且同步回滚也失败

blocks.text: `IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode` 是码值联合，`STORE_MIDDLEWARE_SOURCE='@migaia/store-middleware'` 只标识本包创建的错误；Reactive、pipeline 及其它已有 source/code 保持实际 owner。能附码的原生错误保留原实例、类型、message、stack，不可附码或非 Error 值经 cause/errors 保留。不要把记录状态、业务失败与诊断失败混成一个控制流。

`createStoreMiddlewareError(code,message,options?)` 返回原生 Error；code:IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode、message:string 均必填，options 默认 undefined，唯一字段可选 cause；显式自有 cause（包括 undefined）转发原生 Error。`createStoreMiddlewareAggregateError(code,errors:readonly unknown[],message)` 返回原生 AggregateError，三参必填，errors 保留原对象。两者只构造、不自动 throw，附不可写 source/code、不改 stack。

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: The object returned by createStoreMiddlewareHost for sending store events and managing their plugins. It combines store event methods with [Plugin Host’s IHostHandle](/en/docs/plugin-host/api/IHostHandle) methods for installing and removing plugins, changing configuration, and closing the host. The returned object is frozen, so you cannot add or replace its properties. Its event pipeline, the sequence of steps that handles each event, always runs synchronously.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
identity: Immutable host identity `{ name, id }`: `name` from the `identity` option, `id` unique per host; used in errors and diagnostics.
plugin: Enable/disable controls: `plugin.disable(name)` hides a plugin (extensions, Features, stages) without releasing resources, `plugin.enable(name)` restores it in place, `plugin.disabled()` lists disabled names.
pipelineMode: Always sync: store event host construction overrides any supplied pipeline mode.
revision: Live revision getter from the same canonical managed host; plugin commits update it without replacing the Store domain or fluent handle identity.
config: Per-plugin configuration store. `config.get("plugin.key")` reads a frozen snapshot (unknown paths return `undefined`); `config.update(name, recipe)` merges a patch copy-on-write and commits only after the plugin `update` hook succeeds.
useSync: Installs synchronously and returns handles in input order. A declared setup immediately throws SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL. A thenable install result rejects as PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED with INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE on cause; its later rejection is reported through the diagnostic third argument, not inserted retroactively into the immediate cause chain.
useSync.plugins: Plugin definitions with synchronous install.
The handle tuple in input order.
Building a host that must be usable right after construction.
use: Installs one or more plugins as one batch, in Feature dependency order (argument order does not matter). Either every plugin is published or the batch is rolled back in reverse order.
use.plugins: Definitions from `definePlugin()` or plugin factories such as `level()`. Names must be unique and must not contain `.`.
A Promise of the handle tuple in input order. Install failures reject with `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` (original error on `cause`, `detail.failedName`); missing providers throw `PREREQUISITE_*` directly.
Plugins with async `setup` or `install`, or plugins added at runtime.
unUse: Removes a plugin: runs its `beforeRelease`, waits for running pipelines, withdraws extensions, Features and stages, then runs its disposers and releases resources in reverse order.
unUse.name: Name of the installed plugin.
unUse.options: `policy`: what happens to plugins that require it (`reject` default, `cascade`, `suspend`); `dryRun: true` returns the plan without changing anything.
{ ok: true, affected }, or { ok: false, errors, affected } after cleanup failure or PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup after a drain timeout, records/reports that failure and adds no physicalCompletion protocol. dryRun:true returns IPluginDependencyPlan.
activate: Installs a plugin that was registered with `activation: "lazy"`, first activating any lazy providers it requires. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a failure leaves it registered so it can be retried.
activate.name: Name of the lazy plugin.
The handle of the activated plugin; the original install error on failure.
Defer expensive plugins until the first request needs them.
replace: Hot-swaps a plugin: installs `next` first (the old one keeps serving if that fails), then rebinds dependents that implement `onDependencyReplaced` and restarts the others; the old generation is disposed after its running pipelines drain.
replace.name: Name of the installed plugin.
replace.next: New definition with the same name (otherwise `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`).
The handle of the new generation. Old extracted extension functions throw `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`; a failed dependent restart throws `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED` after the replacement took effect.
runPipeline: Runs `value` through host and plugin stages and calls `done` with the final value. Only the holder of a `defineHost()` handle can call it (subclasses use the protected method), so the domain decides when the pipeline runs.
runPipeline.value: Input value.
runPipeline.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops the value.
`void` in sync modes, a Promise in async modes; host disposal aborts the run with `HOST_DISPOSING`.
dispose: Stops host admission, runs binding disposers in reverse order, then delegates plugin lifecycle cleanup. Every disposer is attempted and binding errors precede plugin errors.
Shared Promise<IPluginHostDisposalResult> with logicalTerminal, cleanupComplete and cleanupErrors. Binding throws are reported in this result; unfinished physical cleanup remains reachable through physicalCompletion.
usePipeline: Adds a synchronous processing function to the host pipeline. Receive the current value and call next(newValue) to continue with a value for the next function. Omitting next() stops processing. The host adapts this synchronous function to its selected mode, so this registration method works in every host mode.
usePipeline.stage: Sync stage; call `next(value)` to continue, omit it to stop the value.
The host itself, so calls can be chained.
useAsyncPipeline: Registers a step that can await other work before or after the next event-processing step. This requires async mode. Store event hosts process events synchronously, so this call throws PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH, meaning the requested step does not match the host mode. Use usePipeline for synchronous steps.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (value, next) => { await next(value) }`; code after `await next()` runs after downstream.
The host itself.
useGeneratorPipeline: Registers a generator function that uses yield to supply a processed value. That form runs only in generator or async-generator mode. On a Store event host, registration throws PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH because its event pipeline accepts synchronous next-style steps only. To transform an event here, register usePipeline and pass the resulting event to next before the callback returns.
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: `function* (value)`; return a value or a `GENERATOR_*` signal.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Registers a function that combines awaited work with values supplied through yield. Only async-generator mode can execute that combination. Store event hosts cannot await yielded results, so this registration fails with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH, the error for an incompatible step mode. Complete asynchronous preparation before emitting the store event, then use usePipeline for the remaining synchronous handling.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: `async function* (value)`; drained completely before the next stage.
mutationPolicy: Exact caller policy object or a newly created off policy; share the same policy with the Store when enforcing actions-only writes.
emit: Synchronously runs an event through the host pipeline. Missing continuation reports MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED; other pipeline failures may propagate from this public method.
emit.event: IMiddlewareEvent from host domain methods, Store trace binding or explicit caller construction using the event constants.
No result after synchronous delivery; this is the direct emission boundary rather than isolated business-action observation.
runAction: Emits isolated start, runs fn inside mutation policy and Runtime batch, then emits isolated end or error. Synchronous business failures retain native identity or remain reachable through cause/errors under the policy callback contract; observer failures are reported.
runAction.name: Application-selected action label propagated to all three action phases.
runAction.fn: Synchronous no-argument business callback; return T or throw. Promises are returned without awaiting, so async continuations and rejections are outside action scope.
runAction.metadata: Optional caller diagnostic record; defaults to absent and retains its reference.
Exact fn return or policy-classified synchronous failure; foreign Reactive/pipeline errors keep their package identity. Action duration covers synchronous execution only.
recordState: Emits an isolated state observation without changing Store state. Middleware failures are reported rather than reaching the business caller.
recordState.name: Application-selected state observation label.
recordState.previous: Previous snapshot owned by the caller or binding clone policy.
recordState.next: Next snapshot owned by the caller or binding clone policy.
recordState.metadata: Optional diagnostic record, absent by default and retained by reference.
No result after isolated observation; state application is a separate capability.
recordError: Emits one isolated diagnostic-error event. Reentrant calls while handling an error report directly to Runtime without starting another middleware pipeline.
recordError.phase: Caller diagnostic phase identifying the failed subsystem or operation.
recordError.error: Original diagnostic failure value retained by identity.
recordError.metadata: Optional caller metadata; defaults to absent and is not cloned.
No result; observation failures are routed to Runtime.
connectDevTools: Installs a plugin that initializes an adapter, sends events after recording sync continuation and before downstream execution and subscribes to normalized commands. Pair with createReduxDevToolsAdapter when using a Redux extension-shaped connection.
connectDevTools.adapter: IDevToolsAdapter from createReduxDevToolsAdapter or caller implementation; init/send are required and subscribe is optional.
connectDevTools.name: Optional unique plugin name chosen by the application; defaults to store-devtools.
Promise<void> after plugin installation. Invalid adapter uses INVALID_OPTION; install failures retain plugin-host semantics; jump/reset without applyState uses DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY.
attachBindingDisposer: While open, registers synchronous cleanup in reverse order before delegated plugin-host disposal. Once closing starts, registration invokes the disposer immediately; a synchronous failure propagates with CALLBACK_FAILED identity or preserves its foreign owner.
attachBindingDisposer.disposer: Caller-owned IDisposer accepting no arguments and returning nothing; throws are collected into structured disposal cleanupErrors.
No result; an open host retains cleanup until disposal, while a closing host finishes it before this call returns.

identity.name: Readable host name used in errors and diagnostics.
Omission uses DEFAULT as the name. The generated id combines that name with a sequence number, allowing diagnostics to distinguish host instances.
execution.mutationTimeoutMs: Required nonnegative finite milliseconds or false, with no default. Bounds setup/install/update; expiry aborts the operation and rolls back with MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT. false removes this deadline; removal hooks and disposers use disposeStepTimeoutMs.
execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: Required nonnegative finite milliseconds or false; no default. Bounds pipeline draining during removal, replacement and host disposal; false waits until no leases remain.
execution: Required execution budgets: mutationTimeoutMs bounds setup/install/update; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs bounds pipeline draining and is a shared managed-removal cleanup deadline. Ordinary removal steps use disposeStepTimeoutMs. false disables the corresponding deadline.
pipeline: External pipeline options are captured once, including a non-enumerable pipeline getter, and excluded from the remaining option spread; mode is overwritten with sync before host construction.

diagnostic: Receives notable events that are not errors (`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`, `EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`, rollback failures, queue waits) as `(message, code?, error?)`. Its own failures never affect the host.
Not set: diagnostics are dropped.
onDiagnosticFailure: Receives the error when `diagnostic` itself throws or rejects.
Not set: the failure goes to `globalThis.reportError` when it exists.

queueAdmissionTimeoutMs: How long a change may wait in the FIFO queue. A number rejects waiting work with `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` (running work is not interrupted); `false` disables queue timers and diagnostics.

disposeStepTimeoutMs: Maximum wait for one cleanup step (a stage disposer, a plugin `dispose`, a resource). A timed-out step is recorded as `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT` and cleanup continues; `false` waits forever.

symbols.name: loggerMiddleware
symbols.purpose: Creates a logging plugin named store-logger. Install it on a host from createStoreMiddlewareHost with host.use; creating the plugin alone prints nothing. For each event, the plugin first passes the event on with next(event), then gives the event and the current state to its sink. The sink still runs before the next plugin handles the event. The logger never relies on the shape of your state, so it installs into a host of any state type without a type argument.
symbols.core:
sink: Optional synchronous (event, state) callback; event is the delivered middleware event and state is core.getState() inside this stage before downstream executes. Defaults to console.log with the stable prefix; no return is used or awaited and throws follow pipeline handling.
IStoreMiddlewarePlugin named store-logger, affecting existing pipeline behavior without adding methods.
Installed using host.use, the fixed store-logger plugin logs each event after recording continuation and before downstream processing, without adding extension methods.
symbols.advanced:
The sink receives the delivered event and latest core state; its throw follows the caller emission isolation policy.
Observe state and action diagnostics through an existing synchronous log sink.
parameters: sink: (event: IMiddlewareEvent<unknown>, state: unknown) => void (optional)
symbols.returns: IStoreMiddlewarePlugin<S>
examples:
import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'
import { bindStoreMiddleware, loggerMiddleware } from '@migaia/store-middleware'

const events: string[] = []
const store = createStore({ count: 0 })
const execution = { mutationTimeoutMs: false, pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: false } as const
const host = bindStoreMiddleware(store, { execution })
await host.use(loggerMiddleware((event) => events.push(event.type)))
store.count = 1
store.$runtime.flush()
console.log(events.join(','))
await host.dispose()
store.count = 2
console.log(store.count)
await store.$dispose()

blocks.text: Host 的 use/unUse/dispose、插件失败回滚、配置与资源逆序清理归 plugin-host。同一 Host 插件名唯一。dispose 首先关闭 binding disposer 登记，再同步按后进先出调用，尝试全部清理，之后卸载插件；不等待 disposer 返回的 Promise，应登记同步函数。重入登记立即执行；晚登记失败按 callback 身份规则同步传播。

重复 dispose 返回同一 Promise，结果为 `{logicalTerminal,cleanupComplete,cleanupErrors}`，可保留 plugin-host 的其它物理清理信息。绑定 disposer 失败排在 cleanupErrors 前面，然后是插件清理失败；这些被收集而不以清理异常拒绝 Promise。cleanupComplete 沿用插件清理完成状态，表示物理完成，不表示 cleanupErrors 必为空。关闭不会销毁借入 Store/Runtime；Store 可继续工作，只是不再被这一绑定观察。领域闭包没有统一的 open 守卫，保留的 runAction 仍可执行 fn；关闭插件接纳不等于取消任意业务回调。

rows: Host options 或 DevTools adapter 形状/读取失败
stage 遗漏 next，向 Runtime 报告
immutable 数据不受支持或克隆失败
没有已有身份的同步 action、初始 binding clone 或 binding disposer 失败
支持的 Redux 状态命令 JSON 无效，报告并跳过
绑定设置失败且同步回滚也失败

blocks.text: `IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode` 是码值联合，`STORE_MIDDLEWARE_SOURCE='@migaia/store-middleware'` 只标识本包创建的错误；Reactive、pipeline 及其它已有 source/code 保持实际 owner。能附码的原生错误保留原实例、类型、message、stack，不可附码或非 Error 值经 cause/errors 保留。不要把记录状态、业务失败与诊断失败混成一个控制流。

`createStoreMiddlewareError(code,message,options?)` 返回原生 Error；code:IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode、message:string 均必填，options 默认 undefined，唯一字段可选 cause；显式自有 cause（包括 undefined）转发原生 Error。`createStoreMiddlewareAggregateError(code,errors:readonly unknown[],message)` 返回原生 AggregateError，三参必填，errors 保留原对象。两者只构造、不自动 throw，附不可写 source/code、不改 stack。

重复 dispose 返回同一 Promise，结果为 `{logicalTerminal,cleanupComplete,cleanupErrors}`，可保留 plugin-host 的其它物理清理信息。绑定 disposer 失败排在 cleanupErrors 前面，然后是插件清理失败；这些被收集而不以清理异常拒绝 Promise。cleanupComplete 沿用插件清理完成状态，表示物理完成，不表示 cleanupErrors 必为空。关闭不会销毁借入 Store/Runtime；Store 可继续工作，只是不再被这一绑定观察。领域闭包没有统一的 open 守卫，保留的 runAction 仍可执行 fn；关闭插件接纳不等于取消任意业务回调。

`createStoreMiddlewareError(code,message,options?)` 返回原生 Error；code:IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode、message:string 均必填，options 默认 undefined，唯一字段可选 cause；显式自有 cause（包括 undefined）转发原生 Error。`createStoreMiddlewareAggregateError(code,errors:readonly unknown[],message)` 返回原生 AggregateError，三参必填，errors 保留原对象。两者只构造、不自动 throw，附不可写 source/code、不改 stack。

examples:
import { ObservableMap } from '@migaia/store-indexed'
import { memoryStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-web/memory'
import { defaultJsonCodec } from '@migaia/store-persist'
import { persistCollection } from '@migaia/store-persist/indexed'

const storage = memoryStorageHost()
const cart = new ObservableMap<string, number>()
const first = persistCollection(cart, { key: 'cart', storage })
await first.ready
cart.set('book', 2)
await first.flush()
first.dispose()
cart.dispose()
const restored = new ObservableMap<string, number>([['stale', 99]])
const second = persistCollection(restored, { key: 'cart', storage })
await second.ready
console.log('恢复：', restored.get('book'), restored.has('stale'))
const saved = (await defaultJsonCodec.decode(await storage.get('cart'))) as { state: unknown }
console.log('映射：', saved.state instanceof Map)
second.dispose()
restored.dispose()
storage.dispose()

blocks.text: persistUnit(unit, options) 是三个适配器共用的引擎。unit 必须提供同步 snapshot()、同步 restore(state) 和 subscribe(onChange)，后者返回退订函数。核心 options 必填 key、runtime、storage；三个 facade 自动使用 Store / collection / AtomStore 自己的 Runtime。状态单位、Runtime 和 storage 均为借用资源。

blocks.text: facade 先捕获 options 自身属性；getter 使用原 options 作为 receiver 读取一次。核心也在创建时捕获配置字段，恢复使用已捕获并验证的 merge，不重新读取调用方的 getter。非对象、反射或 getter 失败以 INVALID_OPTION TypeError 报告，捕获的原因为 cause。key、namespace、id 在拼接前检查字符串，不把对象或数字悄悄转成键，也不额外要求非空字符串。容量时间、version 与回调形状在创建持久化状态前按实际配置校验。
migrate、partialize、merge 都是同步回调，不能返回 Promise / thenable；异步结果或读取 then 失败以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝，避免 Promise 被当作业务状态写入。普通同步业务回调或后端异常保留原来的公共错误路径；不要把所有失败都改判为某一个本包码。

symbols.name: IPersistHandle
symbols.purpose: Caller-owned hydration and serialized-write lifecycle from persistUnit or an adapter; it does not dispose the source state or injected backend.
symbols.core:
status: IReactiveComputed selecting disposed first, then loading, then hydration/write error, otherwise ready. A write can be active while overall status remains ready.
error: Computed current hydration or write failure; simultaneous failures form AggregateError preserving both originals.
hydrated: Computed true only after a successful hydration attempt; disposal does not convert an incomplete hydration into success.
hydrationStatus: Readonly .value projection reporting loading, success or error for the latest hydration attempt.
hydrationError: Readonly .value containing the latest hydration failure; cleared when another hydration attempt starts.
writeStatus: Readonly .value reporting idle, writing, error or disposed independently of hydration status.
writeError: Readonly .value retaining the latest failed write or removal; successful writes clear it and a final disposal write may update it later.
ready: Original first-hydration-attempt Promise: resolves only on success and rejects on failure or disposal before completion with AbortError/ABORTED_BY_DISPOSE. Retries do not replace this Promise.
settled: Barrier derived from the initial ready Promise that resolves after either success or failure; it does not await future retries.
disposed: Live terminal-disposal getter on the original IPersistHandle; becomes true once dispose is called.
retryHydrate: Retries storage reading after hydration failure. An ongoing recovery prevents another read but does not make every concurrent invocation wait for it; await the invocation that starts recovery. Success reopens automatic writes.
Promise of recovery; rejects on another failure or post-disposal invocation. Initial ready and settled remain their original Promises.
flush: Cancels the debounce window, waits for initial hydration and the actual pending write drain, then requests a strict immediate serialized write. Concurrent callers observe the same original drain failure; the scheduling recovery chain never replaces its result.
Promise resolving after the write; hydration/write failures reject, and disposal during the wait produces AbortError.
clear: Cancels the debounce window and queues archive removal after earlier writes; it neither resets memory nor unsubscribes the source.
Promise resolving after removal; hydration/removal failures or disposal reject. A later source change can recreate the archive.
disposeAsync: Stops scheduling like dispose, then waits for admitted writes/removals and any final debounce snapshot. It does not wait for borrowed reads or dispose the source, storage or runtime.
Promise resolving after the write chain settles. A synchronous cleanup failure rejects afterwards; final-write failures remain available on writeError.
dispose: Idempotently stops persistence subscriptions, cancels the debounce timer and aborts active adapter operations. A pending debounce window starts one unawaited final snapshot write. It does not clear business values or dispose the source state.
Nothing; scheduling is terminal. An adapter ignoring abort can still complete, and final-write failure remains in writeError.

members.name: hydrationError
members.description: Hydration failure retained until another attempt starts; undefined initially and on success.

members.name: writeStatus
members.description: Idle/writing/error/disposed for serialized writes and removals.

members.name: writeError
members.description: Latest write failure, cleared by successful active writes; final disposal writes may update it.

members.name: ready
members.description: Initial hydration attempt only; rejects on failure/cancellation and is not replaced by retry.

members.name: settled
members.description: Always resolves after the initial ready attempt settles, including failure or cancellation.

members.name: retryHydrate
members.description: Starts another read when hydration has failed, without starting duplicate recovery reads. Await the invocation that starts recovery before resuming explicit writes; concurrent calls need not share its wait. The original ready/settled promises retain their initial results.

members.name: flush
members.description: Cancels debounce, waits for initial hydration and an observed in-flight write, then requests a current snapshot write. Hydration/write failures reject; disposal is AbortError cancellation. Completion depends on the adapter settling even when it ignores cancellation.

members.name: clear
members.description: Cancels debounce and queues removal of the codec's archive channel after initial hydration and earlier writes. Does not reset live state or disable future writes; hydration/removal failures reject, and disposal rejects with `AbortError`.

members.name: disposed
members.description: Terminal marker set synchronously by dispose, including while adapter work is still pending.

members.name: dispose
members.description: Idempotently stops scheduling and aborts active operations without awaiting them. A pending debounce snapshots one final unawaited write; inspect writeError for failure. Unsubscribe failures can throw after the handle is already terminal; borrowed resources remain owned by their caller.

members.name: disposeAsync
members.description: Stops synchronously like dispose, then waits for admitted writes/removals and any final debounce snapshot to settle, including adapters that ignore abort. Final-write failures remain on writeError; existing flush/clear promises retain their original outcomes. A synchronous cleanup failure rejects after the write chain settles. Does not wait for borrowed adapter reads or dispose the borrowed store/runtime.

symbols.purpose: Complete generic engine configuration, including caller-owned runtime, backend and synchronous state transformation callbacks.
symbols.core:
key: Archive key selected by the application and reused for reading, writing and removal.
runtime: Owning IRuntime from the source Store, collection or AtomStore; persistence status signals are created in that graph.
storage: Caller-injected storage-contract IKeyValueStore projection: capabilities, get, set, remove and keys. Binary output additionally requires getBytes and setBytes from IRecordStore.
codec: ICodec from storage-contract encoding the complete version/state envelope. Text and binary routes are supported; structured writes reject.
defaultJsonCodec with Map/Set round trips and legacy-tag reading.
version: Application schema version, a safe nonnegative integer compared with each saved envelope version.
0; an unequal saved version requires migrate.
migrate: Synchronous callback on version mismatch; receives decoded persisted state and the archive version. Throw or thenable result fails hydration.
migrate.persisted: Decoded archive state before merging into current memory.
migrate.fromVersion: Schema version read from the stored envelope.
Synchronous state compatible with the configured version.
Omitted: version mismatch fails hydration with ENVELOPE_INVALID.
Set it when stored schema versions differ. The callback receives the saved state and its version and must return the current shape synchronously. Without it a mismatch fails; returning a Promise also fails hydration.
partialize: Synchronous callback before each write, receiving the latest unit snapshot and selecting its persisted portion. Throws and thenables become write failures.
partialize.state: Latest synchronous source snapshot taken when the write executes.
Synchronous complete or partial state placed inside the envelope.
Identity: persist the complete snapshot.
Use it to keep session-only or derived fields out of storage. It selects each write without changing live memory. Omission stores the complete snapshot. The callback must return synchronously.
merge: Synchronous hydration callback receiving persisted partial state and the latest current state; return the complete state to restore. Throws or thenables fail hydration.
merge.persisted: Decoded and optionally migrated partial archive state.
merge.current: Current source snapshot immediately before restoration.
Synchronous complete source state for restore.
Plain objects retain current fields changed since the original startup snapshot and accept persisted values for unchanged fields. Arrays, Map, Set and other shapes replace completely.
Set it when archived partial state needs shape-specific reconciliation with live state. Return a complete synchronous state. Default plain-object merging preserves edits since attachment; non-object shapes are replaced by the archive.
debounceMs: Quiet interval before requesting a serialized write; finite milliseconds in [0, 2147483647]. It does not bound storage latency.
0: enqueue a write without a debounce timer.
maxWaitMs: Maximum debounce window from the first post-hydration change; finite milliseconds in [0, 2147483647]. Relevant only when debounceMs is positive.
undefined: only the quiet interval controls enqueueing.
scheduler: Caller-selected IScheduler from @migaia/utils/scheduler; its monotonic now and cancellable schedule own the debounce window.
Canonical systemScheduler resolved through lifecycle scheduler admission.

members.description: Owns the status signals. Use the underlying store, collection, or `AtomStore` runtime to keep them in one graph.

members.name: version
members.description: Archive schema version, default 0; must be a nonnegative safe integer.

members.name: migrate
members.description: Synchronously transforms a different archived version; absence makes a version mismatch fail hydration.

members.name: partialize
members.description: Synchronously selects state for each write, default identity; does not change in-memory state.

members.name: merge
members.description: Synchronously reconciles an archive with current state. Default plain-object merging preserves fields changed since the attachment snapshot; other shapes use archived replacement. Supply a shape-specific merge when storing only part of an array, Map, Set or custom state.

members.name: debounceMs
members.description: Quiet interval before enqueueing a write, default 0; finite range 0 through 2147483647 ms.

members.name: maxWaitMs
members.description: Optional maximum from a window's first post-hydration change; same finite range as debounceMs. Omitted means no maximum; zero schedules a zero-delay task when debounce is enabled. Does not bound queue or adapter latency, and has no timer effect when debounceMs is zero.

members.name: scheduler
members.description: Monotonic clock and cancellable timer owner; defaults to the canonical system scheduler.

blocks.text: 配置 version 非负安全整数等非法项同步 TypeError；信封问题由 PersistEnvelopeError 报告。水合失败后 flush / clear 继续抛 hydrationError，成功 retry 才解锁；写入失败查 writeError，并检查 codec 与后端是否匹配。已释放 handle 不能重用，业务内存和存档删除需分别管理。

公开错误工厂 createStorePersistError / createStorePersistTypeError 接收必填 code、message 和可选 options.cause；createStorePersistAbortError 接收 code、message、可选 cause，返回原生 DOMException，保持 name 为 AbortError；createStorePersistAggregateError 接收 code、errors、message，errors 保留原失败。code 类型为 IStorePersistErrorCode，工厂附加身份但不覆盖 stack。底层工具不需要在普通 Store 使用中自行重复实现。
包已有 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test、build 和 test:packed 脚本；实际报告说明哪些被执行，不以手册列出命令当成验证结论。排查未保存字段先看 partialize 与 debounce，再看 hydrationError / writeError；Map / Set 形状不对时检查是否换用了不支持集合的 codec。

symbols.purpose: Connects a caller-provided synchronous state unit to asynchronous hydration and serialized writes. Automatic writes stay gated after hydration failure until successful retry.
symbols.core:
unit: Application IPersistUnit with synchronous snapshot/restore and change subscription returning an unsubscribe function.
Complete caller-owned persistence handle. The engine captures recognized configuration once at entry; adapters first snapshot options using their original getter receiver. Inaccessible adapter options throw INVALID_OPTION with cause before construction. Hydration failures reject ready and remain observable through status.
key: Archive key selected by the application and reused for reading, writing and removal.
runtime: Owning IRuntime from the source Store, collection or AtomStore; persistence status signals are created in that graph.
storage: Caller-injected storage-contract IKeyValueStore projection: capabilities, get, set, remove and keys. Binary output additionally requires getBytes and setBytes from IRecordStore.
codec: ICodec from storage-contract encoding the complete version/state envelope. Text and binary routes are supported; structured writes reject.
defaultJsonCodec with Map/Set round trips and legacy-tag reading.
version: Application schema version, a safe nonnegative integer compared with each saved envelope version.
0; an unequal saved version requires migrate.
migrate: Synchronous callback on version mismatch; receives decoded persisted state and the archive version. Throw or thenable result fails hydration.
migrate.persisted: Decoded archive state before merging into current memory.
migrate.fromVersion: Schema version read from the stored envelope.
Synchronous state compatible with the configured version.
Omitted: version mismatch fails hydration with ENVELOPE_INVALID.
Set it when stored schema versions differ. The callback receives the saved state and its version and must return the current shape synchronously. Without it a mismatch fails; returning a Promise also fails hydration.
partialize: Synchronous callback before each write, receiving the latest unit snapshot and selecting its persisted portion. Throws and thenables become write failures.
partialize.state: Latest synchronous source snapshot taken when the write executes.
Synchronous complete or partial state placed inside the envelope.
Identity: persist the complete snapshot.
Use it to keep session-only or derived fields out of storage. It selects each write without changing live memory. Omission stores the complete snapshot. The callback must return synchronously.
merge: Synchronous hydration callback receiving persisted partial state and the latest current state; return the complete state to restore. Throws or thenables fail hydration.
merge.persisted: Decoded and optionally migrated partial archive state.
merge.current: Current source snapshot immediately before restoration.
Synchronous complete source state for restore.
Plain objects retain current fields changed since the original startup snapshot and accept persisted values for unchanged fields. Arrays, Map, Set and other shapes replace completely.
Set it when archived partial state needs shape-specific reconciliation with live state. Return a complete synchronous state. Default plain-object merging preserves edits since attachment; non-object shapes are replaced by the archive.
debounceMs: Quiet interval before requesting a serialized write; finite milliseconds in [0, 2147483647]. It does not bound storage latency.
0: enqueue a write without a debounce timer.
maxWaitMs: Maximum debounce window from the first post-hydration change; finite milliseconds in [0, 2147483647]. Relevant only when debounceMs is positive.
undefined: only the quiet interval controls enqueueing.
scheduler: Caller-selected IScheduler from @migaia/utils/scheduler; its monotonic now and cancellable schedule own the debounce window.
Canonical systemScheduler resolved through lifecycle scheduler admission.

blocks.text: facade 先捕获 options 自身属性；getter 使用原 options 作为 receiver 读取一次。核心也在创建时捕获配置字段，恢复使用已捕获并验证的 merge，不重新读取调用方的 getter。非对象、反射或 getter 失败以 INVALID_OPTION TypeError 报告，捕获的原因为 cause。key、namespace、id 在拼接前检查字符串，不把对象或数字悄悄转成键，也不额外要求非空字符串。容量时间、version 与回调形状在创建持久化状态前按实际配置校验。

symbols.name: StorePersistErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Stable persistence failure codes covering configuration, envelope, codec, backend and disposal cancellation failures.
symbols.core:
codecNotResolved: A supplied codec resolves to no usable codec; supply a valid ICodec.
codecOutputMismatch: Representation conflicts with routing, including structured writes or a nonstring text result.
backendCapability: Binary route is selected but required byte methods are unavailable.
envelopeInvalid: Decoded archive shape or unmigrated version is invalid.
encodeFailed: Default JSON encoding failed; the original failure remains as cause.
hydrateAndWriteFailed: Hydration and write failures coexist in a preserving AggregateError.
abortedByDispose: Disposal cancels a persistence operation with native AbortError identity.
invalidOption: Invalid key, version, callback, timer, backend or codec configuration.

members.name: codecNotResolved
members.description: No codec resolves for a storage key. * * Provide `codec` to `persist` or `persistUnit`, or confirm that the default codec is available.

members.name: codecOutputMismatch
members.description: Codec output does not match the backend capabilities or contract. Examples include unsupported * structured output, non-byte binary output, and non-string text output. * * Check the codec `output` and backend `capabilities`. This is a configuration or implementation * mismatch, not a transient failure.

members.name: backendCapability
members.description: A binary read/write requires `getBytes` and `setBytes`, or archive removal requires * `removeBytes`, but the storage backend lacks the required operation. * * Use a record-capable backend such as memory or IndexedDB, or use a text codec.

members.name: envelopeInvalid
members.description: The saved envelope is invalid or incompatible with the current store version. Its state may be * missing, its version invalid, its properties inaccessible, or its version different without a * migration. * * Check the archive and configured `version`. Provide `migrate` for a version mismatch.

members.name: encodeFailed
members.description: The JSON codec fails to serialize a value. * * Check whether the value is JSON-serializable. The original exception remains in `cause`.

members.name: hydrateAndWriteFailed
members.description: The handle retains both a hydration error and a write error. Its combined error projection * returns an AggregateError containing them in hydration-then-write order; it does not reopen a * failed hydration's write gate. * * Inspect `error.errors` and handle each failure. This is a double failure, not one transient * error.

members.name: abortedByDispose
members.description: A persistence operation is aborted by `dispose()`. The error retains the name `AbortError`. * * Treat this as cancellation. Disposal stops scheduling new writes and requests cancellation of * active operations. An in-flight adapter may still complete.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Persistence options are invalid, for example when `version` is not a safe non-negative integer. * * Correct the configuration before retrying. This is a permanent input error.

symbols.name: writeEnvelope
symbols.purpose: Encodes the value and routes its output. structured writes reject. With binary output and capabilities.binary true, byte methods and Uint8Array output are required; otherwise writes use text and require a string. No automatic base64 conversion occurs.
symbols.core:
storage: Caller-injected storage-contract IKeyValueStore projection: capabilities, get, set, remove and keys. Binary output additionally requires getBytes and setBytes from IRecordStore.
key: Archive key selected by the application and reused for reading, writing and removal.
codec: Caller-selected storage-contract ICodec used to encode this exact value.
value: Application envelope or other value; this helper does not assert envelope shape.
ctx: Required context object; signal defaults to undefined. A supplied caller AbortSignal is forwarded to the codec and storage operation.
Promise resolving after the selected backend write; codec, capability and backend failures reject.

key: string
codec: ICodec
value: unknown
ctx: { signal?: IAbortSignal; }

symbols.name: IPersistCollectionOptions
symbols.purpose: Collection adapter options; source runtime is inferred and custom shape reconciliation can use merge.
symbols.core:
key: Archive key selected by the application and reused for reading, writing and removal.
storage: Caller-injected storage-contract IKeyValueStore projection: capabilities, get, set, remove and keys. Binary output additionally requires getBytes and setBytes from IRecordStore.
codec: ICodec from storage-contract encoding the complete version/state envelope. Text and binary routes are supported; structured writes reject.
defaultJsonCodec with Map/Set round trips and legacy-tag reading.
version: Application schema version, a safe nonnegative integer compared with each saved envelope version.
0; an unequal saved version requires migrate.
migrate: Synchronous callback on version mismatch; receives decoded persisted state and the archive version. Throw or thenable result fails hydration.
migrate.persisted: Decoded archive state before merging into current memory.
migrate.fromVersion: Schema version read from the stored envelope.
Synchronous state compatible with the configured version.
Omitted: version mismatch fails hydration with ENVELOPE_INVALID.
Set it when stored schema versions differ. The callback receives the saved state and its version and must return the current shape synchronously. Without it a mismatch fails; returning a Promise also fails hydration.
partialize: Synchronous callback before each write, receiving the latest unit snapshot and selecting its persisted portion. Throws and thenables become write failures.
partialize.state: Latest synchronous source snapshot taken when the write executes.
Synchronous complete or partial state placed inside the envelope.
Identity: persist the complete snapshot.
Use it to keep session-only or derived fields out of storage. It selects each write without changing live memory. Omission stores the complete snapshot. The callback must return synchronously.
merge: Synchronous hydration callback receiving persisted partial state and the latest current state; return the complete state to restore. Throws or thenables fail hydration.
merge.persisted: Decoded and optionally migrated partial archive state.
merge.current: Current source snapshot immediately before restoration.
Synchronous complete source state for restore.
Plain objects retain current fields changed since the original startup snapshot and accept persisted values for unchanged fields. Arrays, Map, Set and other shapes replace completely.
Set it when archived partial state needs shape-specific reconciliation with live state. Return a complete synchronous state. Default plain-object merging preserves edits since attachment; non-object shapes are replaced by the archive.
debounceMs: Quiet interval before requesting a serialized write; finite milliseconds in [0, 2147483647]. It does not bound storage latency.
0: enqueue a write without a debounce timer.
maxWaitMs: Maximum debounce window from the first post-hydration change; finite milliseconds in [0, 2147483647]. Relevant only when debounceMs is positive.
undefined: only the quiet interval controls enqueueing.
scheduler: Caller-selected IScheduler from @migaia/utils/scheduler; its monotonic now and cancellable schedule own the debounce window.
Canonical systemScheduler resolved through lifecycle scheduler admission.

members.name: key
members.description: Required archive key passed unchanged to storage.

members.name: storage
members.description: Borrowed text-capable storage with optional binary operations.

members.name: codec
members.description: Complete envelope codec, default defaultJsonCodec, including Map/Set round trips.

members.name: version
members.description: Nonnegative safe archive version, default 0.

members.name: migrate
members.description: Synchronously converts a mismatched archive version; absence rejects that hydration.

members.name: partialize
members.description: Synchronous write projection, default identity; pair partial non-object shapes with merge.

members.name: merge
members.description: Synchronous reconciliation, default attachment-baseline merge for plain objects and archive replacement for arrays, Maps, Sets and other shapes. Return a complete replacement state.

members.name: debounceMs
members.description: Quiet interval before enqueueing a write, default 0; finite range 0 through 2147483647 ms.

members.name: maxWaitMs
members.description: Optional maximum from a window's first post-hydration change; same finite range as debounceMs. Omitted means no maximum; zero schedules a zero-delay task when debounce is enabled. Does not bound queue or adapter latency, and has no timer effect when debounceMs is zero.

members.name: scheduler
members.description: Monotonic clock and cancellable timer owner; defaults to the canonical system scheduler.

import { ObservableMap } from '@migaia/store-indexed'
import { memoryStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-web/memory'
import { defaultJsonCodec } from '@migaia/store-persist'
import { persistCollection } from '@migaia/store-persist/indexed'

const storage = memoryStorageHost()
const cart = new ObservableMap<string, number>()
const first = persistCollection(cart, { key: 'cart', storage })
await first.ready
cart.set('book', 2)
await first.flush()
first.dispose()
cart.dispose()
const restored = new ObservableMap<string, number>([['stale', 99]])
const second = persistCollection(restored, { key: 'cart', storage })
await second.ready
console.log('恢复：', restored.get('book'), restored.has('stale'))
const saved = (await defaultJsonCodec.decode(await storage.get('cart'))) as { state: unknown }
console.log('映射：', saved.state instanceof Map)
second.dispose()
restored.dispose()
storage.dispose()

symbols.name: clearFamily
symbols.purpose: Enumerates backend keys and removes those starting with namespace plus a colon, sequentially. It does not inventory live definitions or alter their in-memory state.
symbols.core:
storage: Caller-injected storage-contract IKeyValueStore projection: capabilities, get, set, remove and keys. Binary output additionally requires getBytes and setBytes from IRecordStore.
namespace: Exact application-selected namespace used by persistKeyed; matching includes its trailing colon separator.
Number of matched records after all removals succeed; backend failure rejects and earlier removals remain applied.
parameters: storage: IPersistStorage
namespace: string
symbols.returns: Promise<number>
examples:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { createAtomStore, familyDef } from '@migaia/store-keyed'
import { memoryStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-web/memory'
import { persistKeyed, clearFamily } from '@migaia/store-persist/keyed'

const storage = memoryStorageHost()
await storage.set('other:u1', 'keep')
const atoms = createAtomStore(createRuntime())
const counter = familyDef(() => 0)
const def = counter('u1')
const handle = persistKeyed(atoms, def, 'u1', { namespace: 'users', storage })
await handle.ready
atoms.set(def, 7)
await handle.flush()
console.log('匹配数：', await clearFamily(storage, 'users'))
console.log(
  '清理后：',
  await storage.get('users:u1'),
  atoms.peek(def),
  await storage.get('other:u1')
)
atoms.set(def, 8)
await handle.flush()
console.log('重新保存：', (await storage.get('users:u1')) !== null)
handle.dispose()
atoms.dispose()
storage.dispose()

symbols.name: IPersistKeyedHandle
symbols.purpose: The actual complete engine handle extended with value captured before initial hydration. Live status and disposed getters retain their original owner; read live business values through AtomStore.
symbols.core:
status: IReactiveComputed selecting disposed first, then loading, then hydration/write error, otherwise ready. A write can be active while overall status remains ready.
error: Computed current hydration or write failure; simultaneous failures form AggregateError preserving both originals.
hydrated: Computed true only after a successful hydration attempt; disposal does not convert an incomplete hydration into success.
hydrationStatus: Readonly .value projection reporting loading, success or error for the latest hydration attempt.
hydrationError: Readonly .value containing the latest hydration failure; cleared when another hydration attempt starts.
writeStatus: Readonly .value reporting idle, writing, error or disposed independently of hydration status.
writeError: Readonly .value retaining the latest failed write or removal; successful writes clear it and a final disposal write may update it later.
ready: Original first-hydration-attempt Promise: resolves only on success and rejects on failure or disposal before completion with AbortError/ABORTED_BY_DISPOSE. Retries do not replace this Promise.
settled: Barrier derived from the initial ready Promise that resolves after either success or failure; it does not await future retries.
disposed: Live terminal-disposal getter on the original IPersistHandle; becomes true once dispose is called.
retryHydrate: Retries storage reading after hydration failure. An ongoing recovery prevents another read but does not make every concurrent invocation wait for it; await the invocation that starts recovery. Success reopens automatic writes.
Promise of recovery; rejects on another failure or post-disposal invocation. Initial ready and settled remain their original Promises.
flush: Cancels the debounce window, waits for initial hydration and the actual pending write drain, then requests a strict immediate serialized write. Concurrent callers observe the same original drain failure; the scheduling recovery chain never replaces its result.
Promise resolving after the write; hydration/write failures reject, and disposal during the wait produces AbortError.
clear: Cancels the debounce window and queues archive removal after earlier writes; it neither resets memory nor unsubscribes the source.
Promise resolving after removal; hydration/removal failures or disposal reject. A later source change can recreate the archive.
disposeAsync: Stops scheduling like dispose, then waits for admitted writes/removals and any final debounce snapshot. It does not wait for borrowed reads or dispose the source, storage or runtime.
Promise resolving after the write chain settles. A synchronous cleanup failure rejects afterwards; final-write failures remain available on writeError.
dispose: Idempotently stops persistence subscriptions, cancels the debounce timer and aborts active adapter operations. A pending debounce window starts one unawaited final snapshot write. It does not clear business values or dispose the source state.
Nothing; scheduling is terminal. An adapter ignoring abort can still complete, and final-write failure remains in writeError.
value: Initial atomStore.get(def) result captured before persistence construction; not a live getter and not refreshed by hydration.

members.name: status
members.description: Disposed first, then loading/error, otherwise ready; ready also permits an in-flight write.

members.name: error
members.description: Latest hydration/write error, combining both in an AggregateError when both are present.

members.name: hydrated
members.description: Whether the latest hydration attempt succeeded; disposal does not reset this result.

members.name: hydrationStatus
members.description: Loading/success/error for hydration; a retry starts a new loading phase.

members.name: hydrationError
members.description: Hydration failure retained until another attempt starts; undefined initially and on success.

members.name: writeStatus
members.description: Idle/writing/error/disposed for serialized writes and removals.

members.name: writeError
members.description: Latest write failure, cleared by successful active writes; final disposal writes may update it.

members.name: ready
members.description: Initial hydration attempt only; rejects on failure/cancellation and is not replaced by retry.

members.name: settled
members.description: Always resolves after the initial ready attempt settles, including failure or cancellation.

members.name: retryHydrate
members.description: Starts another read when hydration has failed, without starting duplicate recovery reads. Await the invocation that starts recovery before resuming explicit writes; concurrent calls need not share its wait. The original ready/settled promises retain their initial results.

members.name: flush
members.description: Cancels debounce, waits for initial hydration and an observed in-flight write, then requests a current snapshot write. Hydration/write failures reject; disposal is AbortError cancellation. Completion depends on the adapter settling even when it ignores cancellation.

members.name: clear
members.description: Cancels debounce and queues removal of the codec's archive channel after initial hydration and earlier writes. Does not reset live state or disable future writes; hydration/removal failures reject, and disposal rejects with `AbortError`.

members.name: disposed
members.description: Terminal marker set synchronously by dispose, including while adapter work is still pending.

members.name: dispose
members.description: Idempotently stops scheduling and aborts active operations without awaiting them. A pending debounce snapshots one final unawaited write; inspect writeError for failure. Unsubscribe failures can throw after the handle is already terminal; borrowed resources remain owned by their caller.

members.name: disposeAsync
members.description: Stops synchronously like dispose, then waits for admitted writes/removals and any final debounce snapshot to settle, including adapters that ignore abort. Final-write failures remain on writeError; existing flush/clear promises retain their original outcomes. A synchronous cleanup failure rejects after the write chain settles. Does not wait for borrowed adapter reads or dispose the borrowed store/runtime.

version: Application schema version, a safe nonnegative integer compared with each saved envelope version.

undefined: only the quiet interval controls enqueueing.
scheduler: Caller-selected IScheduler from @migaia/utils/scheduler; its monotonic now and cancellable schedule own the debounce window.

examples:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { createAtomStore, familyDef } from '@migaia/store-keyed'
import { memoryStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-web/memory'
import { persistKeyed, clearFamily } from '@migaia/store-persist/keyed'

const storage = memoryStorageHost()
await storage.set('other:u1', 'keep')
const atoms = createAtomStore(createRuntime())
const counter = familyDef(() => 0)
const def = counter('u1')
const handle = persistKeyed(atoms, def, 'u1', { namespace: 'users', storage })
await handle.ready
atoms.set(def, 7)
await handle.flush()
console.log('匹配数：', await clearFamily(storage, 'users'))
console.log(
  '清理后：',
  await storage.get('users:u1'),
  atoms.peek(def),
  await storage.get('other:u1')
)
atoms.set(def, 8)
await handle.flush()
console.log('重新保存：', (await storage.get('users:u1')) !== null)
handle.dispose()
atoms.dispose()
storage.dispose()

examples:
import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'
import { memoryStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-web/memory'
import { persist } from '@migaia/store-persist/light'

const storage = memoryStorageHost()
const settings = createStore({ theme: 'light' })
const handle = persist(settings, { key: 'settings', storage })
await handle.ready
settings.theme = 'dark'
await handle.flush()
console.log('已保存：', (await storage.get('settings')) !== null)
handle.dispose()
await settings.$dispose()
storage.dispose()

blocks.text: persistUnit(unit, options) 是三个适配器共用的引擎。unit 必须提供同步 snapshot()、同步 restore(state) 和 subscribe(onChange)，后者返回退订函数。核心 options 必填 key、runtime、storage；三个 facade 自动使用 Store / collection / AtomStore 自己的 Runtime。状态单位、Runtime 和 storage 均为借用资源。

blocks.text: facade 先捕获 options 自身属性；getter 使用原 options 作为 receiver 读取一次。核心也在创建时捕获配置字段，恢复使用已捕获并验证的 merge，不重新读取调用方的 getter。非对象、反射或 getter 失败以 INVALID_OPTION TypeError 报告，捕获的原因为 cause。key、namespace、id 在拼接前检查字符串，不把对象或数字悄悄转成键，也不额外要求非空字符串。容量时间、version 与回调形状在创建持久化状态前按实际配置校验。
migrate、partialize、merge 都是同步回调，不能返回 Promise / thenable；异步结果或读取 then 失败以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝，避免 Promise 被当作业务状态写入。普通同步业务回调或后端异常保留原来的公共错误路径；不要把所有失败都改判为某一个本包码。

水合和写入均失败，展开 AggregateError.errors。
释放中止，保持 DOMException / AbortError 及原始 cause。

blocks.text: 配置 version 非负安全整数等非法项同步 TypeError；信封问题由 PersistEnvelopeError 报告。水合失败后 flush / clear 继续抛 hydrationError，成功 retry 才解锁；写入失败查 writeError，并检查 codec 与后端是否匹配。已释放 handle 不能重用，业务内存和存档删除需分别管理。

公开错误工厂 createStorePersistError / createStorePersistTypeError 接收必填 code、message 和可选 options.cause；createStorePersistAbortError 接收 code、message、可选 cause，返回原生 DOMException，保持 name 为 AbortError；createStorePersistAggregateError 接收 code、errors、message，errors 保留原失败。code 类型为 IStorePersistErrorCode，工厂附加身份但不覆盖 stack。底层工具不需要在普通 Store 使用中自行重复实现。
包已有 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test、build 和 test:packed 脚本；实际报告说明哪些被执行，不以手册列出命令当成验证结论。排查未保存字段先看 partialize 与 debounce，再看 hydrationError / writeError；Map / Set 形状不对时检查是否换用了不支持集合的 codec。

blocks.text: IStoreReadyBarrier 工厂为 `()=>Promise<unknown> 或 unknown`，归一化会同步调用它，结果用 Promise.resolve 接纳。所有屏障成功后渲染子树，任一失败在 render 抛给外层 Error Boundary；Provider 自己不提供错误 UI。Error 原因保持原实例（包括冻结 Error），非 Error 原因以 READY_REJECTED 包装并在 cause 保留，不进行字符串强制转换。features.wasm 的屏障可为任何等价初始化，不强制使用 store-wasm；ensureWasm 是可选组合。

同一 Provider/barrierScope、同一 ready 数组身份复用列表 Promise；新数组产生新就绪代，即使元素相同也重建 ReadyBoundary，旧代完成不能放行新代。工厂结果另按 scope+factory 身份缓存，在途/成功结果可跨列表复用，失败后删除工厂缓存，但同一旧数组仍复用已缓存的失败列表 Promise；单换数组不保证重新运行已成功的工厂。不同 Provider/请求 scope 隔离。abandoned render 之间不保证工厂恰好运行一次；非幂等初始化应由应用 owner 提供稳定 Promise。

已完成 Promise 的状态仍在 then 微任务更新，因此首次同步渲染可能 pending；客户端 effect 会重查，SSR renderToString 不运行 effect。保持 ready 数组、Store/Signal/Resource、selector/equality 身份稳定；配置是 readonly 输入，改变配置时提供新对象，不在 render 中写状态或创建持有资源的业务实例。

归一化配置的 features.wasm 为 boolean，features.experimental 为空原型浅冻结白名单，defaults 含 warnAsyncActions，ready 为 null 或带 promise/status()/error() 的跟踪对象；状态为 pending/ready/error；只有实验白名单被冻结，外层 features/defaults/ready 容器不保证冻结。StoreProviderState/IStoreProviderState 公开这三个值，状态不是错误码。实验键排序编码使输入键次序不影响配置；访问器不作为开启数据且不执行 getter，`__proto__` 是普通键。

symbols.name: IStoreProviderConfig
symbols.purpose: Input configuration for normalized features, readiness gates, pending fallback and application defaults.
symbols.core:
features: Application feature declarations normalized to explicit WASM and experimental booleans.
Omitted: all features are disabled.
ready: Promises or zero-argument synchronous/async factories. Normalization eagerly invokes uncached factories before returning, caches factory results by scope plus factory identity, and separately caches each list Promise by scope plus array identity. Rejected factory results leave the factory cache; scopes are isolated. A changed array identity selects a new Provider generation and ReadyBoundary, so an old generation cannot release the new one; changing only the array does not rerun a successful cached factory.
Factory result is awaited and discarded; rejection blocks the subtree and reaches its outer Error Boundary.
No barrier, unless WASM is enabled without one, which creates a rejected barrier.
fallback: ReactNode rendered while readiness remains pending; rejected barriers throw instead of rendering this fallback.
`null`: render no subtree while pending.
defaults: Application-readable defaults snapshot; it does not change existing or future Store construction options.
`warnAsyncActions` is `false`.

blocks.text: IStoreReadyBarrier 工厂为 `()=>Promise<unknown> 或 unknown`，归一化会同步调用它，结果用 Promise.resolve 接纳。所有屏障成功后渲染子树，任一失败在 render 抛给外层 Error Boundary；Provider 自己不提供错误 UI。Error 原因保持原实例（包括冻结 Error），非 Error 原因以 READY_REJECTED 包装并在 cause 保留，不进行字符串强制转换。features.wasm 的屏障可为任何等价初始化，不强制使用 store-wasm；ensureWasm 是可选组合。

同一 Provider/barrierScope、同一 ready 数组身份复用列表 Promise；新数组产生新就绪代，即使元素相同也重建 ReadyBoundary，旧代完成不能放行新代。工厂结果另按 scope+factory 身份缓存，在途/成功结果可跨列表复用，失败后删除工厂缓存，但同一旧数组仍复用已缓存的失败列表 Promise；单换数组不保证重新运行已成功的工厂。不同 Provider/请求 scope 隔离。abandoned render 之间不保证工厂恰好运行一次；非幂等初始化应由应用 owner 提供稳定 Promise。

已完成 Promise 的状态仍在 then 微任务更新，因此首次同步渲染可能 pending；客户端 effect 会重查，SSR renderToString 不运行 effect。保持 ready 数组、Store/Signal/Resource、selector/equality 身份稳定；配置是 readonly 输入，改变配置时提供新对象，不在 render 中写状态或创建持有资源的业务实例。

归一化配置的 features.wasm 为 boolean，features.experimental 为空原型浅冻结白名单，defaults 含 warnAsyncActions，ready 为 null 或带 promise/status()/error() 的跟踪对象；状态为 pending/ready/error；只有实验白名单被冻结，外层 features/defaults/ready 容器不保证冻结。StoreProviderState/IStoreProviderState 公开这三个值，状态不是错误码。实验键排序编码使输入键次序不影响配置；访问器不作为开启数据且不执行 getter，`__proto__` 是普通键。

blocks.text: IStoreReadyBarrier 工厂为 `()=>Promise<unknown> 或 unknown`，归一化会同步调用它，结果用 Promise.resolve 接纳。所有屏障成功后渲染子树，任一失败在 render 抛给外层 Error Boundary；Provider 自己不提供错误 UI。Error 原因保持原实例（包括冻结 Error），非 Error 原因以 READY_REJECTED 包装并在 cause 保留，不进行字符串强制转换。features.wasm 的屏障可为任何等价初始化，不强制使用 store-wasm；ensureWasm 是可选组合。

同一 Provider/barrierScope、同一 ready 数组身份复用列表 Promise；新数组产生新就绪代，即使元素相同也重建 ReadyBoundary，旧代完成不能放行新代。工厂结果另按 scope+factory 身份缓存，在途/成功结果可跨列表复用，失败后删除工厂缓存，但同一旧数组仍复用已缓存的失败列表 Promise；单换数组不保证重新运行已成功的工厂。不同 Provider/请求 scope 隔离。abandoned render 之间不保证工厂恰好运行一次；非幂等初始化应由应用 owner 提供稳定 Promise。

已完成 Promise 的状态仍在 then 微任务更新，因此首次同步渲染可能 pending；客户端 effect 会重查，SSR renderToString 不运行 effect。保持 ready 数组、Store/Signal/Resource、selector/equality 身份稳定；配置是 readonly 输入，改变配置时提供新对象，不在 render 中写状态或创建持有资源的业务实例。

归一化配置的 features.wasm 为 boolean，features.experimental 为空原型浅冻结白名单，defaults 含 warnAsyncActions，ready 为 null 或带 promise/status()/error() 的跟踪对象；状态为 pending/ready/error；只有实验白名单被冻结，外层 features/defaults/ready 容器不保证冻结。StoreProviderState/IStoreProviderState 公开这三个值，状态不是错误码。实验键排序编码使输入键次序不影响配置；访问器不作为开启数据且不执行 getter，`__proto__` 是普通键。

registryDisposalFailed: Owned cleanup failed: a mutable native uncoded error keeps identity and gains this code; frozen or non-Error values remain on cause/errors. Foreign coded errors keep their owner; multiple failures form an ordered native AggregateError.
providerRequired: Provider-dependent hook or feature assertion has no Provider configuration.
featureDisabled: Feature assertion targets a flag not explicitly enabled.
storeMissing: Required token has no current Registry entry.
storeDuplicate: Register attempts to insert an already registered token.
crossRuntime: Registered reactive value belongs to another Runtime graph.
invalidConfig: Malformed token, ownership, Provider config or readiness declaration.

members.name: registryDisposed
members.description: A provider registry is registered with or read after `dispose()`. * * Create a new registry instead of reusing the disposed instance.

members.name: registryDisposalFailed
members.description: An owned registry value fails to dispose. Unclassified native errors receive this code; * multiple failures expose an `AggregateError`, and existing foreign package identities remain. * * Inspect the original error, its `cause`, or each aggregate entry. Cleanup continues for other * owned values; retrying disposal does not rerun their callbacks.

members.name: providerRequired
members.description: A hook is called without `StoreProvider`. * * Wrap the subtree in `StoreProvider` or use a protocol hook that does not require a provider.

members.name: featureDisabled
members.description: An API requires a feature that is not explicitly enabled in the provider configuration. * * Enable that path in the `StoreProvider` `features` configuration.

members.name: storeMissing
members.description: The registry has no store for the requested token. * * Confirm that the store is registered and uses the same token.

members.name: storeDuplicate
members.description: The same token is registered twice. * * Remove duplicate registration or give each provider its own registry.

members.name: crossRuntime
members.description: A provider store belongs to another `Runtime`. * * Use the same `Runtime` for the store and registry. Cross-runtime injection is rejected.

members.name: invalidConfig
members.description: Provider or token configuration is invalid, for example a missing debug name or incompatible * `features.wasm` and `ready`. * * Correct the configuration before retrying. This is a permanent configuration error.

members.name: readyRejected
members.description: A non-Error readiness rejection is normalized before rendering can continue. Inspect `cause` * for the original reason; Error rejections, including frozen Errors, retain their identity * instead of receiving this code.

runtime: IRuntime from @migaia/reactive that owns the source nodes; this adapter never disposes it.

runtime: Owning graph used for cross-runtime admission and lifecycle failure reporting; never disposed by this registry.
atomStore: Registry-local IAtomStore from store-keyed; registries remain isolated even when sharing one Runtime.
lifecycle: Canonical ILifecycleState: public admission enters closing before any owned disposer runs, then reaches terminal only after every tracked disposer settles.
disposed: True as soon as whole-registry disposal starts, including during the first owned callback; register/replace/get/require/has/remove and retain reject. Use whenTerminal for physical completion.
whenTerminal: Waits for the whole-registry disposal ledger to finish; it does not initiate disposal or wait for ad-hoc remove/replace cleanup.

register: Registers one token/value pair after runtime admission; duplicate token registration rejects. Use the original token returned by createStoreToken.
register.token: The exact IStoreToken returned by createStoreToken; reuse that object for registration and lookup. Equal debug names do not share identity.
register.value: Application-owned value; reactive ownership, if present, must match registry.runtime.
register.options: Optional IStoreRegistrationOptions; owned defaults false and nonobject or nonboolean flags reject.
Idempotent unregister function; it only removes its original entry and disposes it when owned, leaving replacements untouched.
replace: Installs or replaces a token entry. A different previously owned value is disposed after replacement, so a cleanup throw does not undo the new entry.
replace.token: The exact IStoreToken returned by createStoreToken; reuse that object for registration and lookup. Equal debug names do not share identity.
replace.value: Replacement value admitted to this Runtime ownership boundary.
replace.options: Optional ownership for the new entry, default false; not inherited from the old entry.
Nothing; the new value is registered, or validation/old synchronous cleanup fails.
get: Looks up a token synchronously without adding a React subscription to registry changes.
get.token: The exact IStoreToken returned by createStoreToken; reuse that object for registration and lookup. Equal debug names do not share identity.
Registered value, or undefined if absent; throws after registry closure.
require: Reads an existing registration and rejects a missing token with STORE_MISSING.
require.token: The exact IStoreToken returned by createStoreToken; reuse that object for registration and lookup. Equal debug names do not share identity.
Registered value preserving its original identity.
has: Checks whether this exact token key has a current entry; no source data subscription is created.
has.token: The exact IStoreToken returned by createStoreToken; reuse that object for registration and lookup. Equal debug names do not share identity.
True for a present entry, including one storing undefined.
remove: Deletes an entry before optional owned-value cleanup; asynchronous cleanup failures are reported through Runtime and not joined by later disposeAsync.
remove.token: The exact IStoreToken returned by createStoreToken; reuse that object for registration and lookup. Equal debug names do not share identity.
remove.disposeOwned: Defaults true; false removes the registration while retaining any owned value for external cleanup.
True if an entry was removed, false if absent; synchronous cleanup can throw after removal.
retain: Acquires one Provider retention. Its release function schedules disposal via setTimeout(0) only if requested and the registry still has zero owners in that generation.
retain.disposeOnRelease: True requests terminal registry disposal after the last owner releases; false only drops this retention.
Idempotent release callback; repeated release cannot decrement ownership twice.
dispose: Closes public admission before callbacks, starts reverse-registration-order owned cleanup, then atomStore cleanup. The shared async completion is published first, so reentrant disposeAsync returns the same Promise. Every cleanup is attempted; thenables stay observed and tracked until terminal completion.
Nothing; idempotent after the first start. One mutable native uncoded failure retains object/type/stack and gains REGISTRY_DISPOSAL_FAILED; frozen or non-Error failures remain on cause/errors. Complete foreign identity stays unchanged; multiple failures form AggregateError in cleanup order.
disposeAsync: Starts disposal if needed and returns one stable shared completion, including thenables started by an earlier synchronous dispose.
One stable Promise resolving at cleanup completion, including reentrant calls. Failures use the same native identity/cause/foreign-owner policy as dispose; multiple failures reject as ordered AggregateError.
